	local icons = {}
	for name, data in pairs(iconData) do
		icons[name] = loadEmbeddedImage("OscarsPanel_" .. name .. ".png", data)
	end

	local statIconData = {
		walkspeed = "",
		range = "",
		attackrate = "",
		damage = "",
		resistance = "",
		armor = "",
		health = "",
	}
	local statIcons = {}
	for name, data in pairs(statIconData) do
		statIcons[name] = loadEmbeddedImage("OscarsPanel_stat_" .. name .. ".png", data)
	end

	-- small square button that shows one of the face icons (or a letter if images are unavailable)
	local function addIconButton(row, offsetFromRight)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -offsetFromRight, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = "",
		}, row)
		outline(button)
		local image = make("ImageLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
			Visible = false,
		}, button)
		return button, image
	end

	local function showIcon(button, image, asset, fallbackText)
		if asset then
			image.Image = asset
			image.Visible = true
			button.Text = ""
		else
			image.Visible = false
			button.Text = fallbackText
		end
	end

	local function valueText(slot, key)
		local value = slot[key]
		if key == "strength" then
			return value and tostring(value) or "0"
		end
		return tostring(value)
	end

	local function commitValue(slot, key, text)
		local number = tonumber(text)
		if key == "id" or key == "limit" then
			if number and number >= 0 then
				slot[key] = math.floor(number)
			end
		elseif key == "timer" then
			if number and number >= 0 then
				slot[key] = number
			end
		elseif key == "strength" then
			slot.strength = (number and number > 0) and number or nil
		end
	end

	local FIELD_LABELS = { id = "ID", limit = "Limit", timer = "Timer (s)", strength = "Strength" }

	local function addSlotBlock(outer, slot, title, keys)
		-- every slot is its own little box: a header row that is always visible (name, ID, ON/OFF, icons)
		-- and a body with all the settings that opens with the arrow button
		local wrapper = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
		}, outer)
		make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, wrapper)
		make("UIPadding", { PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8) }, wrapper)

		local header = addGrayRow(wrapper, title)
		local titleLabel = header:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if titleLabel then
			titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 1, 0)
			titleLabel.TextSize = 12
			titleLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		end

		local parent = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Visible = false,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
		}, wrapper)
		make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, parent)

		local expandButton = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -126, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 14,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = "v",
		}, header)
		outline(expandButton)
		listen(expandButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			parent.Visible = not parent.Visible
			expandButton.Text = parent.Visible and "^" or "v"
		end)

		local function refreshTitle()
			if titleLabel then
				titleLabel.Text = title .. (slot.id > 0 and ("  -  ID " .. tostring(slot.id)) or "  -  empty")
					.. ((slot.count or 1) > 1 and ("  x" .. tostring(slot.count)) or "")
			end
			header.BackgroundColor3 = (slot.id > 0 and slot.enabled) and Color3.fromRGB(200, 225, 200) or GRAY
		end
		slot.refreshTitle = refreshTitle
		local teamButton, teamImage = addIconButton(header, 8)
		local modeButton, modeImage = addIconButton(header, 44)

		-- slot switch (ON/OFF)
		local switchButton = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 30),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0.5, 0),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 13,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = "",
		}, header)
		outline(switchButton)
		local function refreshSwitch()
			switchButton.Text = slot.enabled and "ON" or "OFF"
			switchButton.BackgroundColor3 = slot.enabled and ON_COLOR or WHITE
		end
		refreshSwitch()
		listen(switchButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			slot.enabled = not slot.enabled
			refreshSwitch()
			refreshTitle()
		end)

		local function refreshTeam()
			if slot.ally then
				showIcon(teamButton, teamImage, icons.ally, "ALLY")
			else
				showIcon(teamButton, teamImage, icons.enemy, "FOE")
			end
		end
		local function refreshMode()
			if slot.mode == "tumored" then
				showIcon(modeButton, modeImage, icons.tumored, "TUM")
			else
				showIcon(modeButton, modeImage, icons.casual, "CAS")
			end
		end
		refreshTeam()
		refreshMode()

		listen(teamButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			slot.ally = not slot.ally
			refreshTeam()
		end)
		listen(modeButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			slot.mode = slot.mode == "tumored" and "casual" or "tumored"
			refreshMode()
		end)

		local fieldsRow = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52),
			BackgroundColor3 = GRAY,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
		}, parent)
		outline(fieldsRow)

		local count = #keys
		local fieldBoxes, statBoxes = {}, {}
		for index, key in ipairs(keys) do
			local column = make("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1 / count, 0, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new((index - 1) / count, 0, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			}, fieldsRow)
			make("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = FIELD_LABELS[key],
				TextColor3 = BLACK,
				TextSize = 11,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			}, column)
			local box = make("TextBox", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 24),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 22),
				BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
				TextColor3 = BLACK,
				TextSize = 15,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				Text = valueText(slot, key),
				ClearTextOnFocus = false,
			}, column)
			outline(box)
			fieldBoxes[key] = box
			listen(box.FocusLost, function()
				local oldValue = slot[key]
				commitValue(slot, key, box.Text)
				box.Text = valueText(slot, key)
				refreshTitle()
				if slot == Custom.boss and key == "id" and slot.id ~= oldValue and slot.id > 0 then
					Custom.spawnBoss()
				end
			end)
		end

		-- stat changers: heart, shield, armor, sword, bullets, bow, boot. Blank = the game's default.
		local statsRow = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56),
			BackgroundColor3 = GRAY,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
		}, parent)
		outline(statsRow)
		local statCount = #Custom.STATS
		for index, stat in ipairs(Custom.STATS) do
			local column = make("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1 / statCount, 0, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new((index - 1) / statCount, 0, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			}, statsRow)
			local asset = statIcons[stat.id]
			if asset then
				make("ImageLabel", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
					Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 3),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
					Image = asset,
				}, column)
			else
				make("TextLabel", {
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Text = stat.letter,
					TextColor3 = BLACK,
					TextSize = 11,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				}, column)
			end
			local statBox = make("TextBox", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 24),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 27),
				BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
				TextColor3 = BLACK,
				PlaceholderText = "-",
				PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY,
				TextSize = 13,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				Text = slot.stats[stat.id] and tostring(slot.stats[stat.id]) or "",
				ClearTextOnFocus = false,
			}, column)
			outline(statBox)
			statBoxes[stat.id] = statBox
			listen(statBox.FocusLost, function()
				local number = tonumber(statBox.Text)
				slot.stats[stat.id] = number
				statBox.Text = number and tostring(number) or ""
			end)
		end

		-- ===== extras: spawn extra, outfit, on death =====
		local extraRefresh = {}

		local function addFieldsRow(target, defs)
			local row = make("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52),
				BackgroundColor3 = GRAY,
				LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
			}, target)
			outline(row)
			local boxes = {}
			for index, def in ipairs(defs) do
				local column = make("Frame", {
					Size = UDim2.new(def.width, 0, 1, 0),
					Position = UDim2.new(def.x, 0, 0, 0),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				}, row)
				make("TextLabel", {
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Text = def.label,
					TextColor3 = BLACK,
					TextSize = 11,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				}, column)
				local box = make("TextBox", {
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 24),
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 22),
					BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
					TextColor3 = BLACK,
					PlaceholderText = def.placeholder or "",
					PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
					TextSize = def.textSize or 15,
					TextXAlignment = def.left and Enum.TextXAlignment.Left or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
					ClipsDescendants = true,
					Font = def.left and Enum.Font.Code or Enum.Font.GothamBold,
					Text = def.get(),
					ClearTextOnFocus = false,
				}, column)
				outline(box)
				boxes[index] = box
				listen(box.FocusLost, function()
					def.set(box.Text, box)
					box.Text = def.get()
				end)
			end
			table.insert(extraRefresh, function()
				for index, def in ipairs(defs) do
					boxes[index].Text = def.get()
				end
			end)
		end

		local function checkedCode(text, box, prefixes, placeholder, invalid)
			text = string.gsub(text or "", "%s", "")
			if text ~= "" then
				local head = string.sub(text, 1, 4)
				local good = false
				for _, prefix in ipairs(prefixes) do
					if head == prefix then good = true end
				end
				if not good then
					box.PlaceholderText = invalid
					return ""
				end
			end
			box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
			return text
		end

		local function checkedOutfit(text, box)
			text = string.gsub(text or "", "%s", "")
			if text ~= "" and Custom.parseOutfit(text) == nil then
				box.PlaceholderText = "not a valid accessory code"
				return ""
			end
			box.PlaceholderText = "paste outfit code"
			return text
		end

		local extrasRow = addGrayRow(parent, "More: extra / outfit / animation / sound / sprite / on death")
		local extrasButton = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 24),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = "OPEN",
		}, extrasRow)
		outline(extrasButton)

		local extraFrame = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Visible = false,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
		}, parent)
		make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, extraFrame)
		listen(extrasButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			extraFrame.Visible = not extraFrame.Visible
			extrasButton.Text = extraFrame.Visible and "CLOSE" or "OPEN"
		end)

		addFieldsRow(extraFrame, {
			{ label = "Spawn count", x = 0, width = 0.25,
				get = function() return tostring(slot.count) end,
				set = function(text)
					local number = tonumber(text)
					if number and number >= 1 then slot.count = math.floor(number) end
					refreshTitle()
				end },
			{ label = "Extra delay (s)", x = 0.25, width = 0.25,
				get = function() return tostring(slot.extraDelay) end,
				set = function(text)
					local number = tonumber(text)
					if number and number >= 0 then slot.extraDelay = number end
				end },
			{ label = "Outfit code (from Accessory Paster)", x = 0.5, width = 0.5, left = true, textSize = 11, placeholder = "paste outfit code",
				get = function() return slot.outfit end,
				set = function(text, box) slot.outfit = checkedOutfit(text, box) end },
		})

		-- animation / sound that play when this slot's battler spawns
		addFieldsRow(extraFrame, {
			{ label = "Spawn animation ID", x = 0, width = 0.5, placeholder = "0 = none",
				get = function() return (slot.animId or 0) > 0 and tostring(slot.animId) or "" end,
				set = function(text) slot.animId = Custom.parseSoundInput(text) end },
			{ label = "Spawn sound ID", x = 0.5, width = 0.5, placeholder = "0 = none",
				get = function() return (slot.soundId or 0) > 0 and tostring(slot.soundId) or "" end,
				set = function(text) slot.soundId = Custom.parseSoundInput(text) end },
		})

		addFieldsRow(extraFrame, {
			{ label = "Animation Changer code", x = 0, width = 0.5, placeholder = "paste animation SAVE code",
				get = function() return slot.animCode or "" end,
				set = function(text, box) slot.animCode = checkedCode(text, box, { "OSN1" }, "paste animation SAVE code", "not an animation code") end },
			{ label = "Sound Changer code", x = 0.5, width = 0.5, placeholder = "paste sound SAVE code",
				get = function() return slot.soundCode or "" end,
				set = function(text, box) slot.soundCode = checkedCode(text, box, { "OSS1", "OSS2" }, "paste sound SAVE code", "not a sound code") end },
		})

		addFieldsRow(extraFrame, {
			{ label = "Battler Sprites code (picture block)", x = 0, width = 1, placeholder = "paste sprite SAVE code",
				get = function() return slot.spriteCode or "" end,
				set = function(text, box) slot.spriteCode = checkedCode(text, box, { "OSB1" }, "paste sprite SAVE code", "not a sprite code") end },
		})

		-- on death
		local death = slot.death
		local deathHeader = addGrayRow(extraFrame, "On death: summon this ID")
		local deathTeamButton, deathTeamImage = addIconButton(deathHeader, 8)
		local deathModeButton, deathModeImage = addIconButton(deathHeader, 44)
		-- the ID box IS the on/off: 0 or empty = nothing happens, an ID = that battler is summoned when this one dies
		local deathIdBox = make("TextBox", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 30),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			PlaceholderText = "ID",
			PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
			TextSize = 14,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = "",
			ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		}, deathHeader)
		outline(deathIdBox)
		local deathTitle = deathHeader:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if deathTitle then
			deathTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -160, 1, 0)
			deathTitle.TextSize = 12
		end
		local function refreshDeathHeader()
			death = slot.death
			death.enabled = death.id > 0
			deathIdBox.Text = death.id > 0 and tostring(death.id) or ""
			if death.ally then
				showIcon(deathTeamButton, deathTeamImage, icons.ally, "ALLY")
			else
				showIcon(deathTeamButton, deathTeamImage, icons.enemy, "FOE")
			end
			if death.mode == "tumored" then
				showIcon(deathModeButton, deathModeImage, icons.tumored, "TUM")
			else
				showIcon(deathModeButton, deathModeImage, icons.casual, "CAS")
			end
		end
		refreshDeathHeader()
		table.insert(extraRefresh, refreshDeathHeader)
		listen(deathIdBox.FocusLost, function()
			local number = tonumber(deathIdBox.Text)
			slot.death.id = (number and number > 0) and math.floor(number) or 0
			refreshDeathHeader()
		end)
		listen(deathTeamButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			slot.death.ally = not slot.death.ally
			refreshDeathHeader()
		end)
		listen(deathModeButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			slot.death.mode = slot.death.mode == "tumored" and "casual" or "tumored"
			refreshDeathHeader()
		end)

		addFieldsRow(extraFrame, {
			{ label = "Strength", x = 0, width = 0.3,
				get = function() return slot.death.strength and tostring(slot.death.strength) or "0" end,
				set = function(text)
					local number = tonumber(text)
					slot.death.strength = (number and number > 0) and number or nil
				end },
			{ label = "Outfit code", x = 0.3, width = 0.7, left = true, textSize = 11, placeholder = "paste outfit code",
				get = function() return slot.death.outfit end,
				set = function(text, box) slot.death.outfit = checkedOutfit(text, box) end },
		})

		addFieldsRow(extraFrame, {
			{ label = "Spawn animation ID", x = 0, width = 0.5, placeholder = "0 = none",
				get = function() return (slot.death.animId or 0) > 0 and tostring(slot.death.animId) or "" end,
				set = function(text) slot.death.animId = Custom.parseSoundInput(text) end },
			{ label = "Spawn sound ID", x = 0.5, width = 0.5, placeholder = "0 = none",
				get = function() return (slot.death.soundId or 0) > 0 and tostring(slot.death.soundId) or "" end,
				set = function(text) slot.death.soundId = Custom.parseSoundInput(text) end },
		})

		addFieldsRow(extraFrame, {
			{ label = "Animation Changer code", x = 0, width = 0.5, placeholder = "paste animation SAVE code",
				get = function() return slot.death.animCode or "" end,
				set = function(text, box) slot.death.animCode = checkedCode(text, box, { "OSN1" }, "paste animation SAVE code", "not an animation code") end },
			{ label = "Sound Changer code", x = 0.5, width = 0.5, placeholder = "paste sound SAVE code",
				get = function() return slot.death.soundCode or "" end,
				set = function(text, box) slot.death.soundCode = checkedCode(text, box, { "OSS1", "OSS2" }, "paste sound SAVE code", "not a sound code") end },
		})

		addFieldsRow(extraFrame, {
			{ label = "Battler Sprites code (picture block)", x = 0, width = 1, placeholder = "paste sprite SAVE code",
				get = function() return slot.death.spriteCode or "" end,
				set = function(text, box) slot.death.spriteCode = checkedCode(text, box, { "OSB1" }, "paste sprite SAVE code", "not a sprite code") end },
		})

		local deathStatsRow = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56),
			BackgroundColor3 = GRAY,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
		}, extraFrame)
		outline(deathStatsRow)
		local deathStatBoxes = {}
		for index, stat in ipairs(Custom.STATS) do
			local column = make("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1 / #Custom.STATS, 0, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new((index - 1) / #Custom.STATS, 0, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			}, deathStatsRow)
			local asset = statIcons[stat.id]
			if asset then
				make("ImageLabel", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
					Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 3),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
					Image = asset,
				}, column)
			else
				make("TextLabel", {
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Text = stat.letter,
					TextColor3 = BLACK,
					TextSize = 11,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				}, column)
			end
			local statBox = make("TextBox", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 24),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 27),
				BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
				TextColor3 = BLACK,
				PlaceholderText = "-",
				PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY,
				TextSize = 13,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				Text = slot.death.stats[stat.id] and tostring(slot.death.stats[stat.id]) or "",
				ClearTextOnFocus = false,
			}, column)
			outline(statBox)
			deathStatBoxes[stat.id] = statBox
			listen(statBox.FocusLost, function()
				local number = tonumber(statBox.Text)
				slot.death.stats[stat.id] = number
				statBox.Text = number and tostring(number) or ""
			end)
		end
		table.insert(extraRefresh, function()
			for statId, box in deathStatBoxes do
				box.Text = slot.death.stats[statId] ~= nil and tostring(slot.death.stats[statId]) or ""
			end
		end)

		-- used by Load to redraw everything in this slot
		slot.refreshUI = function()
			for _, refreshExtra in ipairs(extraRefresh) do
				refreshExtra()
			end
			refreshTitle()
			refreshTeam()
			refreshMode()
			refreshSwitch()
			for key, box in fieldBoxes do
				box.Text = valueText(slot, key)
			end
			for statId, box in statBoxes do
				box.Text = slot.stats[statId] ~= nil and tostring(slot.stats[statId]) or ""
			end
		end
	end

	local container = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, page)
	make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, container)

	local header = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		LayoutOrder = 1,
	}, container)
	outline(header, 3)

	local nameButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 1, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "Custom Spawner",
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		TextSize = 18,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	}, header)
	make("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10) }, nameButton)

	local function refreshHeader()
		header.BackgroundColor3 = Custom.on and ON_COLOR or WHITE
	end
	listen(nameButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		Custom.setEnabled(not Custom.on)
		refreshHeader()
	end)

	local drawer = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Visible = false,
		LayoutOrder = 2,
	}, container)
	make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, drawer)

	-- Save / Load
	local saveRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Save / Load setup")
	local function makeSmallButton(text, offset)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 24),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, saveRow)
		outline(button)
		return button
	end
	local loadButton = makeSmallButton("LOAD", 8)
	local saveButton = makeSmallButton("SAVE", 68)

	local codeRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Code")
	local codeBox = make("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		PlaceholderText = "save to get a code / paste one here",
		PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY,
		Text = "",
		TextSize = 12,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		Font = Enum.Font.Code,
	}, codeRow)
	outline(codeBox)

	local saveStatus = make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "",
		TextColor3 = WHITE,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, drawer)

	listen(saveButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		local code = Custom.serialize()
		codeBox.Text = code
		local copied = false
		copied = Custom.copy(code)
		saveStatus.Text = copied and "Saved! The code is in the box and copied to your clipboard." or "Saved! Copy the code from the box (tap it, select all, copy)."
	end)

	listen(loadButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		local ok, reason = Custom.deserialize(codeBox.Text)
		saveStatus.Text = ok and "Loaded!" or ("Could not load: " .. tostring(reason))
	end)

	addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, "Outfits: remove old accessories first"), function()
		return Custom.slotOutfitReplace
	end, function(value)
		Custom.slotOutfitReplace = value
	end)

	local detectRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Stat names: default guesses")
	local detectButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		Text = "DETECT",
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		TextSize = 12,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	}, detectRow)
	outline(detectButton)
	local detectLabel = detectRow:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	listen(detectButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		local found = Custom.refreshStatKeys()
		if detectLabel then
			detectLabel.Text = found and "Stat names: read from game menu" or "Stat names: not found, using guesses"
		end
		if found then
			local parts = {}
			for _, stat in ipairs(Custom.STATS) do
				table.insert(parts, stat.id .. "=" .. tostring(Custom.statKeys[stat.id]))
			end
			print("Oscars Cool Panel stat names: " .. table.concat(parts, ", "))
		end
	end)

	addSlotBlock(drawer, Custom.boss, "Boss Slot", { "id", "timer", "strength" })
	for index, slot in ipairs(Custom.units) do
		addSlotBlock(drawer, slot, "Unit Slot " .. index, { "id", "limit", "timer", "strength" })
	end

	local chevron = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = ">",
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		TextSize = 24,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	}, header)
	listen(chevron.MouseButton1Click, function()
		drawer.Visible = not drawer.Visible
		chevron.Text = drawer.Visible and "v" or ">"
	end)
end
-- Rename Stage + Puzzles (Misc tab)
-- Rename Stage: keeps the stage name on the battle screen on whatever you type.
-- Puzzles: spawn cycle made by Delifell ("you have to solve my puzzles one to get in ULTRA").
safeBuild("Rename Stage / Puzzles", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]

	-- ===== Rename Stage =====
	local rename = { on = false, name = "Da fac", token = 0 }
	Custom.rename = rename

	local function stopRename()
		rename.on = false
		rename.token += 1
	end

	local function startRename()
		stopRename()
		rename.on = true
		local token = rename.token
		task.spawn(function()
			while rename.on and rename.token == token and not destroyed do
				local battleScreen = playerGui:FindFirstChild("BattleScreen")
				local stageName = battleScreen and battleScreen:FindFirstChild("StageName")
				if stageName and stageName.Text ~= rename.name then
					pcall(function()
						stageName.Text = rename.name
					end)
				end
				task.wait()
			end
		end)
	end
	Custom.renameStop = stopRename

	local renameDrawer = addToggleCogRow(page, "Rename Stage", function()
		return rename.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then
			startRename()
		else
			stopRename()
		end
	end)

	local nameRow = addGrayRow(renameDrawer, "Stage name")
	local nameBox = make("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		TextSize = 14,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		Text = rename.name,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
	}, nameRow)
	outline(nameBox)
	listen(nameBox.FocusLost, function()
		rename.name = nameBox.Text
	end)

	-- ===== Puzzles (by Delifell) =====
	local puzzle = { on = false, form = "A", magnification = 11.1, spawnRate = 1, limit = 3, token = 0, cycle = nil }
	Custom.puzzle = puzzle

	local npcRoot = Workspace:WaitForChild("NPCFolders", 10)
	local friendlyFolder = npcRoot and npcRoot:FindFirstChild("FriendlyFolder")
	local baseFolder = npcRoot and npcRoot:FindFirstChild("BaseFolder")
	local settingsRemote = SandboxSettings
	local spawnRemote = SandboxSpawn

	local function countAlive(names, skipNoClog)
		local count = 0
		if not friendlyFolder then return 0 end
		for _, unit in friendlyFolder:GetChildren() do
			if (not names or names[unit.Name]) and not unit:GetAttribute("ConfusedTime")
				and not (skipNoClog and unit:GetAttribute("NoClog")) then
				local humanoid = unit:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
					count += 1
				end
			end
		end
		return count
	end

	local BALLERS = { ["Baller Battler"] = true, ["Soccer Battler"] = true }

	local function spawnLimited(entry, token)
		while puzzle.on and puzzle.token == token and countAlive(nil, true) >= puzzle.limit do
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		if puzzle.on and puzzle.token == token then
			pcall(function()
				spawnRemote:InvokeServer(table.unpack(entry))
			end)
		end
	end

	local function runCycle(token)
		local mag, form = puzzle.magnification, puzzle.form
		local boss = { "Enemy", 5, form, mag }
		local enemy1 = { "Enemy", 12, form, mag }
		local enemy2 = { "Enemy", 5, form, mag }
		local enemy3 = { "Enemy", 121, "B", mag, { Health = 1000000, Damage = 1000000, WalkSpeed = 50, AttackRate = 0 } }
		local enemy4 = { "Enemy", 44, form, mag }
		local rate = puzzle.spawnRate

		local function alive()
			return puzzle.on and puzzle.token == token
		end
		local function ballerCheck()
			if countAlive(BALLERS) < 1 then
				task.wait(999 / rate)
				if alive() and countAlive(BALLERS) < 1 then
					spawnLimited(enemy2, token)
				end
			end
		end

		spawnLimited(boss, token)
		while alive() do
			for _ = 1, 3 do
				task.wait(1 / rate)
				if not alive() then return end
				spawnLimited(enemy1, token)
			end
			ballerCheck()
			for _ = 1, 16 do
				task.wait(0.1 / rate)
				if not alive() then return end
				spawnLimited(enemy3, token)
			end
			task.wait(0.1 / rate)
			if not alive() then return end
			spawnLimited(enemy4, token)
			ballerCheck()
		end
	end

	local function stopPuzzle()
		puzzle.on = false
		puzzle.token += 1
		if puzzle.cycle then
			pcall(task.cancel, puzzle.cycle)
			puzzle.cycle = nil
		end
	end

	local function sandboxBase()
		local base = baseFolder and baseFolder:FindFirstChild("Blue Base")
		return base and base:GetAttribute("Sandbox") and base or nil
	end

	local function startPuzzle()
		stopPuzzle()
		puzzle.on = true
		local token = puzzle.token
		-- starts when the sandbox base exists (like the original script), restarts if you leave and come back
		task.spawn(function()
			local running = false
			while puzzle.on and puzzle.token == token and not destroyed do
				local base = sandboxBase()
				if base and not running then
					running = true
					pcall(function()
						settingsRemote:InvokeServer("SpawnTeamsSwap", true)
						Custom.applyHealthBars(settingsRemote)
					end)
					puzzle.cycle = task.spawn(runCycle, token)
				elseif not base and running then
					running = false
					if puzzle.cycle then
						pcall(task.cancel, puzzle.cycle)
						puzzle.cycle = nil
					end
				end
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end)
	end
	Custom.puzzleStop = stopPuzzle

	local puzzleDrawer = addToggleCogRow(page, "Puzzles (Delifell)", function()
		return puzzle.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then
			startPuzzle()
		else
			stopPuzzle()
		end
	end)

	local formRow = addGrayRow(puzzleDrawer, "Form (A / B)")
	local formButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		TextSize = 14,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		Text = puzzle.form,
	}, formRow)
	outline(formButton)
	listen(formButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		puzzle.form = puzzle.form == "A" and "B" or "A"
		formButton.Text = puzzle.form
	end)

	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(puzzleDrawer, "Magnification"), tostring(puzzle.magnification), function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		puzzle.magnification = (number and number > 0) and number or 11.1
		box.Text = tostring(puzzle.magnification)
	end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(puzzleDrawer, "Spawn rate"), tostring(puzzle.spawnRate), function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		puzzle.spawnRate = (number and number > 0) and number or 1
		box.Text = tostring(puzzle.spawnRate)
	end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(puzzleDrawer, "Unit limit"), tostring(puzzle.limit), function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		puzzle.limit = (number and number >= 1) and math.floor(number) or 3
		box.Text = tostring(puzzle.limit)
	end)

	make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "Credits: made by Delifell",
		TextColor3 = WHITE,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, puzzleDrawer)
end)

safeBuild("Custom Spawner", Custom.buildUI)

-- Spawn Battler (Misc tab): spawns ONE battler on demand with its own settings, using the same tools as the rest
-- of the panel: the Custom Spawner's stat overrides + outfit codes, the Avatar Applier (its settings, rules and stored
-- accessories), and an optional entrance (own animation, come VFX, pausing everybody else) that can run BEFORE the
-- avatar / accessories go on.
safeBuild("Spawn Battler", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

	local Battler = {
		id = 1,
		mode = "casual",
		ally = false,
		strength = nil,
		stats = {},
		useAvatar = true,        -- the Avatar Applier (avatar, shirt, face, body colours, rules ...) also dresses this battler
		useStore = false,        -- put the Avatar Applier's stored accessories (Accessory Paster list) on it
		outfit = "",             -- or an Accessory Paster SAVE code
		meshIndex = 0,           -- a Mesh Changer setting (its number in the list) for this battler only
		meshCode = "",           -- or a pasted Mesh Changer code (its first setting)
		entrance = false,
		entranceFirst = true,    -- entrance first, THEN the avatar / accessories
		animId = 0,
		animLoop = false,
		duration = 3,            -- seconds (0 = the animation's length)
		fadeIn = true,
		pauseOthers = true,
		vfx = true,
		sfxId = 0,
		busy = false,
	}
	Custom.battler = Battler

	local statusLabel

	local function setStatus(text)
		if statusLabel then statusLabel.Text = text end
	end

	local function folderList()
		local list = {}
		for _, name in ipairs({ "FriendlyFolder", "EnemyFolder" }) do
			local folder = npcFolder(name)
			if folder then table.insert(list, folder) end
		end
		return list
	end

	-- local fade (only you see it): 1 = invisible, 0 = normal
	local function setFade(unit, amount)
		for _, object in ipairs(unit:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("BasePart") then
				pcall(function() object.LocalTransparencyModifier = amount end)
			end
		end
	end

	local function loadTrack(unit, id)
		local humanoid = unit:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or id <= 0 then return nil end
		local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 2)
		if not animator then return nil end
		local track = Custom.loadAnimTrack(animator, id) -- also IDs from other games
		if not track then return nil end
		pcall(function() track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4 end) -- above idle / walk, so it replaces the idle you see
		return track
	end

	-- pauses every OTHER battler on your screen (animations frozen, bodies held in place) until the returned function is called
	local function startFreeze(except)
		local savedSpeed = {}
		local held = {}
		local active = true
		local function sweep()
			for _, folder in ipairs(folderList()) do
				for _, other in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
					if other ~= except and other:IsA("Model") then
						local humanoid = other:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
						if animator then
							for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
								if savedSpeed[track] == nil then savedSpeed[track] = track.Speed end
								pcall(function() track:AdjustSpeed(0) end)
							end
						end
						local root = other:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and not root.Anchored and not held[root] then
							held[root] = true
							pcall(function() root.Anchored = true end)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		sweep()
		task.spawn(function()
			while active and not destroyed do
				task.wait(0.1)
				if active then pcall(sweep) end
			end
		end)
		return function()
			active = false
			for track, speed in pairs(savedSpeed) do
				pcall(function() track:AdjustSpeed(speed) end)
			end
			for root in pairs(held) do
				pcall(function() root.Anchored = false end)
			end
		end
	end

	-- "come" effect: sparkle burst, light flash and an expanding ring (+ an optional sound), only you see it
	local function playVfx(unit, ally, soundId)
		local root = unit:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or unit.PrimaryPart or unit:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
		if not root then return end
		local position = root.Position
		local color = ally and Color3.fromRGB(90, 160, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
		local anchor = make("Part", {
			Name = "OscarsEntranceFx", Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false,
			Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Position = position,
		}, Workspace)
		local emitter = make("ParticleEmitter", {
			Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds",
			Color = ColorSequence.new(color, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 26),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
			Rate = 0,
			Drag = 3,
			LightEmission = 1,
			Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
		}, anchor)
		emitter:Emit(60)
		local light = make("PointLight", { Color = color, Brightness = 8, Range = 24 }, anchor)
		TweenService:Create(light, TweenInfo.new(0.8), { Brightness = 0 }):Play()
		local ring = make("Part", {
			Name = "OscarsEntranceRing", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false,
			CanTouch = false, CastShadow = false, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = color, Transparency = 0.35,
			Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Position = position,
		}, Workspace)
		TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = Vector3.new(18, 18, 18), Transparency = 1,
		}):Play()
		Debris:AddItem(ring, 1)
		if soundId and soundId > 0 then
			local sound = make("Sound", {
				SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(soundId), Volume = 1, RollOffMaxDistance = 300,
			}, anchor)
			sound:Play()
			Debris:AddItem(anchor, 8)
		else
			Debris:AddItem(anchor, 2.5)
		end
	end

	local function runEntrance(unit, ally)
		local stopFreeze = Battler.pauseOthers and startFreeze(unit) or nil
		local track = nil
		if Battler.animId > 0 then
			track = loadTrack(unit, Battler.animId)
			if track then
				pcall(function() track.Looped = Battler.animLoop end)
				pcall(function() track:Play(0.1, 1, 1) end)
			else
				setStatus("The entrance animation could not be loaded (wrong ID?). Continuing without it.")
			end
		end
		if Battler.vfx then
			pcall(playVfx, unit, ally, Battler.sfxId)
		end
		local duration = Battler.duration
		if duration <= 0 then
			local length = 0
			if track then pcall(function() length = track.Length end) end
			duration = length > 0 and length or 1.5
		end
		if Battler.fadeIn then
			task.spawn(function()
				local startTime = os.clock()
				local fadeTime = math.min(duration, 1)
				while os.clock() - startTime < fadeTime and unit.Parent and not destroyed do
					setFade(unit, 1 - (os.clock() - startTime) / fadeTime)
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end
				if unit.Parent then setFade(unit, 0) end
			end)
		end
		task.wait(duration)
		if track then
			pcall(function() track:Stop(0.2) end)
		end
		if stopFreeze then stopFreeze() end
		if unit.Parent then setFade(unit, 0) end
	end

	-- accessories for this battler: an outfit code and / or whatever the Avatar Applier has stored for its kind of unit
	local function outfitFor(unit, ally)
		local list = {}
		if Battler.outfit ~= "" then
			local parsed = Custom.parseOutfit(Battler.outfit)
			if parsed then
				for _, entry in ipairs(parsed) do table.insert(list, entry) end
			else
				setStatus("The outfit code is not valid, so it was skipped.")
			end
		end
		if Battler.useStore then
			local unitId = tonumber(unit:GetAttribute("ID")) or Battler.id
			for _, entry in ipairs(Custom.accStore) do
				local sideOk = entry.team == 2 or ((entry.team == 1) == ally)
				local unitOk = entry.unitId == 0 or entry.unitId == unitId
				if sideOk and unitOk then
					table.insert(list, { id = entry.id, bundle = entry.bundle })
				end
			end
		end
		return list
	end

	local function releaseHeld(ourUnit, skipOurs)
		for held in pairs(Avatar.held) do
			Avatar.release(held, skipOurs and held == ourUnit)
		end
	end

	local function spawnBattler()
		if Battler.busy then
			setStatus("Already spawning, wait a moment.")
			return
		end
		if Battler.id <= 0 then
			setStatus("Type a battler ID first.")
			return
		end
		if not (getRefs() and checkBasesValid()) then
			setStatus("Open a stage / the sandbox first.")
			return
		end
		Battler.busy = true
		setStatus("Spawning ...")
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local slot = Custom.newSlot(false)
				slot.id = Battler.id
				slot.mode = Battler.mode
				slot.ally = Battler.ally
				slot.strength = Battler.strength
				slot.limit = 0
				slot.timer = 0
				slot.outfit = "" -- the outfit goes on below, after the entrance if you picked that
				for key, value in pairs(Battler.stats) do slot.stats[key] = value end

				local useEntrance = Battler.entrance
				local holdAvatar = (useEntrance and Battler.entranceFirst) or not Battler.useAvatar
				local early, listeners = {}, {}
				for _, folder in ipairs(folderList()) do
					table.insert(listeners, folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(unit)
						table.insert(early, unit)
						if useEntrance and Battler.fadeIn then
							task.defer(setFade, unit, 1) -- hidden from the very first frame, the entrance fades it in
						end
					end))
				end
				if holdAvatar then Avatar.holdNew = true end
				local called, spawned = pcall(Custom.spawn, slot)
				Avatar.holdNew = false
				for _, listener in ipairs(listeners) do listener:Disconnect() end

				local unit
				for tracked in pairs(slot.tracked) do
					unit = tracked
					break
				end
				for _, other in ipairs(early) do
					if other ~= unit and other.Parent then setFade(other, 0) end
				end
				if not (called and spawned and unit and unit.Parent) then
					releaseHeld(nil, false)
					setStatus("Could not spawn ID " .. tostring(Battler.id) .. ". Is the sandbox open and the ID right?")
					return
				end

				local ally = unit.Parent == npcFolder("FriendlyFolder")
				if useEntrance then
					setStatus("Entrance ...")
					runEntrance(unit, ally)
				end
				releaseHeld(unit, not Battler.useAvatar)

				local list = outfitFor(unit, ally)
				if #list > 0 and Avatar.applyToUnit then
					-- when the Avatar Applier dresses it too, the old accessories are not wiped (that would take its own away)
					pcall(Avatar.applyToUnit, unit, list, (not Battler.useAvatar) and Custom.slotOutfitReplace)
				end
				-- its own mesh setting (a number from the Mesh Changer list, or a pasted Mesh Changer code)
				local meshEntry, meshNote
				if Battler.meshCode ~= "" and Custom.meshParse then
					local parsed, listed = Custom.meshParse(Battler.meshCode)
					if parsed and listed[1] then meshEntry = listed[1] else meshNote = " (the mesh code could not be read)" end
				elseif Battler.meshIndex > 0 and Custom.meshEntryNumber then
					meshEntry = Custom.meshEntryNumber(Battler.meshIndex)
					if not meshEntry then meshNote = " (there is no mesh setting number " .. tostring(Battler.meshIndex) .. ")" end
				end
				if meshEntry and Custom.meshForce then
					pcall(Custom.meshForce, unit, meshEntry)
					meshNote = " and its mesh setting"
				end
				setStatus("Battler " .. tostring(Battler.id) .. " spawned" .. (#list > 0 and (" with " .. tostring(#list) .. " accessory item(s)") or "") .. (meshNote or "") .. ".")
			end)
			Avatar.holdNew = false
			if not ok then
				releaseHeld(nil, false)
				warn("Oscars Cool Panel: Spawn Battler error: " .. tostring(err))
				setStatus("Something went wrong while spawning (see the output).")
			end
			Battler.busy = false
		end)
	end
	Custom.spawnBattler = spawnBattler

	-- ===== UI =====
	local container = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, page)
	make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, container)

	local header = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		LayoutOrder = 1,
	}, container)
	outline(header, 3)
	local nameButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 1, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "Spawn Battler",
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		TextSize = 18,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	}, header)
	make("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10) }, nameButton)

	local drawer = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Visible = false,
		LayoutOrder = 2,
	}, container)
	make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, drawer)

	local function addSection(text)
		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = WHITE,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
		}, drawer)
	end

	local function shrinkLabel(row, rightSpace)
		local label = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if label then label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -rightSpace, 1, 0) end
	end

	local function addTextRow(text, placeholder, width, onCommit)
		local row = addGrayRow(drawer, text)
		shrinkLabel(row, width + 24)
		local box = make("TextBox", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 24),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			PlaceholderText = placeholder,
			PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY,
			Text = "",
			TextSize = 14,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		}, row)
		outline(box)
		listen(box.FocusLost, function() onCommit(box) end)
		return box
	end

	local function addCycleRow(text, getText, onClick)
		local row = addGrayRow(drawer, text)
		shrinkLabel(row, 130)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 24),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = getText(),
		}, row)
		outline(button)
		listen(button.MouseButton1Click, function()
			onClick()
			button.Text = getText()
		end)
		return button
	end

	local function addSwitchRow(text, get, set)
		local row = addGrayRow(drawer, text)
		addSwitch(row, get, set)
		return row
	end

	local function numberOrNil(box, allowZero)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		if number and (number > 0 or (allowZero and number == 0)) then
			return number
		end
		box.Text = ""
		return nil
	end

	-- spawn button + status
	local spawnRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Spawn this battler now")
	shrinkLabel(spawnRow, 110)
	local spawnButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 26),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = ON_COLOR,
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		TextSize = 13,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		Text = "SPAWN",
	}, spawnRow)
	outline(spawnButton)
	listen(spawnButton.MouseButton1Click, spawnBattler)

	statusLabel = make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "Set it up below, then press SPAWN.",
		TextColor3 = WHITE,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, drawer)

	addSection("Battler")
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Battler ID (1 = Battler)"), "1", function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		Battler.id = (number and number > 0) and math.floor(number) or 1
		box.Text = tostring(Battler.id)
	end)
	addCycleRow("Form", function()
		return Battler.mode == "tumored" and "Tumored" or "Casual"
	end, function()
		Battler.mode = Battler.mode == "casual" and "tumored" or "casual"
	end)
	addCycleRow("Team", function()
		return Battler.ally and "Ally (blue)" or "Enemy (red)"
	end, function()
		Battler.ally = not Battler.ally
	end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Strength (blank = default)"), "", function(box)
		Battler.strength = numberOrNil(box, false)
	end)

	addSection("Stats (blank = game default)")
	for _, stat in ipairs(Custom.STATS) do
		addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, stat.letter .. "  -  " .. stat.id), "", function(box)
			Battler.stats[stat.id] = numberOrNil(box, true)
		end)
	end

	addSection("Look")
	addSwitchRow("Avatar Applier dresses it too", function() return Battler.useAvatar end, function(value)
		Battler.useAvatar = value
	end)
	addSwitchRow("Put the Avatar Applier's stored accessories on it", function() return Battler.useStore end, function(value)
		Battler.useStore = value
	end)
	addTextRow("Outfit code (Accessory Paster SAVE)", "OSA1...", 120, function(box)
		Battler.outfit = string.gsub(box.Text, "%s", "")
	end)

	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Mesh Changer setting # (0 = none)"), "0", function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		Battler.meshIndex = (number and number > 0) and math.floor(number) or 0
		box.Text = tostring(Battler.meshIndex)
	end)
	addTextRow("or a Mesh Changer code (OSM1...)", "OSM1...", 120, function(box)
		Battler.meshCode = string.gsub(box.Text, "%s", "")
	end)

	addSection("Entrance")
	addSwitchRow("Entrance on", function() return Battler.entrance end, function(value)
		Battler.entrance = value
	end)
	addSwitchRow("Entrance first, avatar / accessories after", function() return Battler.entranceFirst end, function(value)
		Battler.entranceFirst = value
	end)
	addTextRow("Entrance animation ID (blank = none)", "animation ID", 110, function(box)
		local number = tonumber(string.match(box.Text, "%d+") or "")
		Battler.animId = number and math.floor(number) or 0
		if Battler.animId == 0 then box.Text = "" end
	end)
	addSwitchRow("Loop that animation", function() return Battler.animLoop end, function(value)
		Battler.animLoop = value
	end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Entrance length, seconds (0 = auto)"), "3", function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		Battler.duration = (number and number >= 0) and math.min(number, 30) or 3
		box.Text = tostring(Battler.duration)
	end)
	addSwitchRow("Fade in", function() return Battler.fadeIn end, function(value)
		Battler.fadeIn = value
	end)
	addSwitchRow("Pause the other battlers / enemies", function() return Battler.pauseOthers end, function(value)
		Battler.pauseOthers = value
	end)
	addSwitchRow("Come VFX (burst, flash, ring)", function() return Battler.vfx end, function(value)
		Battler.vfx = value
	end)
	addTextRow("Entrance sound ID (blank = none)", "sound ID", 110, function(box)
		local number = tonumber(string.match(box.Text, "%d+") or "")
		Battler.sfxId = number and math.floor(number) or 0
		if Battler.sfxId == 0 then box.Text = "" end
	end)


	local chevron = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = ">",
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		TextSize = 24,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	}, header)
	local function toggleDrawer()
		drawer.Visible = not drawer.Visible
		chevron.Text = drawer.Visible and "v" or ">"
	end
	listen(chevron.MouseButton1Click, toggleDrawer)
	listen(nameButton.MouseButton1Click, toggleDrawer)
end)

-- Randomizer (Misc tab): rolls a random battler ID between a low and a high number and spawns it
function Custom.buildRandomizer(fixedTeam, title, stopKey)
safeBuild(title, function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

	local R = {
		min = 1, max = 10,
		team = fixedTeam,        -- this roller only ever rolls for ONE team: "red" (enemy IDs) or "blue" (unit IDs)
		form = "casual",         -- "casual" | "tumored" | "random"
		rolls = 1,
		allowBoss = true, allowMini = true, allowRegular = true,
		keep = true,             -- true = keep what was rolled, false = auto delete it
		deleteAfter = 0,         -- seconds before an auto delete (0 = right away)
		strength = nil,
		randMag = false, magMin = 1, magMax = 5,   -- random strength (magnification) per roll
		randStats = false, statRanges = {},         -- random stats per roll: statRanges[statId] = { min, max }
		auto = false, autoEvery = 10,
		busy = false, token = 0,
	}
	Custom[stopKey == "randomizerBlueStop" and "randomizerBlue" or "randomizerRed"] = R

	local statusLabel
