		[150] = { "Roadbumper", "Speeddemon" },
		[151] = { "Dark Pelican", "Pancake Pelican Of Truth" },
	}
	-- IDs that are a stage boss in this panel's stages (so they can be skipped without spawning them first)
	local KNOWN_BOSS = {}
	for _, id in ipairs({ 14, 17, 13, 33, 37, 40, 72, 71, 61, 143, 122, 149, 137, 117, 110, 53, 26, 44, 129, 151, 82, 150, 108 }) do KNOWN_BOSS[id] = true end
	local function nameOf(id, tumored)
		local pair = NAMES[id]
		return pair and pair[tumored and 2 or 1] or ("ID " .. tostring(id))
	end
	local ALLY_MAX = 103 -- the highest unit (ally) ID that exists; enemy IDs go higher
	local skipIds = {}
	local miniIds = {} -- IDs typed in by hand that count as mini bosses (the game does not always mark them)

	-- what kind of unit is it: "boss", "mini" (mini boss) or "regular", judged from its tags / attributes / name
	local function classify(unit, id)
		local isBoss, isMini = false, false
		if id and miniIds[id] then isMini = true end
		local function look(text)
			local lowered = string.lower(tostring(text))
			if string.find(lowered, "boss", 1, true) then
				if string.find(lowered, "mini", 1, true) then isMini = true else isBoss = true end
			elseif string.find(lowered, "mini", 1, true) then
				isMini = true
			end
		end
		for _, tag in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(unit)) do look(tag) end
		for attribute, value in pairs(unit:GetAttributes()) do
			if value == true or type(value) == "string" then
				if type(value) == "string" then look(attribute .. value) else look(attribute) end
			end
		end
		look(unit.Name)
		-- a mini boss can also be marked by a child object / value / bar with "mini" in its name
		for _, object in ipairs(unit:GetDescendants()) do
			local lowered = string.lower(object.Name)
			if string.find(lowered, "mini", 1, true) and (string.find(lowered, "boss", 1, true) or object:IsA("ValueBase")) then
				isMini = true
				break
			end
		end
		if isMini then return "mini" end
		if isBoss then return "boss" end
		return "regular"
	end

	local function allowed(kind)
		if kind == "boss" then return R.allowBoss end
		if kind == "mini" then return R.allowMini end
		return R.allowRegular
	end

	-- takes a rolled unit away: the game is asked first (health to 0); if it stays, it is at least hidden for you
	local function removeUnit(unit)
		if not unit or not unit.Parent then return end
		local humanoid = unit:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then pcall(function() humanoid.Health = 0 end) end
		task.delay(0.6, function()
			if unit.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				for _, object in ipairs(unit:GetDescendants()) do
					if object:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end) end
				end
				pcall(function() unit:Destroy() end)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function unitsOf(slot)
		local list = {}
		for unit in pairs(slot.tracked) do
			if unit.Parent then list[#list + 1] = unit end
		end
		return list
	end

	-- does the unit stand on the side that was asked for? (blue = FriendlyFolder, red = EnemyFolder)
	local function onWantedTeam(unit, wantAlly)
		local folder = unit.Parent
		return folder ~= nil and folder.Name == (wantAlly and "FriendlyFolder" or "EnemyFolder")
	end

	local function rollOne()
		local lo, hi = math.floor(math.min(R.min, R.max)), math.floor(math.max(R.min, R.max))
		local baseSwap = SwitchTeamsAtStart and true or false
		for _ = 1, 30 do
			-- team first: blue rolls use unit (ally) IDs, which only go up to ALLY_MAX; red rolls use enemy IDs
			local wantAlly = (R.team == "blue") or (R.team == "both" and lo <= ALLY_MAX and math.random(2) == 1)
			local top = wantAlly and math.min(hi, ALLY_MAX) or hi
			if top < lo then return false end -- the range has no ally IDs at all
			local id = math.random(lo, top)
			if skipIds[id] or (KNOWN_BOSS[id] and not R.allowBoss) or (miniIds[id] and not R.allowMini) then continue end -- not even spawned
			local slot = Custom.newSlot(false)
			slot.id = id
			slot.ally = wantAlly
			slot.strictTeam = true -- never fall back to "enemy ID with swapped teams"
			slot.mode = (R.form == "random") and (math.random(2) == 1 and "tumored" or "casual") or R.form
			slot.strength = R.strength
			if R.randMag then
				local low, high = math.min(R.magMin, R.magMax), math.max(R.magMin, R.magMax)
				slot.strength = math.floor((low + math.random() * (high - low)) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
			end
			if R.randStats then
				for statId, range in pairs(R.statRanges) do
					local low, high = math.min(range[1], range[2]), math.max(range[1], range[2])
					slot.stats[statId] = math.floor((low + math.random() * (high - low)) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
				end
			end
			if Custom.spawn(slot) then
				task.wait(0.4) -- the game tags bosses / mini bosses a moment after they appear

				-- A unit on the wrong team is never "fixed" by flipping the game's team swap on and off: that flips the OTHER
				-- units too (they end up on both teams). It is simply removed and a new one is rolled.
				-- (Skipped when "Switch Teams at Start" is on: then the sides are swapped on purpose.)
				local kept = unitsOf(slot)
				local rejected = #kept == 0
				for _, unit in ipairs(kept) do
					if (not baseSwap and not onWantedTeam(unit, slot.ally)) or not allowed(classify(unit, id)) then rejected = true end
				end
				if rejected then
					for _, unit in ipairs(kept) do removeUnit(unit) end
					task.wait(0.3)
				else
					return true, id, slot, kept
				end
			else
				task.wait(0.2) -- that ID does not exist (or the sandbox is closed): roll again
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function rollAll()
		if R.busy then return end
		if not (R.allowBoss or R.allowMini or R.allowRegular) then
			setStatus("Allow at least one kind (regular / mini boss / boss) first.")
			return
		end
		R.busy = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local results, failed = {}, 0
			for index = 1, math.clamp(math.floor(R.rolls), 1, 50) do
				if destroyed then break end
				setStatus("Rolling " .. tostring(index) .. " / " .. tostring(R.rolls) .. " ...")
				local ok, id, slot, units = rollOne()
				if ok then
					results[#results + 1] = tostring(id) .. " " .. nameOf(id, slot.mode == "tumored") .. (slot.ally and " (blue)" or " (red)") .. (R.randMag and slot.strength and (" x" .. tostring(slot.strength)) or "")
					if not R.keep then
						task.delay(math.max(R.deleteAfter, 0), function()
							for _, unit in ipairs(units) do removeUnit(unit) end
						end)
					end
				else
					failed += 1
				end
				task.wait(0.15)
			end
			local text = "Rolled: " .. (#results > 0 and table.concat(results, ", ") or "nothing")
			if failed > 0 then text ..= "  -  " .. tostring(failed) .. " roll(s) could not spawn (is the sandbox open? blue rolls only use unit IDs up to 103)" end
			text ..= R.keep and "  -  kept." or "  -  auto deleted."
			setStatus(text)
			R.busy = false
		end)
	end

	local function stopAuto()
		R.auto = false
		R.token += 1
	end
	local function startAuto()
		R.auto = true
		R.token += 1
		local token = R.token
		task.spawn(function()
			while R.auto and R.token == token and not destroyed do
				rollAll()
				task.wait(math.max(R.autoEvery, 1))
			end
		end)
	end
	Custom[stopKey] = stopAuto

	-- ===== UI =====
	local container = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, page)
	make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, container)
	local header = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, LayoutOrder = 1 }, container)
	outline(header, 3)
	local nameButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = title, TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 18,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	}, header)
	make("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10) }, nameButton)
	local drawer = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, LayoutOrder = 2,
	}, container)
	make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, drawer)

	local function shrinkLabel(row, rightSpace)
		local label = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if label then label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -rightSpace, 1, 0) end
	end
	local function addCycleRow(text, getText, onClick)
		local row = addGrayRow(drawer, text)
		shrinkLabel(row, 130)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = getText(),
		}, row)
		outline(button)
		listen(button.MouseButton1Click, function()
			onClick()
			button.Text = getText()
		end)
	end
	local function addSwitchRow(text, get, set)
		addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, text), get, set)
	end
	local function intBox(text, key, low, high)
		addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, text), tostring(R[key]), function(box)
			local number = tonumber(box.Text)
			R[key] = number and math.clamp(math.floor(number), low, high) or R[key]
			box.Text = tostring(R[key])
		end)
	end

	local rollRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Roll now")
	shrinkLabel(rollRow, 110)
	local rollButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 26), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = ON_COLOR, TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = "ROLL",
	}, rollRow)
	outline(rollButton)
	listen(rollButton.MouseButton1Click, rollAll)
	statusLabel = make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "",
		TextColor3 = WHITE, TextSize = 11, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, drawer)

	intBox("Lowest ID", "min", 1, 100000)
	intBox("Highest ID", "max", 1, 100000)
	intBox("Number of rolls", "rolls", 1, 50)
	local skipRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "IDs to never roll (e.g. 72, 71)")
	shrinkLabel(skipRow, 150)
	local skipBox = make("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, TextColor3 = BLACK, PlaceholderText = "72, 71", PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY, Text = "",
		TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ClearTextOnFocus = false,
	}, skipRow)
	outline(skipBox)
	listen(skipBox.FocusLost, function()
		table.clear(skipIds)
		for number in string.gmatch(skipBox.Text, "%d+") do skipIds[tonumber(number)] = true end
	end)
	local FORMS = { casual = "Normal", tumored = "Tumored", random = "Random" }
	addCycleRow("Form", function() return FORMS[R.form] end, function()
		R.form = R.form == "casual" and "tumored" or (R.form == "tumored" and "random" or "casual")
	end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Strength (blank = default)"), "", function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		R.strength = (number and number > 0) and number or nil
		if not R.strength then box.Text = "" end
	end)
	-- random strength (magnification): every roll picks its own number between min and max
	addSwitchRow("Random strength (mag) per roll", function() return R.randMag end, function(v) R.randMag = v end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Random strength: lowest"), tostring(R.magMin), function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		R.magMin = (number and number > 0) and number or R.magMin
		box.Text = tostring(R.magMin)
	end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Random strength: highest"), tostring(R.magMax), function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		R.magMax = (number and number > 0) and number or R.magMax
		box.Text = tostring(R.magMax)
	end)
	-- random stats: every roll picks a number inside the range typed for each stat (blank = that stat stays default)
	addSwitchRow("Random stats per roll", function() return R.randStats end, function(v) R.randStats = v end)
	for _, stat in ipairs(Custom.STATS) do
		local statRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Range " .. stat.letter .. " (e.g. 50-500)")
		local statBox = make("TextBox", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 26), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, TextColor3 = BLACK, PlaceholderText = "min-max", PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY, Text = "",
			TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		}, statRow)
		outline(statBox)
		listen(statBox.FocusLost, function()
			local numbers = {}
			for number in string.gmatch(statBox.Text, "%d+%.?%d*") do numbers[#numbers + 1] = tonumber(number) end
			if #numbers >= 2 then
				R.statRanges[stat.id] = { numbers[1], numbers[2] }
			elseif #numbers == 1 then
				R.statRanges[stat.id] = { numbers[1], numbers[1] }
			else
				R.statRanges[stat.id] = nil
			end
		end)
	end
	addSwitchRow("Allow regular units / enemies", function() return R.allowRegular end, function(v) R.allowRegular = v end)
	addSwitchRow("Allow mini bosses", function() return R.allowMini end, function(v) R.allowMini = v end)
	-- the game does not always mark mini bosses in a way the panel can see: list their IDs here (comma separated)
	local miniRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Mini boss IDs (e.g. 39, 40)")
	local miniBox = make("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 26), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, TextColor3 = BLACK, PlaceholderText = "ids", PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY, Text = "",
		TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ClearTextOnFocus = false,
	}, miniRow)
	outline(miniBox)
	listen(miniBox.FocusLost, function()
		table.clear(miniIds)
		for number in string.gmatch(miniBox.Text, "%d+") do miniIds[tonumber(number)] = true end
	end)
	addSwitchRow("Allow bosses", function() return R.allowBoss end, function(v) R.allowBoss = v end)
	addCycleRow("After rolling", function() return R.keep and "Keep them" or "Auto delete" end, function() R.keep = not R.keep end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Auto delete after (seconds, 0 = at once)"), "0", function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		R.deleteAfter = number and math.clamp(number, 0, 600) or 0
		box.Text = tostring(R.deleteAfter)
	end)
	addSwitchRow("Auto roll again and again", function() return R.auto end, function(v)
		if v then startAuto() else stopAuto() end
	end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Auto roll every (seconds)"), tostring(R.autoEvery), function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		R.autoEvery = number and math.clamp(number, 1, 3600) or R.autoEvery
		box.Text = tostring(R.autoEvery)
	end)

	local chevron = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = ">",
		TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 24, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	}, header)
	local function toggleDrawer()
		drawer.Visible = not drawer.Visible
		chevron.Text = drawer.Visible and "v" or ">"
	end
	listen(chevron.MouseButton1Click, toggleDrawer)
	listen(nameButton.MouseButton1Click, toggleDrawer)
end)
end
Custom.buildRandomizer("red", "Randomizer (Red team)", "randomizerRedStop")
Custom.buildRandomizer("blue", "Randomizer (Blue team)", "randomizerBlueStop")

-- Battle Counter (Misc tab): small on-screen counter of living units (blue) and enemies (red)
safeBuild("Battle Counter", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local counter = { on = false, token = 0, gui = nil }
	Custom.counter = counter

	local function stopCounter()
		counter.on = false
		counter.token += 1
		if counter.gui then
			pcall(function()
				counter.gui:Destroy()
			end)
			counter.gui = nil
		end
	end

	local function aliveIn(folder)
		local count = 0
		if folder then
			for _, unit in folder:GetChildren() do
				local humanoid = unit:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
					count += 1
				end
			end
		end
		return count
	end

	local function startCounter()
		stopCounter()
		counter.on = true
		local token = counter.token
		local hud = make("ScreenGui", { Name = "OscarsCounter", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 60 }, playerGui)
		counter.gui = hud
		local box = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 34),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 6),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
		}, hud)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }, box)
		local blue = make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 170, 255),
			TextSize = 16,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = "BLUE 0",
		}, box)
		local red = make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 110),
			TextSize = 16,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = "RED 0",
		}, box)
		task.spawn(function()
			while counter.on and counter.token == token and not destroyed do
				local npcRoot = Workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCFolders")
				blue.Text = "BLUE " .. aliveIn(npcRoot and npcRoot:FindFirstChild("FriendlyFolder"))
				red.Text = "RED " .. aliveIn(npcRoot and npcRoot:FindFirstChild("EnemyFolder"))
				task.wait(0.4)
			end
		end)
	end
	Custom.counterStop = stopCounter

	addSwitch(addGrayRow(page, "Battle Counter (alive units / enemies)"), function()
		return counter.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then
			startCounter()
		else
			stopCounter()
		end
	end)
end)

-- Chat Bubble (Misc tab): a speech bubble with any text you type, for live streams.
-- Drag it where you want it, lock it in place, or lock it to your character's head. The text can also be typed
-- straight into the bubble on the screen ("Edit text on the bubble"), so the panel does not have to be open.
safeBuild("Chat Bubble", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local cb = {
		on = false, text = "", textSize = 26, style = 1, hideAfter = 0,
		followHead = false, -- the bubble stays over my character's head
		locked = false,     -- the bubble cannot be dragged any more
		editOnBubble = false, -- tap the bubble and type into it
		gui = nil, bubble = nil, label = nil, token = 0, position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.78, 0),
		followConn = nil, syncPanel = nil,
	}
	Custom.chatBubble = cb

	local STYLES = {
		{ name = "White", fill = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), text = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25) },
		{ name = "Yellow", fill = Color3.fromRGB(255, 233, 120), text = Color3.fromRGB(40, 30, 0) },
		{ name = "Blue", fill = Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255), text = Color3.fromRGB(10, 30, 70) },
		{ name = "Pink", fill = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 205), text = Color3.fromRGB(70, 10, 40) },
		{ name = "Dark", fill = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) },
	}

	local function stopFollow()
		if cb.followConn then
			pcall(function() cb.followConn:Disconnect() end)
			cb.followConn = nil
		end
	end

	local function destroyGui()
		cb.token += 1
		stopFollow()
		if cb.gui then pcall(function() cb.gui:Destroy() end) end
		cb.gui, cb.bubble, cb.label = nil, nil, nil
	end

	local function applyLook()
		if not cb.bubble then return end
		local style = STYLES[cb.style]
		cb.bubble.BackgroundColor3 = style.fill
		cb.label.TextColor3 = style.text
		cb.label.PlaceholderColor3 = style.text:Lerp(style.fill, 0.55)
		cb.label.TextSize = cb.textSize
		if cb.tail then cb.tail.BackgroundColor3 = style.fill end
		-- an empty bubble you can type into still needs some size to be tapped
		if cb.minSize then cb.minSize.MinSize = cb.editOnBubble and Vector2.new(140, cb.textSize + 6) or Vector2.new(0, 0) end
		cb.label.TextEditable = cb.editOnBubble
		cb.label.Active = cb.editOnBubble
	end

	local function hideBubble()
		if not cb.bubble then return end
		-- while you can type into the bubble it stays (empty) so you can find it again
		cb.bubble.Visible = cb.editOnBubble
	end

	-- keeps the bubble above my character's head (follows the head on the screen, also when the camera moves)
	local function startFollow()
		stopFollow()
		if not cb.followHead or not cb.bubble then return end
		cb.followConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not cb.bubble then return end
			local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
			local character = player.Character
			local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if not camera or not (head and head:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
			local point, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, head.Size.Y / 2 + 0.9, 0))
			if onScreen then
				cb.bubble.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
				cb.bubble.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
				cb.bubble.Visible = cb.label.Text ~= "" or cb.editOnBubble
			else
				cb.bubble.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end

	local function showText(text)
		cb.text = text
		if cb.syncPanel then cb.syncPanel(text) end
		if not cb.on then return end
		if not cb.gui then
			-- build() is defined below, it is looked up when this runs
			cb.build()
		end
		cb.label.Text = text
		if text == "" then hideBubble() return end
		cb.bubble.Visible = true
		cb.token += 1
		local token = cb.token
		if cb.hideAfter > 0 then
			task.delay(cb.hideAfter, function()
				if cb.token == token then hideBubble() end
			end)
		end
	end

	function cb.build()
		destroyGui()
		local hud = make("ScreenGui", { Name = "OscarsChatBubble", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 61 }, playerGui)
		cb.gui = hud
		local bubble = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
			Position = cb.position,
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Visible = false,
			ZIndex = 2,
		}, hud)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16) }, bubble)
		make("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(460, 600) }, bubble)
		make("UIPadding", {
			PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 16), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 16), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10),
		}, bubble)
		-- a TextBox, so the text can be typed straight into the bubble (it is read-only while that setting is off)
		local label = make("TextBox", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "",
			PlaceholderText = "tap here and type",
			TextWrapped = true,
			ClearTextOnFocus = false,
			MultiLine = false,
			TextEditable = false,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextSize = cb.textSize,
			ZIndex = 3,
		}, bubble)
		cb.minSize = make("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(428, 580), MinSize = Vector2.new(0, 0) }, label)
		-- the little tail under the bubble
		local tail = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 2),
			Rotation = 45,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ZIndex = 1,
		}, bubble)
		cb.bubble, cb.label, cb.tail = bubble, label, tail
		applyLook()
		if cb.editOnBubble then bubble.Visible = true end

		-- Enter / tapping away commits what was typed into the bubble
		listen(label.FocusLost, function()
			if cb.editOnBubble then showText(label.Text) end
		end)

		-- drag it with a finger / the mouse (not while it is locked or follows the head)
		local dragging, dragStart, startPos
		listen(bubble.InputBegan, function(input)
			if cb.locked or cb.followHead then return end
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging, dragStart, startPos = true, input.Position, bubble.Position
			end
		end)
		listen(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
			if dragging and not cb.locked and not cb.followHead
				and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				local delta = input.Position - dragStart
				bubble.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
				cb.position = bubble.Position
			end
		end)
		listen(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
		startFollow()
	end

	local drawer = addToggleCogRow(page, "Chat Bubble (for streams)", function()
		return cb.on
	end, function(value)
		cb.on = value
		if value then
			cb.build()
			if cb.text ~= "" then showText(cb.text) end
		else
			destroyGui()
		end
	end)

	local textRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Text")
	local textLabel = textRow:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	if textLabel then textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, 0) end
	local textBox = make("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 26),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		PlaceholderText = "type here, press enter",
		PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY,
		Text = "",
		TextSize = 14,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
	}, textRow)
	outline(textBox)
	listen(textBox.FocusLost, function()
		showText(textBox.Text)
	end)
	-- text typed on the bubble itself shows up in this box too
	cb.syncPanel = function(text)
		if textBox.Text ~= text then textBox.Text = text end
	end

	local buttonRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Bubble")
	local function rowButton(text, width, offset, onClick)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Text = text, TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, buttonRow)
		outline(button)
		listen(button.MouseButton1Click, onClick)
	end
	rowButton("SHOW", 64, 8, function() showText(textBox.Text) end)
	rowButton("HIDE", 64, 78, function() cb.token += 1 hideBubble() end)
	rowButton("CENTRE", 70, 148, function()
		cb.position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.78, 0)
		if cb.bubble and not cb.followHead then cb.bubble.Position = cb.position end
	end)

	local styleRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Colour")
	local styleButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Text = STYLES[cb.style].name, TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	}, styleRow)
	outline(styleButton)
	listen(styleButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		cb.style = cb.style % #STYLES + 1
		styleButton.Text = STYLES[cb.style].name
		applyLook()
	end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Text size"), tostring(cb.textSize), function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		cb.textSize = number and math.clamp(math.floor(number), 10, 80) or cb.textSize
		box.Text = tostring(cb.textSize)
		applyLook()
	end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Hide after (seconds, 0 = stays)"), "0", function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		cb.hideAfter = number and math.clamp(number, 0, 3600) or 0
		box.Text = tostring(cb.hideAfter)
	end)
	addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, "Lock bubble to my character's head"), function() return cb.followHead end, function(v)
		cb.followHead = v
		if cb.bubble then
			if v then
				startFollow()
			else
				stopFollow()
				cb.bubble.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
				cb.bubble.Position = cb.position
			end
		end
	end)
	addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, "Lock bubble position (no dragging)"), function() return cb.locked end, function(v)
		cb.locked = v
	end)
	addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, "Edit text on the bubble (no panel needed)"), function() return cb.editOnBubble end, function(v)
		cb.editOnBubble = v
		if cb.bubble then
			applyLook()
			if v then
				cb.bubble.Visible = true
			elseif cb.label.Text == "" then
				cb.bubble.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end)

	Custom.chatBubbleStop = destroyGui
end)

-- Camera Follow (Misc tab): the camera only TURNS left / right to face a chosen enemy (type its ID or a name).
-- It never moves, never changes the camera type and keeps looking up / down as it was.
safeBuild("Camera Follow", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local F = { on = false, query = "", alsoAllies = false, speed = 8, bound = false }

	local function folderOf(name)
		local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCFolders")
		return root and root:FindFirstChild(name)
	end

	local function matches(unit, text, number)
		if number then return tonumber(unit:GetAttribute("ID")) == number end
		return string.find(string.lower(unit.Name), text, 1, true) ~= nil
	end

	-- the closest living unit that matches the ID / name
	local function findTarget(cameraPos)
		local query = F.query
		if query == "" then return nil end
		local number = tonumber(query)
		local text = string.lower(query)
		local best, bestDistance
		for _, folderName in ipairs(F.alsoAllies and { "EnemyFolder", "FriendlyFolder" } or { "EnemyFolder" }) do
			local folder = folderOf(folderName)
			if folder then
				for _, unit in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
					if unit:IsA("Model") and matches(unit, text, number) then
						local humanoid = unit:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						local part = unit:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or unit:FindFirstChild("Head") or unit.PrimaryPart
						if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and (not humanoid or humanoid.Health > 0) then
							local distance = (part.Position - cameraPos).Magnitude
							if not bestDistance or distance < bestDistance then
								best, bestDistance = part, distance
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local function step(dt)
		if not F.on then return end
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end
		local cf = camera.CFrame
		local position, look = cf.Position, cf.LookVector
		local target = findTarget(position)
		if not target then return end
		local flat = Vector3.new(target.Position.X - position.X, 0, target.Position.Z - position.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then return end
		local wantedYaw = math.atan2(-flat.X, -flat.Z)
		local currentYaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
		local difference = (wantedYaw - currentYaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi -- shortest way round
		local alpha = F.speed > 0 and (1 - math.exp(-F.speed * dt)) or 1
		local yaw = currentYaw + difference * alpha
		local pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(look.Y, -1, 1)) -- looking up / down stays as it is
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
	end

	local function setOn(value)
		F.on = value
		if value and not F.bound then
			F.bound = true
			RunService:BindToRenderStep("OscarsCameraFollow", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, step)
		elseif not value and F.bound then
			F.bound = false
			pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("OscarsCameraFollow") end)
		end
	end
	Custom.camFollowStop = function() setOn(false) end

	local drawer = addToggleCogRow(page, "Camera Follow (turns to an enemy)", function()
		return F.on
	end, function(value)
		setOn(value)
	end)
	local queryRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Enemy ID or name")
	local queryBox = make("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 26), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, TextColor3 = BLACK, PlaceholderText = "e.g. 72 or hellfighter", PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY, Text = "",
		TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ClearTextOnFocus = false,
	}, queryRow)
	outline(queryBox)
	listen(queryBox.FocusLost, function()
		F.query = string.gsub(queryBox.Text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
	end)
	addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, "Turn speed (0 = instant)"), tostring(F.speed), function(box)
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		F.speed = number and math.clamp(number, 0, 60) or F.speed
		box.Text = tostring(F.speed)
	end)
	addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, "Also follow blue team units"), function() return F.alsoAllies end, function(value)
		F.alsoAllies = value
	end)
end)

-- Camera Scan / Fix (Misc tab): SCAN remembers how the normal camera looks (which camera, type, what it follows, field of view,
-- zoom). FIX puts all of it back - use it when the camera is stuck or broken after Enemy POV, Freecam or a game that
-- swapped cameras. With the main switch ON the camera is scanned automatically right before POV / Freecam start.
safeBuild("Camera Scan", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local S = { data = nil, statusLabel = nil }
	Custom.camAutoScan = true

	local function describe(camera, header)
		if not camera then return header .. ": no camera" end
		local subject = camera.CameraSubject
		return string.format("%s: %s | %s | FOV %d | follows %s", header, camera.Name, tostring(camera.CameraType):gsub("Enum.CameraType.", ""),
			math.round(camera.FieldOfView), subject and subject.ClassName or "nothing")
	end

	local function refreshStatus(prefix)
		if not S.statusLabel then return end
		local scanned = S.data and describe(S.data.camera, "Saved") or "Nothing scanned yet"
		S.statusLabel.Text = (prefix and (prefix .. "   ") or "") .. scanned
	end

	function Custom.camScan(quiet)
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return false end
		-- one of our own cameras (POV / Freecam) is not the normal camera: keep the earlier scan
		if string.sub(camera.Name, 1, 5) == "Oscar" and S.data then return false end
		local player = Players.LocalPlayer
		S.data = {
			camera = camera, cameraType = camera.CameraType, subject = camera.CameraSubject, fov = camera.FieldOfView, cframe = camera.CFrame,
			minZoom = player.CameraMinZoomDistance, maxZoom = player.CameraMaxZoomDistance, mode = player.CameraMode,
		}
		refreshStatus(quiet and nil or "Scanned.")
		return true
	end

	function Custom.camFix()
		-- 1) our own camera features let go of the camera
		if Custom.freecamStop then pcall(Custom.freecamStop) end
		if Custom.theirViewStop then pcall(Custom.theirViewStop) end
		for _, name in ipairs({ "OscarFreecam", "OscarTheirView", "OscarsCameraFollow" }) do
			pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(name) end)
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Camera") and (child.Name == "OscarFreecam" or child.Name == "OscarTheirViewCamera") then
				pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
			end
		end
		pcall(function() UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default end)

		-- 2) the camera: the scanned one if it still exists, otherwise any normal camera, otherwise a new one
		local data = S.data
		local camera = data and data.camera and data.camera.Parent and data.camera or nil
		if not camera then
			for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Camera") then camera = child break end
			end
		end
		if not camera then
			camera = Instance.new("Camera")
			camera.Name = "Camera"
			camera.Parent = Workspace
		end
		pcall(function() Workspace.CurrentCamera = camera end)

		-- 3) its settings
		local player = Players.LocalPlayer
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		pcall(function()
			local wasScriptable = data and data.cameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
			camera.CameraType = (data and data.cameraType) or Enum.CameraType.Custom
			local subject = data and data.subject
			camera.CameraSubject = (subject and subject.Parent and subject) or humanoid
			camera.FieldOfView = data and data.fov or 70
			if wasScriptable and data.cframe then camera.CFrame = data.cframe end
			if data then
				player.CameraMinZoomDistance = data.minZoom
				player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = data.maxZoom
				player.CameraMode = data.mode
			end
		end)
		refreshStatus("Fixed.")
	end

	local drawer = addToggleCogRow(page, "Camera Scan / Fix (auto-scan before POV / Freecam)", function()
		return Custom.camAutoScan
	end, function(value)
		Custom.camAutoScan = value
	end)

	local buttonRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Camera")
	local function rowButton(text, width, offset, onClick)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Text = text, TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, buttonRow)
		outline(button)
		listen(button.MouseButton1Click, onClick)
	end
	rowButton("FIX CAMERA", 100, 8, function() Custom.camFix() end)
	rowButton("SCAN NOW", 90, 116, function() Custom.camScan(false) end)

	local statusRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Not scanned yet")
	S.statusLabel = statusRow:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	if S.statusLabel then
		S.statusLabel.TextWrapped = true
		S.statusLabel.TextSize = 12
	end
	Custom.camScanStop = function() end
end)

-- Map Creator (Misc tab): "btools" with freecam. Tap a part in the world and use the toolbar on the left:
-- SELECT / MOVE / SCALE / ROTATE (drag the handles) / DELETE / CLONE / PAINT, + PART, UNDO, ANCHOR, COLLIDE, TRANSP, FREECAM.
-- Extras: SAVE / LOAD (your builds), HIDE MAP (hides the current map so it cannot get in your way), PREMADES (ready-made arenas)
-- and COMMUNITY (a video with sound; tap COMMUNITY again to reload it).
-- When you switch Map Creator ON a small window recommends turning on Freecam first:
--   Enable it anyway = build mode only | Enable it = build mode + Freecam | Discard = build mode stays off.
-- Everything changes on YOUR screen only (nobody else sees it) and goes back when you rejoin.
safeBuild("Map Creator", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]

	local Players = game:GetService("Players")

	local SAVE_FOLDER = "OscarMaps"

	local M = {

		allowUnits = false, selected = nil, undo = {}, gui = nil, conns = {}, gizmos = {}, status = nil, toolButtons = {},
		transp = 1, shapeButton = nil,
		folder = nil, touched = {}, mapHidden = false, hiddenOrig = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), hiddenExtra = {},
		hideConn = nil, hideToken = 0, popup = nil, popupMode = nil, video = nil, videoToken = 0, hideButton = nil,
		promptGui = nil, lastName = "My Map",
		keepImportant = true, keepBox = nil,
		keepWords = { "tv", "television", "screen", "monitor", "shield", "barrier", "forcefield", "mortis", "funk1d", "funkid", "event", "trigger", "button", "lever", "portal", "checkpoint" },

	Custom.mapCreator = M
	local SHAPES = { "Block", "Ball", "Cylinder", "Wedge" }
	local TOOLS = { "SELECT", "MOVE", "SCALE", "ROTATE", "DELETE", "CLONE", "PAINT" }
	local TRANSPARENCIES = { 0, 0.5, 0.8, 1 }

	_G.OscarMapSlots = _G.OscarMapSlots or {} -- fallback storage when the executor has no file functions

	local function setStatus(text)
		if M.status then M.status.Text = text end
	end

	local function snap(value, step)
		if step and step > 0 then return math.round(value / step) * step end
		return value
	end

	local function pushUndo(fn)
		M.undo[#M.undo + 1] = fn
		if #M.undo > 100 then table.remove(M.undo, 1) end
	end

	-- every part you add lives in this folder (so SAVE knows what is yours)
	local function getFolder()
		if M.folder and M.folder.Parent then return M.folder end
		local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild(MAP_FOLDER_NAME)
		if not folder then
			folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = MAP_FOLDER_NAME
			folder.Parent = Workspace
		end
		M.folder = folder
		return folder
	end

	local function clearGizmos()
		for _, object in ipairs(M.gizmos) do pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
		table.clear(M.gizmos)
	end

	local function describe(part)
		return string.format("%s  %.1f x %.1f x %.1f", part.Name, part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, part.Size.Z)
	end

	-- ===== remembering the ORIGINAL state of every game part you touch (for SAVE and CLEAR ALL) =====
	local function pathOf(part)
		local path = {}
		local node = part
		while node and node ~= Workspace do
			local parent = node.Parent
			if not parent then return nil end
			local index = 0
			for _, sibling in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
				if sibling.Name == node.Name then index += 1 end
				if sibling == node then break end
			end
			table.insert(path, 1, { node.Name, index })
			node = parent
		end
		if node ~= Workspace then return nil end
		return path
	end

	local function resolvePath(path)
		local node = Workspace
		for _, step in ipairs(path) do
			local seen, found = 0, nil
			for _, child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do
				if child.Name == step[1] then
					seen += 1
					if seen == step[2] then
						found = child
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if not found then return nil end
			node = found
		end
		return node
	end

	local function realCollide(part)
		local stored = M.hiddenOrig[part]
		if stored ~= nil then return stored end
		return part.CanCollide
	end

	local function touch(part)
		if M.touched[part] then return end
		if M.folder and part:IsDescendantOf(M.folder) then return end
		local path = pathOf(part)
		if not path then return end
		M.touched[part] = {
			path = path, cf = part.CFrame, size = part.Size, color = part.Color, transp = part.Transparency,
			anchored = part.Anchored, collide = realCollide(part), parent = part.Parent,
		}
	end

	-- the selection outline and (for MOVE / SCALE / ROTATE) the drag handles
	local function refreshGizmos()
		clearGizmos()
		local part = M.selected
		if not part or not part.Parent or not M.gui then
			if not part then setStatus("Tool: " .. M.tool .. " - tap a part") end
			return
		end
		local box = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
		box.Adornee = part
		box.LineThickness = 0.03
		box.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0)
		box.Parent = M.gui
		table.insert(M.gizmos, box)
		setStatus(M.tool .. ": " .. describe(part))

		local startCF, startSize
		local function remember()
			touch(part)
			startCF, startSize = part.CFrame, part.Size
			local cf0, size0 = startCF, startSize
			pushUndo(function()
				if part.Parent then part.Size = size0 part.CFrame = cf0 end
			end)
		end
		if M.tool == "MOVE" or M.tool == "SCALE" then
			local handles = Instance.new("Handles")
			handles.Adornee = part
			handles.Style = M.tool == "MOVE" and Enum.HandlesStyle.Movement or Enum.HandlesStyle.Resize
			handles.Color3 = M.tool == "MOVE" and Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 40)
			handles.Parent = M.gui
			table.insert(M.gizmos, handles)
			handles.MouseButton1Down:Connect(remember)
			handles.MouseDrag:Connect(function(face, distance)
				if not part.Parent then return end
				local axis = Vector3.FromNormalId(face)
				local amount = snap(distance, M.moveSnap)
				if M.tool == "MOVE" then
					part.CFrame = startCF * CFrame.new(axis * amount)
				else
					local component = Vector3.new(math.abs(axis.X), math.abs(axis.Y), math.abs(axis.Z))
					amount = math.max(amount, 0.05 - component:Dot(startSize)) -- never smaller than 0.05
					part.Size = startSize + component * amount
					part.CFrame = startCF * CFrame.new(axis * (amount / 2)) -- the opposite side stays where it is
				end
				setStatus(M.tool .. ": " .. describe(part))
			end)
		elseif M.tool == "ROTATE" then
			local arcs = Instance.new("ArcHandles")
			arcs.Adornee = part
			arcs.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)
			arcs.Parent = M.gui
			table.insert(M.gizmos, arcs)
			arcs.MouseButton1Down:Connect(remember)
			arcs.MouseDrag:Connect(function(axis, relativeAngle)
				if not part.Parent then return end
				local step = math.rad(M.rotateSnap)
				local angle = step > 0 and math.round(relativeAngle / step) * step or relativeAngle
				part.CFrame = startCF * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.FromAxis(axis), angle)
			end)
		end
	end

	local function select(part)
		M.selected = part
		refreshGizmos()
	end

	local function setTool(name)
		M.tool = name
		for toolName, button in pairs(M.toolButtons) do
			button.BackgroundColor3 = toolName == name and Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)
		end
		refreshGizmos()
	end

	local function isUnitPart(part)
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
		while model do
			if model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return true end
			model = model:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
		end
		return false
	end

	-- the first real part under the finger / mouse (units, invisible parts, hidden-map parts and your own character are skipped)
	-- returns the part and the exact spot that was hit
	local function pickPart(ray)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local ignore = {}
		if player.Character then ignore[1] = player.Character end
		if M.gui then ignore[#ignore + 1] = M.gui end
		for _ = 1, 12 do
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
			local result = Workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 3000, params)
			if not result then return nil end
			local part = result.Instance
			if part:IsA("Terrain") or part.Transparency >= 0.99 or M.hiddenOrig[part] ~= nil or (not M.allowUnits and isUnitPart(part)) then
				ignore[#ignore + 1] = part
			else
				return part, result.Position
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function applyTool(part)
		if not part then
			select(nil)
			return
		end
		local tool = M.tool
		if tool == "DELETE" then
			touch(part)
			if M.selected == part then select(nil) end
			local parent = part.Parent
			part.Parent = nil
			pushUndo(function() part.Parent = parent end)
			setStatus("Deleted " .. part.Name)
		elseif tool == "CLONE" then
			local copy = part:Clone()
			if M.hiddenOrig[part] ~= nil then copy.CanCollide = M.hiddenOrig[part] end
			copy.Parent = getFolder()
			copy.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.new(part.Size.X + 0.5, 0, 0)
			pushUndo(function()
				if M.selected == copy then select(nil) end
				copy:Destroy()
			end)
			select(copy)
		elseif tool == "PAINT" then
			touch(part)
			local old = part.Color
			part.Color = M.color
			pushUndo(function() part.Color = old end)
			select(part)
		else
			select(part)
		end
	end

	-- ===== building parts (from + PART, from a premade, from a saved map) =====
	local function buildPart(spec)
		local shape = spec.shape or "Block"
		local part = shape == "Wedge" and Instance.new("WedgePart") or Instance.new("Part")
		if shape == "Ball" or shape == "Cylinder" then part.Shape = Enum.PartType[shape] end
		part.Name = "MapPart"
		part.Anchored = spec.anchored ~= false
		part.Size = Vector3.new(spec.size[1], spec.size[2], spec.size[3])
		part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(spec.color[1], spec.color[2], spec.color[3])
		part.Transparency = spec.transp or 0
		part.CanCollide = spec.collide ~= false
		part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		if spec.mat then
			pcall(function() part.Material = Enum.Material[spec.mat] end)
		end
		part.CFrame = spec.cf
		part.Parent = getFolder()
		return part
	end

	local function addPart()
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end
		local color = M.color
		local part = buildPart({
			shape = SHAPES[M.shape], size = { 4, 4, 4 }, color = { color.R * 255, color.G * 255, color.B * 255 },
			cf = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position + camera.CFrame.LookVector * 14),
		})
		pushUndo(function()
			if M.selected == part then select(nil) end
			part:Destroy()
		end)
		setTool(M.tool == "SELECT" and "MOVE" or M.tool) -- so the handles show up
		select(part)
	end

	local function onSelected(change, label)
		local part = M.selected
		if not part or not part.Parent then
			setStatus("Select a part first")
			return
		end
		touch(part)
		change(part)
		setStatus(label(part))
	end

	-- ===== HIDE MAP: hides the current map (and turns its collisions off) so it cannot get in your way =====
	-- Only anchored parts that are not units, not your character and not your own parts are touched, so battlers, bullets and bases keep working.
	-- Terrain cannot be hidden by a script.
	local EXTRA_PROPS = { Decal = "Transparency", Texture = "Transparency", SurfaceGui = "Enabled", ParticleEmitter = "Enabled", Beam = "Enabled", Trail = "Enabled" }

	-- "important map stuff" (Mortis TVs, shields, FunK1d events ...) stays visible and solid while the rest is hidden.
	-- A part counts as important when its name (or the name of anything it sits in) contains one of the KEEP words, when it is a
	-- ForceField, a screen (SurfaceGui), or something you can touch / click (touch trigger, ClickDetector, ProximityPrompt).
	-- Add your own words in the drawer or with KEEP SELECTED.
	local function isImportant(part)
		if not M.keepImportant then return false end
		if part.Material == Enum.Material.ForceField then return true end
		local node = part
		while node and node ~= Workspace do
			local lowered = string.lower(node.Name)
			for _, word in ipairs(M.keepWords) do
				if word ~= "" and string.find(lowered, word, 1, true) then return true end
			end
			node = node.Parent
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("SurfaceGui") or child:IsA("ClickDetector") or child:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or child:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function isMapPart(part)
		if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Terrain") or not part.Anchored then return false end
		if M.folder and part:IsDescendantOf(M.folder) then return false end
		local npc = Workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCFolders")
		if npc and part:IsDescendantOf(npc) then return false end
		for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if other.Character and part:IsDescendantOf(other.Character) then return false end
		end
		if Workspace.CurrentCamera and part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace.CurrentCamera) then return false end
		if isUnitPart(part) then return false end
		return not isImportant(part)
	end

	local function hidePart(part)
		if M.hiddenOrig[part] ~= nil or not isMapPart(part) then return end
		M.hiddenOrig[part] = part.CanCollide
		part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
		part.CanCollide = false
		for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
			local property = EXTRA_PROPS[child.ClassName]
			if property then
				local old = child[property]
				M.hiddenExtra[child] = { property, old }
				child[property] = property == "Enabled" and false or 1
			end
		end
	end

	local function setMapHidden(state)
		if state == M.mapHidden then return end
		M.mapHidden = state
		M.hideToken += 1
		local token = M.hideToken
		if M.hideConn then
			M.hideConn:Disconnect()
			M.hideConn = nil
		end
		if state then
			M.hideConn = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
				if object:IsA("BasePart") then task.defer(hidePart, object) end
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				local count = 0
				for _, object in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					if token ~= M.hideToken then return end
					if object:IsA("BasePart") then hidePart(object) end
					count += 1
					if count % 400 == 0 then task.wait() end
				end
				if token == M.hideToken then setStatus("Current map hidden - build your own ground") end
			end)
		else
			for part, collide in pairs(M.hiddenOrig) do
				pcall(function()
					part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
					part.CanCollide = collide
				end)
			end
			table.clear(M.hiddenOrig)
			for object, saved in pairs(M.hiddenExtra) do
				pcall(function() object[saved[1]] = saved[2] end)
			end
			table.clear(M.hiddenExtra)
			setStatus("Current map shown again")
		end
		if M.hideButton then
			M.hideButton.Text = state and "HIDE MAP: ON" or "HIDE MAP: OFF"
			M.hideButton.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(150, 230, 150) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)
		end
	end

	local function reapplyHide()
		if M.mapHidden then
			setMapHidden(false)
			setMapHidden(true)
		end
	end

	local function setKeepWords(text)
		local words = {}
		for piece in string.gmatch(string.lower(tostring(text)), "[^,]+") do
			local word = string.gsub(piece, "^%s+", "")
			word = string.gsub(word, "%s+$", "")
			if word ~= "" then table.insert(words, word) end
		end
		M.keepWords = words
		if M.keepBox then M.keepBox.Text = table.concat(words, ", ") end
		reapplyHide()
	end

	-- ===== CLEAR ALL: puts every game part back and removes your parts =====
	local function resetAll()
		select(nil)
		for part, state in pairs(M.touched) do
			pcall(function()
				part.Parent = state.parent
				part.Size = state.size
				part.CFrame = state.cf
				part.Color = state.color
				part.Transparency = state.transp
				part.Anchored = state.anchored
				if M.hiddenOrig[part] ~= nil then M.hiddenOrig[part] = state.collide else part.CanCollide = state.collide end
			end)
		end
		table.clear(M.touched)
		for _, child in ipairs(getFolder():GetChildren()) do child:Destroy() end
		table.clear(M.undo)
	end

	-- ===== SAVE / LOAD =====
	local function fileFunctions()
		return {
			write = Custom.exec("writefile", "write_file"),
			read = Custom.exec("readfile", "read_file"),
			list = Custom.exec("listfiles", "list_files"),
			make = Custom.exec("makefolder", "make_folder"),
			delete = Custom.exec("delfile", "delete_file"),
			isfile = Custom.exec("isfile", "is_file"),
		}
	end

	local function cleanName(text)
		local name = string.gsub(tostring(text or ""), "[^%w _%-]", "")
		name = string.gsub(name, "^%s+", "")
		name = string.gsub(name, "%s+$", "")
		name = string.sub(name, 1, 40)
		if name == "" then name = "Map" end
		return name
	end

	local function vec(v) return { v.X, v.Y, v.Z } end
	local function rgb(c) return { math.round(c.R * 255), math.round(c.G * 255), math.round(c.B * 255) } end

	local function serialize()
		local data = { version = 1, hidden = M.mapHidden, added = {}, edited = {} }
		for _, part in ipairs(getFolder():GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local shape = "Block"
				if part:IsA("WedgePart") then
					shape = "Wedge"
				elseif part:IsA("Part") and part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then
					shape = "Ball"
				elseif part:IsA("Part") and part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Cylinder then
					shape = "Cylinder"
				end
				table.insert(data.added, {
					shape = shape, cf = { part.CFrame:GetComponents() }, size = vec(part.Size), color = rgb(part.Color),
					transp = part.Transparency, anchored = part.Anchored, collide = realCollide(part), mat = part.Material.Name,
				})
			end
		end
		for part, state in pairs(M.touched) do
			if not part.Parent then
				table.insert(data.edited, { path = state.path, deleted = true })
			else
				local changed = part.CFrame ~= state.cf or part.Size ~= state.size or part.Color ~= state.color
					or part.Transparency ~= state.transp or part.Anchored ~= state.anchored or realCollide(part) ~= state.collide
				if changed then
					table.insert(data.edited, {
						path = state.path, cf = { part.CFrame:GetComponents() }, size = vec(part.Size), color = rgb(part.Color),
						transp = part.Transparency, anchored = part.Anchored, collide = realCollide(part),
					})
				end
			end
		end
		return HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
	end

	local function saveMap(rawName)
		local name = cleanName(rawName)
		M.lastName = name
		local ok, json = pcall(serialize)
		if not ok then
			setStatus("Save failed: " .. tostring(json))
			return false
		end
		local fs = fileFunctions()
		local stored = false
		if fs.write then
			if fs.make then pcall(fs.make, SAVE_FOLDER) end
			stored = pcall(fs.write, SAVE_FOLDER .. "/" .. name .. ".json", json)
		end
		if stored then
			setStatus("Saved '" .. name .. "' (to your executor's workspace folder)")
		else
			_G.OscarMapSlots[name] = json
			setStatus("Saved '" .. name .. "' (memory only: lost when you leave the game)")
		end
		return true
	end

	local function listSaves()
		local names, seen = {}, {}
		local fs = fileFunctions()
		if fs.list then
			if fs.make then pcall(fs.make, SAVE_FOLDER) end
			local ok, files = pcall(fs.list, SAVE_FOLDER)
			if ok and type(files) == "table" then
				for _, path in ipairs(files) do
					local name = string.match(tostring(path), "([^/\\]+)%.json$")
					if name and not seen[name] then
						seen[name] = true
						table.insert(names, name)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for name in pairs(_G.OscarMapSlots) do
			if not seen[name] then
				seen[name] = true
				table.insert(names, name)
			end
		end
		table.sort(names)
		return names
	end

	local function loadMap(name)
		local json
		local fs = fileFunctions()
		if fs.read then
			local ok, content = pcall(fs.read, SAVE_FOLDER .. "/" .. name .. ".json")
			if ok and type(content) == "string" and content ~= "" then json = content end
		end
		json = json or _G.OscarMapSlots[name]
		if not json then
			setStatus("Could not find '" .. name .. "'")
			return false
		end
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(json) end)
		if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
			setStatus("'" .. name .. "' is not a valid map file")
			return false
		end
		resetAll()
		local missing = 0
		for _, entry in ipairs(data.edited or {}) do
			local part = entry.path and resolvePath(entry.path)
			if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
				touch(part)
				if entry.deleted then
					part.Parent = nil
				else
					pcall(function()
						part.Size = Vector3.new(entry.size[1], entry.size[2], entry.size[3])
						part.CFrame = CFrame.new(table.unpack(entry.cf))
						part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(entry.color[1], entry.color[2], entry.color[3])
						part.Transparency = entry.transp
						part.Anchored = entry.anchored
						if M.hiddenOrig[part] ~= nil then M.hiddenOrig[part] = entry.collide else part.CanCollide = entry.collide end
					end)
				end
			else
				missing += 1
			end
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(data.added or {}) do
			pcall(function()
				entry.cf = CFrame.new(table.unpack(entry.cf))
				buildPart(entry)
			end)
		end
		if data.hidden then setMapHidden(true) end
		M.lastName = name
		setStatus("Loaded '" .. name .. "'" .. (missing > 0 and (" (" .. missing .. " game parts not found)") or ""))
		return true
	end

	local function deleteSave(name)
		local fs = fileFunctions()
		if fs.delete then pcall(fs.delete, SAVE_FOLDER .. "/" .. name .. ".json") end
		_G.OscarMapSlots[name] = nil
		setStatus("Deleted save '" .. name .. "'")
	end

	-- ===== PREMADES: ready-made arenas, built where you are looking =====
	-- Every part is placed relative to the spot in front of you; the ground's top is at height 0.
	local function P(list, shape, size, cf, color, mat, transp)
		list[#list + 1] = { shape = shape, size = size, rel = cf, color = color, mat = mat, transp = transp }
	end

					P(L, "Block", { 1.2, 0.6, 140 }, CFrame.new(x, 0.3, 0), C(255, 0, 200), "Neon")
				end
				for index, spot in ipairs({ { -45, -25 }, { 45, -25 }, { -45, 25 }, { 45, 25 } }) do
					P(L, "Block", { 22, 2, 22 }, CFrame.new(spot[1], 9, spot[2]), C(40, 40, 70), "SmoothPlastic")
					P(L, "Block", { 22.4, 0.5, 22.4 }, CFrame.new(spot[1], 10.2, spot[2]), index % 2 == 0 and C(255, 0, 200) or C(0, 200, 255), "Neon", 0.3)
				end
			end,
		},
		{
			name = "Bridge Gap", info = "Two platforms and a narrow wooden bridge.",
			build = function(L)
				P(L, "Block", { 70, 2, 70 }, CFrame.new(-75, -1, 0), C(110, 160, 90), "Grass")
				P(L, "Block", { 70, 2, 70 }, CFrame.new(75, -1, 0), C(110, 160, 90), "Grass")
				P(L, "Block", { 82, 1, 10 }, CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0), C(150, 105, 60), "WoodPlanks")
				for _, z in ipairs({ -5, 5 }) do
					P(L, "Block", { 82, 1.5, 0.6 }, CFrame.new(0, 1, z), C(110, 75, 45), "Wood")
				end
			end,
		},
		{
			name = "Stepped Hill", info = "A hill with steps up to a flat top.",
			build = function(L)
				P(L, "Block", { 200, 2, 140 }, CFrame.new(0, -1, 0), C(95, 165, 75), "Grass")
				for i = 1, 5 do
					P(L, "Block", { 100 - i * 14, 3, 80 - i * 10 }, CFrame.new(0, i * 3 - 1.5, 0), C(105 + i * 8, 150, 80), "Grass")
				end
			end,
		},
	}

	local function buildPremade(premade)
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end
		local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
		local _, hit = pickPart(camera:ViewportPointToRay(viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2))
		hit = hit or (camera.CFrame.Position + look * 40 - Vector3.new(0, 10, 0))
		local origin = CFrame.new(hit) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z), 0)
		local list = {}
		premade.build(list)
		local made = {}
		for _, spec in ipairs(list) do
			spec.cf = origin * spec.rel
			spec.color = rgbOf(spec.color)
			local ok, part = pcall(buildPart, spec)
			if ok then table.insert(made, part) end
		end
		pushUndo(function()
			for _, part in ipairs(made) do pcall(function() part:Destroy() end) end
		end)
		setStatus("Built '" .. premade.name .. "' (UNDO removes it)")
	end

	-- ===== popup window (SAVE / LOAD, PREMADES, COMMUNITY) =====
	local function closePopup()
		M.videoToken += 1
		if M.video then pcall(function() M.video:Pause() end) end
		if M.popup then pcall(function() M.popup:Destroy() end) end -- destroying the video also stops its sound
		M.popup, M.video, M.popupMode = nil, nil, nil
	end

		closePopup()

	local popupOrder = 0

		popupOrder += 1
		return make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230),
			TextSize = 12, TextWrapped = true, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, LayoutOrder = popupOrder, ZIndex = 10,
		}, parent)
	end

	local function popButton(parent, text, color, onClick, height)
		popupOrder += 1
		local item = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or 30), BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235), Text = text,
			TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 12, TextWrapped = true, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, LayoutOrder = popupOrder, ZIndex = 10,
		}, parent)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, item)
		listen(item.MouseButton1Click, function() onClick(item) end)
		return item
	end

	local function openSaves()
		local body = openPopup("saves", "SAVE / LOAD MAPS")
		popupOrder = 0
		popLabel(body, "Saves your parts and the changes you made to game parts.", 30)
		popupOrder += 1
		local nameBox = make("TextBox", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, TextColor3 = BLACK, Text = M.lastName, PlaceholderText = "map name",
			TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ClearTextOnFocus = false, LayoutOrder = popupOrder, ZIndex = 10,
		}, body)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, nameBox)
		local listHolder
		local function refreshList()
			if not listHolder or not listHolder.Parent then return end
			for _, child in ipairs(listHolder:GetChildren()) do
				if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") then child:Destroy() end
			end
			local names = listSaves()
			if #names == 0 then
				make("TextLabel", {
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "No saved maps yet.", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
					TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, ZIndex = 10,
				}, listHolder)
			end
			for index, name in ipairs(names) do
				local row = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45), LayoutOrder = index, ZIndex = 10 }, listHolder)
				make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, row)
				make("TextLabel", {
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = name,
					TextColor3 = WHITE, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 11,
				}, row)
				local load = make("TextButton", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 22), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0.5, 0),
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 230, 150), Text = "LOAD", TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = 11,
				}, row)
				make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) }, load)
				local del = make("TextButton", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 22), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0.5, 0),
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 120, 120), Text = "DEL", TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = 11,
				}, row)
				make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) }, del)
				listen(load.MouseButton1Click, function()
					nameBox.Text = name
					loadMap(name)
				end)
				listen(del.MouseButton1Click, function()
					deleteSave(name)
					refreshList()
				end)
			end
		end
		popButton(body, "SAVE", Color3.fromRGB(150, 230, 150), function()
			saveMap(nameBox.Text)
			nameBox.Text = M.lastName
			refreshList()
		end)
		popLabel(body, "Saved maps (tap LOAD to replace your current build with it):", 30)
		popupOrder += 1
		listHolder = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = popupOrder, ZIndex = 10,
		}, body)
		make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 3), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, listHolder)
		refreshList()
	end

	local function openPremades()
		local body = openPopup("premades", "PREMADE MAPS")
		popupOrder = 0
		popLabel(body, "Look at the spot you want, then tap a map. It is built there. UNDO removes it. Use HIDE MAP first if you want a clean start.", 54)
