-- Mobile Cinematic Mode (Misc tab): hides the game's HUD (title, health bar, money, level, FIRE, Menu ...) so
-- nothing can be seen or tapped until the switch is turned off again. Oscar's own panel / icon stay visible.
-- Invisible character (Misc tab): hides your own character AND the weapon / tool / accessories, for you only
safeBuild("Invisible Character", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local state = { on = false, hidden = {}, bound = false, refreshAt = 0 }
	Custom.invisible = state

	local function remember(object)
		if object:IsA("BasePart") and state.hidden[object] == nil then
			state.hidden[object] = object.LocalTransparencyModifier
		end
	end

	-- finds every part of the character, including held tools / weapons and accessories (and new ones later)
	local function collect()
		local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		if not character then return end
		for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			remember(object)
		end
	end

	local function apply()
		for object in pairs(state.hidden) do
			if object.Parent then
				pcall(function() object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end)
			else
				state.hidden[object] = nil -- part is gone (respawn, weapon unequipped)
			end
		end
	end

	local function restore()
		for object, old in pairs(state.hidden) do
			pcall(function() object.LocalTransparencyModifier = old end)
		end
		table.clear(state.hidden)
	end

	local function stop()
		state.on = false
		if state.bound then
			state.bound = false
			pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("OscarInvisibleCharacter") end)
		end
		restore() -- everything becomes visible again
	end
	Custom.invisibleStop = stop

	local function start()
		stop()
		state.on = true
		state.refreshAt = 0
		state.bound = true
		-- every frame, after the game's own scripts, so nothing can make the character visible again
		RunService:BindToRenderStep("OscarInvisibleCharacter", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 5, function()
			if not state.on or destroyed then return end
			if os.clock() >= state.refreshAt then
				state.refreshAt = os.clock() + 0.3
				collect()
			end
			apply()
		end)
	end

	addSwitch(addGrayRow(page, "Invisible character (including the weapon)"), function()
		return state.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then start() else stop() end
	end)
end)

-- Battler Sprites (Misc tab): the chosen battlers / enemies turn invisible (for you only) and a block with your picture
-- takes their place and follows them. Like the Animation Changer, every setting is for ONE kind of animation
-- (Idle / Walk / Punch / Custom words): the picture changes with what the battler is doing right now.
safeBuild("Battler Image Block", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local MAX_ENTRIES = 250
	local TYPES = {
		{ name = "Idle", keys = "idle" },
		{ name = "Walk", keys = "walk,run" },
		{ name = "Punch", keys = "punch,attack,swing,slash,melee,hit" },
		{ name = "Custom", keys = "" },
	}
	local block = {
		on = false, sizeX = 5, sizeY = 6, sizeZ = 1, raise = 0,
		blockTransparency = 0, imageTransparency = 0, faceCamera = false,
		spin = 0, angle = 0, axis = 1, spinAngle = 0, lastRender = nil,
		entries = {}, units = {}, bound = false, scanAt = 0, stateAt = 0,
		projectiles = {}, proj = {}, extra = {}, hideNames = "", keepBars = true, projDirty = true, projBound = false,
		cache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	}
	Custom.imageBlock = block

	-- Roblox "asset IDs": a Decal asset (the number of a decal) holds the real image inside it, so the real image is
	-- looked up once (GetObjects) and cached; image asset IDs simply work. Until it is known the plain ID is used.
	local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
	local resolved, pending = {}, {}
	local function sourceOf(id)
		local known = resolved[id]
		if known then return known end
		if not pending[id] then
			pending[id] = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local final = "rbxassetid://" .. id
				local ok, objects = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. id) end)
				if ok and type(objects) == "table" then
					for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
						local texture
						pcall(function()
							if object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then
								texture = object.Texture
							elseif object:IsA("ImageLabel") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
								texture = object.Image
							end
						end)
						if texture and texture ~= "" then
							final = texture
							break
						end
					end
					for _, object in ipairs(objects) do pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
				end
				pcall(function() ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ final }) end)
				resolved[id] = final
			end)
		end
		return "rbxassetid://" .. id
	end

	-- 12345, rbxassetid://12345, roblox.com/asset/?id=12345 - several can be given, separated by commas or spaces
	local function parseIds(text)
		local list = {}
		for token in string.gmatch(tostring(text or ""), "[^,%s]+") do
			local id = string.match(token, "id=(%d+)") or string.match(token, "%d+")
			if id then table.insert(list, id) end
		end
		return list
	end

	local function isAlive(model)
		if not model or not model.Parent then return false end
		local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		return model:FindFirstChild("Head") ~= nil and (not humanoid or humanoid.Health > 0)
	end

	local function rootOf(model)
		return model.PrimaryPart
			or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			or model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
			or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
			or model:FindFirstChild("Head")
	end

	-- every name a battler goes by (its model name, a Name / DisplayName attribute, its humanoid's display name)
	local nameCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local function namesOf(model)
		local cached = nameCache[model]
		if cached and os.clock() - cached.time < 3 then return cached.list end
		local list = { string.lower(model.Name) }
		for attribute, value in pairs(model:GetAttributes()) do
			if type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
				local lowered = string.lower(attribute)
				if lowered == "name" or lowered == "displayname" or lowered == "unitname" or lowered == "enemyname" or lowered == "title" then
					table.insert(list, string.lower(value))
				end
			end
		end
		local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and humanoid.DisplayName ~= "" then table.insert(list, string.lower(humanoid.DisplayName)) end
		nameCache[model] = { time = os.clock(), list = list }
		return list
	end
	-- "chronos" matches "Chronos", "Chronos (Boss)" ...; several names can be given, separated by commas
	local function nameMatches(model, text)
		local names = namesOf(model)
		for piece in string.gmatch(string.lower(text), "[^,]+") do
			local token = string.match(piece, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
			if token ~= "" then
				for _, name in ipairs(names) do
					if string.find(name, token, 1, true) then return true end
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function isSpecific(entry)
		return entry.id > 0 or (entry.name or "") ~= ""
	end

	local function entryCovers(entry, model, isAlly)
		if not entry.enabled then return false end
		if entry.team ~= 2 and (entry.team == 1) ~= isAlly then return false end
		if (entry.name or "") ~= "" then
			if not nameMatches(model, entry.name) then return false end
		elseif entry.id > 0 and tonumber(model:GetAttribute("ID")) ~= entry.id then
			return false
		end
		return true
	end

	-- ===== what is the battler doing? (same idea as the Animation Changer's scanner) =====
	local function wordsOf(keys)
		local list = {}
		for word in string.gmatch(string.lower(keys or ""), "[^,%s]+") do
			table.insert(list, word)
		end
		return list
	end

	-- the game keeps Animation objects named "Idle" / "Walk" / "Punch" inside each battler, but the playing
	-- track is often just called "Animation": so the IDs of the matching objects are collected too
	local function idsOfNamed(unit, words)
		local ids = {}
		for _, object in ipairs(unit:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("Animation") and not object:GetAttribute("OscarMade") then
				local lowered = string.lower(object.Name)
				for _, word in ipairs(words) do
					if string.find(lowered, word, 1, true) then
						ids[string.lower(object.AnimationId)] = true
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return ids
	end

	local function unitInfo(unit, now)
		local info = block.cache[unit]
		if info and now - info.time < 1.5 then return info end
		info = { time = now, sources = {}, idsByKeys = {} }
		for _, object in ipairs(unit:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("Animator") or object:IsA("Humanoid") or object:IsA("AnimationController") then
				table.insert(info.sources, object)
			end
		end
		block.cache[unit] = info
		return info
	end

	local function playingTracks(info)
		local result, seen = {}, {}
		for _, object in ipairs(info.sources) do
			local ok, list = pcall(function() return object:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() end)
			if ok and type(list) == "table" then
				for _, track in ipairs(list) do
					if not seen[track] then
						seen[track] = true
						table.insert(result, track)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return result
	end

	local function keysMatch(unit, info, tracks, keys)
		local words = wordsOf(keys)
		if #words == 0 then return false end
		local ids = info.idsByKeys[keys]
		if not ids then
			ids = idsOfNamed(unit, words)
			info.idsByKeys[keys] = ids
		end
		for _, track in ipairs(tracks) do
			local weight = 1
			pcall(function() weight = track.WeightCurrent end)
			if weight > 0.05 then
				local names = { string.lower(track.Name or "") }
				pcall(function()
					if track.Animation then
						table.insert(names, string.lower(track.Animation.Name))
						table.insert(names, string.lower(track.Animation.AnimationId))
						if ids[string.lower(track.Animation.AnimationId)] then names[#names + 1] = "\0match" end
					end
				end)
				for _, name in ipairs(names) do
					if name == "\0match" then return true end
					for _, word in ipairs(words) do
						if string.find(name, word, 1, true) then return true end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	-- picks the setting whose animation kind the battler is showing right now
	local function chooseEntry(unit, state, covering, now)
		local info = unitInfo(unit, now)
		local tracks = playingTracks(info)
		local function firstOf(kind)
			for _, entry in ipairs(covering) do
				if entry.typeIndex == kind then return entry end
			end
		end
		-- Custom words and Punch win, then Walk, then Idle
		for _, entry in ipairs(covering) do
			if entry.typeIndex == 4 and keysMatch(unit, info, tracks, entry.keys) then return entry end
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(covering) do
			if entry.typeIndex == 3 and keysMatch(unit, info, tracks, entry.keys) then
				state.punchEntry, state.punchUntil = entry, now + 0.25 -- do not flicker
				return entry
			end
		end
		if state.punchEntry and now < state.punchUntil and table.find(covering, state.punchEntry) then
			return state.punchEntry
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(covering) do
			if entry.typeIndex == 2 and (state.speed > 1 or keysMatch(unit, info, tracks, entry.keys)) then return entry end
		end
		return firstOf(1) or covering[1]
	end

	-- ===== hiding a battler COMPLETELY (only for you): parts, pictures, lights, particles, beams, guis =====
	local FX_CLASSES = {
		{ "ParticleEmitter", "Enabled" }, { "Beam", "Enabled" }, { "Trail", "Enabled" }, { "Fire", "Enabled" },
		{ "Smoke", "Enabled" }, { "Sparkles", "Enabled" }, { "Light", "Enabled" }, { "Highlight", "Enabled" },
		{ "SelectionBox", "Visible" }, { "SelectionSphere", "Visible" },
	}
	local KEEP_WORDS = { "health", "hp", "bar", "name", "tag", "title", "level" }
	-- health bars / name tags stay (when that switch is on): by name, or because they hold no pictures at all
	local function keepGui(gui)
		if not block.keepBars then return false end
		local lowered = string.lower(gui.Name)
		for _, word in ipairs(KEEP_WORDS) do
			if string.find(lowered, word, 1, true) then return true end
		end
		return not (gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel", true) or gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageButton", true)
			or gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ViewportFrame", true))
	end
	local function hideObject(state, object)
		if state.hidden[object] ~= nil or state.fx[object] ~= nil then return end
		pcall(function()
			if object:IsA("BasePart") then
				state.hidden[object] = object.LocalTransparencyModifier
			elseif object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then
				state.fx[object] = { "Transparency", object.Transparency }
				object.Transparency = 1
			elseif object:IsA("BillboardGui") or object:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
				if not keepGui(object) then
					state.fx[object] = { "Enabled", object.Enabled }
					object.Enabled = false
				end
			else
				for _, pair in ipairs(FX_CLASSES) do
					if object:IsA(pair[1]) then
						state.fx[object] = { pair[2], object[pair[2]] }
						object[pair[2]] = false
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	-- every frame: the game cannot show it again
	local function keepHidden(state)
		for object in pairs(state.hidden) do
			if object.Parent then
				pcall(function() object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end)
			end
		end
		for object, info in pairs(state.fx) do
			if object.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					local wanted = info[1] == "Transparency" and 1 or false
					if object[info[1]] ~= wanted then object[info[1]] = wanted end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	local function restoreState(state)
		if state.conn then
			state.conn:Disconnect()
			state.conn = nil
		end
		for object, old in pairs(state.hidden) do
			pcall(function() object.LocalTransparencyModifier = old end) -- visible again
		end
		for object, info in pairs(state.fx) do
			pcall(function() object[info[1]] = info[2] end)
		end
		table.clear(state.hidden)
		table.clear(state.fx)
	end

	-- shared with the Death Effects module: hide / keep hidden / show again
	Custom.fx = { hideObject = hideObject, keepHidden = keepHidden, restoreState = restoreState }

	-- every setting can have its own size / look: a blank box means "use the main settings"
	-- (projectiles have their own defaults instead: a flat picture that faces you)
	local PROJ_DEFAULT = {
		sizeX = 2, sizeY = 2, sizeZ = 0.05, raise = 0, blockTransparency = 0, imageTransparency = 0,
		spin = 0, angle = 0, axis = 2, faceCamera = true,
	}
	local function look(entry, key, defaults)
		local value = entry and entry[key]
		if value ~= nil then return value end
		if defaults then return defaults[key] end
		return block[key]
	end
	local function rotationOf(entry, state, frameTime, defaults)
		state.spinAngle = ((state.spinAngle or 0) + look(entry, "spin", defaults) * 360 * frameTime) % 360
		local turn = math.rad(look(entry, "angle", defaults) + state.spinAngle)
		local axis = look(entry, "axis", defaults)
		if axis == 2 then
			return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, turn)
		elseif axis == 3 then
			return CFrame.Angles(turn, 0, 0)
		end
		return CFrame.Angles(0, turn, 0)
	end

	-- which cell of a spritesheet a frame is: the sheet can be read to the Right, Left, Down or Up
	local DIRECTIONS = { "Right >", "Left <", "Down v", "Up ^" }
	local function cellOf(entry, frame)
		local cols, rows = entry.cols, entry.rows
		local direction = entry.dir or 1
		if direction == 2 then
			return cols - 1 - (frame % cols), math.floor(frame / cols) -- right to left, then the next row down
		elseif direction == 3 then
			return math.floor(frame / rows), frame % rows -- top to bottom, then the next column
		elseif direction == 4 then
			return math.floor(frame / rows), rows - 1 - (frame % rows) -- bottom to top, then the next column
		end
		return frame % cols, math.floor(frame / cols) -- left to right, then the next row down
	end

	-- ===== the blocks =====
	local function updateLook(state)
		local entry, defaults = state.entry, state.defaults
		local imageTransparency = look(entry, "imageTransparency", defaults)
		state.part.Transparency = look(entry, "blockTransparency", defaults)
		for _, decal in ipairs(state.decals) do
			decal.Transparency = imageTransparency
		end
		for _, face in ipairs(state.sheets) do
			face.image.ImageTransparency = imageTransparency
		end
	end

	local function remove(model)
		local state = block.units[model]
		if not state then return end
		restoreState(state) -- the battler is visible again
		pcall(function() state.part:Destroy() end)
		block.units[model] = nil
	end

	local function buildPart()
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = "OscarBattlerBlock"
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		part.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		part.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(block.sizeX, 0.05), math.max(block.sizeY, 0.05), math.max(block.sizeZ, 0.05))
		local decals, sheets = {}, {}
		for _, face in ipairs({ Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back, Enum.NormalId.Left, Enum.NormalId.Right }) do
			local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
			decal.Face = face
			decal.Parent = part
			table.insert(decals, decal)

			-- spritesheet face: the sheet is drawn inside a frame that only shows ONE cell (a scaled, clipped ImageLabel)
			local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
			gui.Face = face
			gui.Adornee = part
			gui.LightInfluence = 0
			gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
			gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
			gui.Enabled = true
			gui.Parent = part
			local clip = Instance.new("Frame")
			clip.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			clip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			clip.BorderSizePixel = 0
			clip.ClipsDescendants = true
			clip.Parent = gui
			local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			image.BorderSizePixel = 0
			image.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			image.Parent = clip
			table.insert(sheets, { gui = gui, image = image })
		end
		part.Parent = Workspace
		return part, decals, sheets
	end

	local function add(model, isAlly)
		local part, decals, sheets = buildPart()
		local state = {
			part = part, decals = decals, sheets = sheets, mode = "decal", hidden = {}, fx = {}, ally = isAlly, texture = nil,
			speed = 0, lastPos = nil, lastTime = os.clock(), entry = nil, since = os.clock(), covering = {},
		}
		block.units[model] = state
		updateLook(state)
		-- parts / effects the game adds later (attacks, auras) are hidden the moment they appear
		state.conn = model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			hideObject(state, object)
		end)
	end

	local function hideModel(model, state)
		for _, object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			hideObject(state, object)
		end
	end

	-- ===== objects by NAME that belong to a battler but live elsewhere (a boss's clock, rays ...) =====
	local function hideExtras()
		local wanted = {}
		for piece in string.gmatch(string.lower(block.hideNames or ""), "[^,]+") do
			local token = string.match(piece, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
			if token ~= "" then wanted[token] = true end
		end
		for object, state in pairs(block.extra) do
			if not object.Parent or not wanted[string.lower(object.Name)] then
				restoreState(state)
				block.extra[object] = nil
			end
		end
		if next(wanted) == nil then return end
		local function check(object)
			if block.extra[object] or object.Name == "OscarBattlerBlock" or not wanted[string.lower(object.Name)] then return end
			local state = { hidden = {}, fx = {} }
			block.extra[object] = state
			hideObject(state, object)
			for _, inner in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do hideObject(state, inner) end
			state.conn = object.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inner) hideObject(state, inner) end)
		end
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
			check(child)
			if not child:IsA("Terrain") and child ~= camera then
				for _, grand in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do check(grand) end
			end
		end
	end

	-- ===== projectiles: bullets / rockets / effects that are NOT battlers, picked by name =====
	local function projectileEntry(object)
		local lowered = string.lower(object.Name)
		for _, entry in ipairs(block.projectiles) do
			if entry.enabled and (entry.name or "") ~= "" then
				for token in string.gmatch(string.lower(entry.name), "[^,]+") do
					if string.match(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$") == lowered then return entry end
				end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function insideUnits(object)
		local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCFolders")
		return root ~= nil and object:IsDescendantOf(root)
	end
	local function trackedAbove(object)
		local node = object.Parent
		while node and node ~= Workspace do
			if block.proj[node] then return true end
			node = node.Parent
		end
		return false
	end
	local function removeProjectile(object)
		local state = block.proj[object]
		if not state then return end
		restoreState(state)
		pcall(function() state.part:Destroy() end)
		block.proj[object] = nil
	end
	local function trackProjectile(object)
		if block.proj[object] then return end
		if not (object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("Model")) or object:IsA("Terrain") or object.Name == "OscarBattlerBlock" then return end
		local entry = projectileEntry(object)
		if not entry or insideUnits(object) or trackedAbove(object) then return end
		local part, decals, sheets = buildPart()
		local state = {
			part = part, decals = decals, sheets = sheets, hidden = {}, fx = {}, entry = entry, since = os.clock(),
			defaults = PROJ_DEFAULT,
		}
		block.proj[object] = state
		updateLook(state)
		hideObject(state, object)
		for _, inner in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do hideObject(state, inner) end
		state.conn = object.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inner) hideObject(state, inner) end)
	end

	-- which living battlers are covered by at least one ON setting
	local function rescan()
		local wanted = {}
		for _, folderName in ipairs({ "EnemyFolder", "FriendlyFolder" }) do
			local isAlly = folderName == "FriendlyFolder"
			local folder = npcFolder(folderName)
			if folder then
				for _, npc in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
					if npc:IsA("Model") and isAlive(npc) then
						local covering = {}
						for _, entry in ipairs(block.entries) do
							if entryCovers(entry, npc, isAlly) then table.insert(covering, entry) end
						end
						if #covering > 0 then
							-- a setting for one unit ID beats a setting for "every battler"
							table.sort(covering, function(a, b)
								if isSpecific(a) ~= isSpecific(b) then return isSpecific(a) end
								return table.find(block.entries, a) < table.find(block.entries, b)
							end)
							wanted[npc] = { covering = covering, ally = isAlly }
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for model in pairs(block.units) do
			if not wanted[model] then remove(model) end
		end
		for model, info in pairs(wanted) do
			if not block.units[model] then add(model, info.ally) end
			local state = block.units[model]
			state.covering = info.covering
			hideModel(model, state)
		end

		-- projectiles: drop what is no longer wanted, find what is already out there
		for object, state in pairs(block.proj) do
			if not object.Parent or projectileEntry(object) ~= state.entry then removeProjectile(object) end
		end
		if block.projDirty and #block.projectiles > 0 then
			block.projDirty = false
			for _, object in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do trackProjectile(object) end
		end
		hideExtras()
	end

	local function stop()
		block.on = false
		if block.bound then
			block.bound = false
			pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("OscarBattlerBlock") end)
		end
		for model in pairs(block.units) do
			remove(model)
		end
		if block.projBound then
			block.projBound = false
			pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("OscarProjectileBlocks") end)
		end
		if block.projConn then
			block.projConn:Disconnect()
			block.projConn = nil
		end
		for object in pairs(block.proj) do
			removeProjectile(object)
		end
		for object, state in pairs(block.extra) do
			restoreState(state)
			block.extra[object] = nil
		end
	end
	Custom.imageBlockStop = stop

	local function start()
		stop()
		block.on = true
		block.spinAngle, block.lastRender = 0, nil
		block.scanAt, block.stateAt = 0, 0
		block.bound = true
		block.projDirty = true
		block.projConn = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			if block.on and #block.projectiles > 0 then trackProjectile(object) end
		end)
		block.projBound = true
		RunService:BindToRenderStep("OscarProjectileBlocks", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 6, function()
			if not block.on or destroyed then return end
			local now = os.clock()
			local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
			local lastFrame = block.projLast
			for object, state in pairs(block.proj) do
				if not object.Parent then
					removeProjectile(object)
				else
					local entry = state.entry
					local pivot
					if object:IsA("BasePart") then
						pivot = object.CFrame
					else
						local ok, result = pcall(function() return object:GetPivot() end)
						pivot = ok and result or nil
					end
					if pivot then
						local position = pivot.Position + Vector3.new(0, look(entry, "raise", PROJ_DEFAULT), 0)
						local ids = entry.ids or {}
						local source = ""
						if #ids > 0 then
							local index = (#ids > 1) and (math.floor((now - state.since) * 8) % #ids + 1) or 1
							source = sourceOf(ids[index])
						end
						for _, face in ipairs(state.sheets) do
							if face.image.Image ~= source then face.image.Image = source end
						end
						if source ~= state.source then
							state.source, state.sourceTime, state.decalOn = source, now, false
							for _, decal in ipairs(state.decals) do decal.Texture = "" end
						end
						local loaded = state.sheets[1] and state.sheets[1].image.IsLoaded
						if source ~= "" and not loaded and not state.decalOn and now - state.sourceTime > 2 then
							state.decalOn = true
							for _, decal in ipairs(state.decals) do decal.Texture = source end
						end
						-- no picture typed = the projectile is simply invisible
						state.part.Transparency = (source == "") and 1 or look(entry, "blockTransparency", PROJ_DEFAULT)
						state.part.Size = Vector3.new(
							math.max(look(entry, "sizeX", PROJ_DEFAULT), 0.05),
							math.max(look(entry, "sizeY", PROJ_DEFAULT), 0.05),
							math.max(look(entry, "sizeZ", PROJ_DEFAULT), 0.05))
						local projTime = math.min(now - (block.projLast or now), 0.2)
						local projRotation = rotationOf(entry, state, projTime, PROJ_DEFAULT)
						if look(entry, "faceCamera", PROJ_DEFAULT) and camera then
							state.part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, camera.CFrame.Position) * projRotation -- faces you
						else
							state.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * (pivot - pivot.Position) * projRotation
						end
					end
					keepHidden(state)
				end
			end
			block.projLast = now
			for _, state in pairs(block.extra) do keepHidden(state) end
		end)
		local function renderStep()
			if not block.on or destroyed then return end
			local now = os.clock()
			if now >= block.scanAt then
				block.scanAt = now + 0.3
				rescan()
			end
			-- rotation: a fixed angle plus a steady spin (turns per second, negative = the other way round)
			local frameTime = block.lastRender and math.min(now - block.lastRender, 0.2) or 0
			block.lastRender = now
			block.spinAngle = (block.spinAngle + block.spin * 360 * frameTime) % 360
			local turn = math.rad(block.angle + block.spinAngle)
			local rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, turn, 0)
			if block.axis == 2 then
				rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, turn)
			elseif block.axis == 3 then
				rotation = CFrame.Angles(turn, 0, 0)
			end

			local doState = now >= block.stateAt
			if doState then block.stateAt = now + 0.1 end

			local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
			local size = Vector3.new(math.max(block.sizeX, 0.05), math.max(block.sizeY, 0.05), math.max(block.sizeZ, 0.05))
			for model, state in pairs(block.units) do
				local root = model.Parent and rootOf(model)
				if not root then
					remove(model)
				else
					-- walking = how fast it really moves (works for tweened / scripted movement too)
					if doState then
						local position = root.Position
						local elapsed = now - state.lastTime
						if state.lastPos and elapsed > 0 then
							state.speed = Vector3.new(position.X - state.lastPos.X, 0, position.Z - state.lastPos.Z).Magnitude / elapsed
						end
						state.lastPos, state.lastTime = position, now
						local chosen = chooseEntry(model, state, state.covering, now)
						if chosen ~= state.entry then
							state.entry, state.since = chosen, now
							updateLook(state) -- this setting may have its own transparency
						end
					end

					-- the picture: a spritesheet (columns x rows, played at frames/s), or one image, or several IDs
					-- flipped through like frames. It is drawn the same way as the little preview on the setting.
					local entry = state.entry
					local ids = entry and entry.ids or {}
					local cells = entry and (entry.cols * entry.rows) or 1
					local source, sizeScale, offsetScale = "", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
					if entry and #ids > 0 then
						if cells > 1 then
							local total = (entry.frames > 0) and math.min(entry.frames, cells) or cells
							local frame = math.floor((now - state.since) * entry.fps) % total
							source = sourceOf(ids[1])
							sizeScale = UDim2.fromScale(entry.cols, entry.rows)
							local column, row = cellOf(entry, frame)
							offsetScale = UDim2.fromScale(-column, -row)
						else
							local index = 1
							if #ids > 1 then
								index = math.floor((now - state.since) * entry.fps) % #ids + 1
							end
							source = sourceOf(ids[index])
						end
					end
					for _, face in ipairs(state.sheets) do
						local image = face.image
						if image.Image ~= source then image.Image = source end
						if image.Size ~= sizeScale then image.Size = sizeScale end
						if image.Position ~= offsetScale then image.Position = offsetScale end
					end
					-- backup: if the picture could not be drawn on the block's faces within 2 seconds, a plain Decal gets it
					if source ~= state.source then
						state.source, state.sourceTime, state.decalOn = source, now, false
						for _, decal in ipairs(state.decals) do decal.Texture = "" end
					end
					state.loaded = state.sheets[1] and state.sheets[1].image.IsLoaded
					if source ~= "" and cells <= 1 and not state.loaded and not state.decalOn and now - state.sourceTime > 2 then
						state.decalOn = true
						for _, decal in ipairs(state.decals) do decal.Texture = source end
					end

					keepHidden(state) -- every frame, the game cannot show it again
					local current = state.entry
					local ownSize = Vector3.new(math.max(look(current, "sizeX"), 0.05), math.max(look(current, "sizeY"), 0.05), math.max(look(current, "sizeZ"), 0.05))
					if state.part.Size ~= ownSize then state.part.Size = ownSize end
					local ownRotation = rotationOf(current, state, frameTime)
					local position = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, look(current, "raise"), 0)
					if look(current, "faceCamera") and camera then
						local cameraPosition = camera.CFrame.Position
						state.part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, Vector3.new(cameraPosition.X, position.Y, cameraPosition.Z)) * ownRotation
					else
						state.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * (root.CFrame - root.CFrame.Position) * ownRotation
					end
				end
			end
		end
		RunService:BindToRenderStep("OscarBattlerBlock", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 5, function()
			local ok, err = pcall(renderStep)
			if not ok and not block.warned then
				block.warned = true
				warn("Oscars Cool Panel: battler sprites: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end)
	end

	local function refreshAll()
		for _, state in pairs(block.units) do updateLook(state) end
		for _, state in pairs(block.proj) do updateLook(state) end
	end

	-- ===== UI =====
	local drawer, _, refreshMain = addToggleCogRow(page, "Battler Sprite's (image block replaces a battler)", function()
		return block.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then start() else stop() end
	end)
	-- the Custom Spawner can load a code for one battler kind: the main row has to be on for it to do anything
	block.autoOn = function()
		if not block.on then
			start()
			if refreshMain then refreshMain() end
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local topRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "")
	local countLabel = topRow:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	local addButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		Text = "+ ADD",
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		TextSize = 12,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	}, topRow)
	outline(addButton)
	if countLabel then countLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, 0) end

	local status = make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "",
		TextColor3 = WHITE,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, drawer)

	local liveLabel = make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "Live: switch the main row ON",
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120),
		TextSize = 12,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, drawer)

	local function number(label, key, low, high, default)
		addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, label), tostring(block[key]), function(box)
			local value = tonumber(box.Text)
			block[key] = value and math.clamp(value, low, high) or default
			box.Text = tostring(block[key])
			refreshAll()
		end)
	end
	number("Block width (studs)", "sizeX", 0, 200, 5)
	number("Block height (studs)", "sizeY", 0, 200, 6)
	number("Block depth (studs)", "sizeZ", 0, 200, 1)
	number("Raise the block (studs)", "raise", -50, 50, 0)
	number("Block see-through (0 solid - 1 invisible)", "blockTransparency", 0, 1, 0)
	number("Image see-through (0 solid - 1 invisible)", "imageTransparency", 0, 1, 0)
	number("Spin speed (turns/second, e.g. 0.5 - negative = other way)", "spin", -20, 20, 0)
	number("Rotate by (degrees, negative = other way)", "angle", -360, 360, 0)
	addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, "Always face the camera"), function()
		return block.faceCamera
	end, function(value)
		block.faceCamera = value
	end)

	local AXIS_NAMES = { "Up (like a turntable)", "Roll (flat, like a wheel)", "Tilt (forwards / back)" }
	local axisRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Rotate around")
	local axisButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		Text = AXIS_NAMES[block.axis],
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		TextSize = 11,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	}, axisRow)
	outline(axisButton)
	listen(axisButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		block.axis = block.axis % #AXIS_NAMES + 1
		axisButton.Text = AXIS_NAMES[block.axis]
	end)
	block.refreshAxis = function() axisButton.Text = AXIS_NAMES[block.axis] end

	local list = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, drawer)
	make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, list)

	local function refreshCount()
		if countLabel then
			countLabel.Text = "Sprite settings: " .. tostring(#block.entries) .. " / " .. tostring(MAX_ENTRIES)
		end
	end
	refreshCount()

	local TEAM_LABELS = { [0] = "RED enemies", [1] = "BLUE units", [2] = "BOTH teams" }

	local function column(holderParent, x, width, label)
		local holder = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(width, 0, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		}, holderParent)
		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = label,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 11,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, holder)
		return holder
	end
	local function textBox(holder, text, size, commit)
		local input = make("TextBox", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 24),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 22),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = size or 14,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = text,
			ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		}, holder)
		outline(input)
		listen(input.FocusLost, function()
			commit(input)
		end)
		return input
	end
	local function cellButton(holder, text, onClick)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 24),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 22),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, holder)
		outline(button)
		listen(button.MouseButton1Click, function()
			onClick(button)
		end)
		return button
	end

	-- ===== size & look rows, shared by every sprite setting and every projectile setting =====
	-- (a blank box = use the main settings above; a projectile uses its own defaults)
	local AXIS_SHORT = { "Up", "Roll", "Tilt" }
	local function buildLookRows(box, entry, firstOrder, isProjectile)
		local function overrideBox(holder, x, width, label, key, low, high, fallback)
			local input = textBox(column(holder, x, width, label), entry[key] ~= nil and tostring(entry[key]) or "", 13, function(input)
				local value = tonumber(input.Text)
				entry[key] = value and math.clamp(value, low, high) or fallback
				input.Text = entry[key] ~= nil and tostring(entry[key]) or ""
				refreshAll()
				block.scanAt = 0
			end)
			input.PlaceholderText = isProjectile and "default" or "main"
			input.PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY
			return input
		end

		-- row A: sheet direction (sprites only) + the two transparencies
		local rowA = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundColor3 = GRAY, LayoutOrder = firstOrder }, box)
		outline(rowA)
		if isProjectile then
			overrideBox(rowA, 0, 0.5, "Block see-through (0-1)", "blockTransparency", 0, 1, nil)
			overrideBox(rowA, 0.5, 0.5, "Picture see-through (0-1)", "imageTransparency", 0, 1, nil)
		else
			cellButton(column(rowA, 0, 0.3, "Sheet plays"), DIRECTIONS[entry.dir or 1], function(button)
				entry.dir = (entry.dir or 1) % #DIRECTIONS + 1
				button.Text = DIRECTIONS[entry.dir]
				for _, state in pairs(block.units) do state.since = os.clock() end
			end)
			overrideBox(rowA, 0.3, 0.35, "Block see-through", "blockTransparency", 0, 1, nil)
			overrideBox(rowA, 0.65, 0.35, "Picture see-through", "imageTransparency", 0, 1, nil)
		end

		-- row B: size + height
		local rowB = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundColor3 = GRAY, LayoutOrder = firstOrder + 1 }, box)
		outline(rowB)
		overrideBox(rowB, 0, 0.25, "Width", "sizeX", 0.05, 200, isProjectile and 2 or nil)
		overrideBox(rowB, 0.25, 0.25, "Height", "sizeY", 0.05, 200, isProjectile and 2 or nil)
		overrideBox(rowB, 0.5, 0.25, "Depth", "sizeZ", 0.05, 200, nil)
		overrideBox(rowB, 0.75, 0.25, "Raise", "raise", -50, 50, nil)

		-- row C: rotation + facing
		local rowC = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundColor3 = GRAY, LayoutOrder = firstOrder + 2 }, box)
		outline(rowC)
		overrideBox(rowC, 0, 0.2, "Spin/s", "spin", -20, 20, nil)
		overrideBox(rowC, 0.2, 0.2, "Angle", "angle", -360, 360, nil)
		local function axisText()
			return entry.axis and AXIS_SHORT[entry.axis] or (isProjectile and "Roll*" or "main")
		end
		cellButton(column(rowC, 0.4, 0.28, "Rotate"), axisText(), function(button)
			if entry.axis == nil then
				entry.axis = 1
			elseif entry.axis >= 3 then
				entry.axis = nil
			else
				entry.axis = entry.axis + 1
			end
			button.Text = axisText()
		end)
		local function faceText()
			if entry.faceCamera == nil then return isProjectile and "ON*" or "main" end
			return entry.faceCamera and "ON" or "OFF"
		end
		cellButton(column(rowC, 0.68, 0.32, "Face you"), faceText(), function(button)
			if entry.faceCamera == nil then
				entry.faceCamera = true
			elseif entry.faceCamera == true then
				entry.faceCamera = false
			else
				entry.faceCamera = nil
			end
			button.Text = faceText()
		end)
	end

	local function addEntry(init)
		if #block.entries >= MAX_ENTRIES then
			status.Text = "That is the maximum: " .. tostring(MAX_ENTRIES) .. " settings."
			return
		end
		local entry = { enabled = true, id = 0, name = "", team = 2, typeIndex = 1, keys = TYPES[1].keys, sprite = "", ids = {}, fps = 8, cols = 1, rows = 1, frames = 0, dir = 1 }
		if type(init) == "table" then
			for key, value in pairs(init) do entry[key] = value end
		end
		entry.ids = parseIds(entry.sprite)
		table.insert(block.entries, entry)
		block.scanAt = 0

		local box = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = #block.entries,
		}, list)
		make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, box)

		local header = addGrayRow(box, "")
		local title = header:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if title then
			title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0)
			title.TextSize = 12
			title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		end
		local function refreshHeader()
			local index = table.find(block.entries, entry) or 0
			if title then
				title.Text = "Sprite " .. tostring(index) .. "  -  " .. TYPES[entry.typeIndex].name .. "  -  "
					.. ((entry.name or "") ~= "" and ('"' .. entry.name .. '"') or (entry.id > 0 and ("ID " .. tostring(entry.id)) or "every battler")) .. "  -  " .. TEAM_LABELS[entry.team]
			end
			header.BackgroundColor3 = entry.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(200, 225, 200) or GRAY
		end
		entry.refreshHeader = refreshHeader

		local switchButton = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 26),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0.5, 0),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = "",
		}, header)
		outline(switchButton)
		local function refreshSwitch()
			switchButton.Text = entry.enabled and "ON" or "OFF"
			switchButton.BackgroundColor3 = entry.enabled and ON_COLOR or WHITE
		end
		refreshSwitch()
		listen(switchButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			entry.enabled = not entry.enabled
			refreshSwitch()
			refreshHeader()
			block.scanAt = 0
		end)

		local removeButton = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 26),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 90, 90),
			Text = "X",
			TextColor3 = WHITE,
			TextSize = 13,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, header)
		outline(removeButton)
		entry.remove = function()
			local index = table.find(block.entries, entry)
			if index then table.remove(block.entries, index) end
			box:Destroy()
			for _, other in ipairs(block.entries) do other.refreshHeader() end
			refreshCount()
			block.scanAt = 0
		end
		listen(removeButton.MouseButton1Click, entry.remove)

		-- row 1: unit ID | sprite ID(s) | frames per second | team
		local fields = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundColor3 = GRAY, LayoutOrder = 2 }, box)
		outline(fields)
		-- a number = the unit / enemy ID, anything else = its NAME (part of the name is enough, commas for several)
		textBox(column(fields, 0, 0.24, "ID / name (0=all)"), (entry.name or "") ~= "" and entry.name or tostring(entry.id), 12, function(input)
			local text = string.match(input.Text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
			local value = tonumber(text)
			if value then
				entry.id, entry.name = (value > 0) and math.floor(value) or 0, ""
			elseif text ~= "" then
				entry.id, entry.name = 0, text
			else
				entry.id, entry.name = 0, ""
			end
			input.Text = entry.name ~= "" and entry.name or tostring(entry.id)
			refreshHeader()
			block.scanAt = 0
		end)
		textBox(column(fields, 0.24, 0.34, "Asset ID(s)"), entry.sprite, 12, function(input)
			entry.sprite = input.Text
			entry.ids = parseIds(input.Text)
			input.Text = table.concat(entry.ids, ", ")
			entry.sprite = input.Text
		end)
		textBox(column(fields, 0.58, 0.14, "Frames/s"), tostring(entry.fps), 14, function(input)
			local value = tonumber(input.Text)
			if not value then
				entry.fps = 8
			else
				value = math.clamp(value, -60, 60) -- negative = the frames play backwards, 0 = frozen on the first frame
				if value ~= 0 and math.abs(value) < 0.1 then value = value > 0 and 0.1 or -0.1 end
				entry.fps = value
			end
			input.Text = tostring(entry.fps)
		end)
		cellButton(column(fields, 0.72, 0.28, "Goes on"), TEAM_LABELS[entry.team], function(button)
			entry.team = (entry.team + 1) % 3
			button.Text = TEAM_LABELS[entry.team]
			refreshHeader()
			block.scanAt = 0
		end)

		-- row 2: animation kind | the words the scanner looks for
		local fields2 = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundColor3 = GRAY, LayoutOrder = 3 }, box)
		outline(fields2)
		local keysInput
		cellButton(column(fields2, 0, 0.28, "Plays during"), TYPES[entry.typeIndex].name, function(button)
			entry.typeIndex = entry.typeIndex % #TYPES + 1
			button.Text = TYPES[entry.typeIndex].name
			if entry.typeIndex ~= 4 then
				entry.keys = TYPES[entry.typeIndex].keys
				if keysInput then keysInput.Text = entry.keys end
			end
			refreshHeader()
		end)
		keysInput = textBox(column(fields2, 0.28, 0.72, "Animation name words (comma)"), entry.keys, 12, function(input)
			entry.keys = input.Text
		end)

		-- row 3: spritesheet layout + a live preview of what the edited sprite looks like
		local fields3 = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 76), BackgroundColor3 = GRAY, LayoutOrder = 4 }, box)
		outline(fields3)
		local function sheetBox(x, width, label, key, low, high, default)
			textBox(column(fields3, x, width, label), tostring(entry[key]), 14, function(input)
				local value = tonumber(input.Text)
				entry[key] = value and math.clamp(math.floor(value), low, high) or default
				input.Text = tostring(entry[key])
				for _, state in pairs(block.units) do state.since = os.clock() end
			end)
		end
		sheetBox(0, 0.2, "Columns", "cols", 1, 64, 1)
		sheetBox(0.2, 0.2, "Rows", "rows", 1, 64, 1)
		sheetBox(0.4, 0.26, "Frames (0=all)", "frames", 0, 4096, 0)
		local previewFrame = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 225),
			ClipsDescendants = true,
		}, fields3)
		outline(previewFrame)
		local previewImage = make("ImageLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		}, previewFrame)
		entry.previewImage = previewImage

		buildLookRows(box, entry, 5, false)

		refreshHeader()
		refreshCount()
		return entry
	end

	-- ===== live preview on every setting: plays the sheet / frames exactly like the battler's block will =====
	listen(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if block.on then
			local covered, drawn, withPicture = 0, 0, 0
			for _, state in pairs(block.units) do
				covered += 1
				if state.loaded then drawn += 1 end
				if state.source and state.source ~= "" then withPicture += 1 end
			end
			liveLabel.Text = "Live: " .. covered .. " battler(s) covered, " .. withPicture .. " with a picture, " .. drawn .. " picture(s) loaded"
				.. (block.warned and "  (error - see console)" or "")
		else
			liveLabel.Text = "Live: switch the main row ON"
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(block.entries) do
			local image = entry.previewImage
			if image and image.Parent then
				local ids = entry.ids
				if #ids == 0 then
					if image.Image ~= "" then image.Image = "" end
				else
					local cells = entry.cols * entry.rows
					local sizeScale, offsetScale, source = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), nil
					if cells > 1 then
						local total = (entry.frames > 0) and math.min(entry.frames, cells) or cells
						local frame = math.floor(now * entry.fps) % total
						sizeScale = UDim2.fromScale(entry.cols, entry.rows)
						local column, row = cellOf(entry, frame)
						offsetScale = UDim2.fromScale(-column, -row)
						source = sourceOf(ids[1])
					else
						local index = #ids > 1 and (math.floor(now * entry.fps) % #ids + 1) or 1
						source = sourceOf(ids[index])
					end
					if image.Image ~= source then image.Image = source end
					if image.Size ~= sizeScale then image.Size = sizeScale end
					if image.Position ~= offsetScale then image.Position = offsetScale end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- ===== hiding extras + projectiles (UI) =====
	addGrayRow(drawer, "HIDING  -  what a replaced battler leaves behind")
	local refreshKeep = addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, "Keep health bars / name tags (main row off and on to apply)"), function()
		return block.keepBars
	end, function(value)
		block.keepBars = value
		block.scanAt = 0
	end)
	local hideRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Also hide these objects (names, comma)")
	local hideLabel = hideRow:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	if hideLabel then
		hideLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 1, 0)
		hideLabel.TextSize = 12
	end
	local hideBox = make("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		PlaceholderText = "e.g. Clock, Rays",
		PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY,
		Text = block.hideNames,
		TextSize = 12,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
	}, hideRow)
	outline(hideBox)
	listen(hideBox.FocusLost, function()
		block.hideNames = hideBox.Text
		block.scanAt = 0
	end)
	block.refreshHideUi = function()
		hideBox.Text = block.hideNames
		refreshKeep()
	end

	local projTop = addGrayRow(drawer, "")
	local projCount = projTop:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	if projCount then projCount.Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, 0) end
	local function smallButton(parent, text, offset, width, color)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 24),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = color or WHITE,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, parent)
		outline(button)
		return button
	end
	local projAddButton = smallButton(projTop, "+ ADD", 8, 56)
	local scanButton = smallButton(projTop, "SCAN 8s", 70, 72)
	local scanStatus = make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "",
		TextColor3 = WHITE,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, drawer)
	local scanResults = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, drawer)
	make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, scanResults)
	local projList = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, drawer)
	make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, projList)

	local function refreshProjCount()
		if projCount then
			projCount.Text = "Projectile settings: " .. tostring(#block.projectiles) .. " / " .. tostring(MAX_ENTRIES)
		end
	end
