	local addProjectile
	function addProjectile(init)
		if #block.projectiles >= MAX_ENTRIES then
			status.Text = "That is the maximum: " .. tostring(MAX_ENTRIES) .. " projectile settings."
			return
		end
		local entry = { enabled = true, name = "", sprite = "", ids = {}, sizeX = 2, sizeY = 2 }
		if type(init) == "table" then
			for key, value in pairs(init) do entry[key] = value end
		end
		entry.ids = parseIds(entry.sprite)
		table.insert(block.projectiles, entry)
		block.projDirty = true

		local box = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = #block.projectiles,
		}, projList)
		make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, box)

		local header = addGrayRow(box, "")
		header.LayoutOrder = 1
		local title = header:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if title then
			title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0)
			title.TextSize = 12
			title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		end
		local function refreshHeader()
			local index = table.find(block.projectiles, entry) or 0
			if title then
				title.Text = "Projectile " .. tostring(index) .. "  -  " .. ((entry.name or "") ~= "" and entry.name or "(type its name)")
			end
			header.BackgroundColor3 = entry.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(200, 225, 200) or GRAY
		end
		local switchButton = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 26),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0.5, 0),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = "",
		}, header)
		outline(switchButton)
		local function refreshSwitch()
			switchButton.Text = entry.enabled and "ON" or "OFF"
			switchButton.BackgroundColor3 = entry.enabled and ON_COLOR or WHITE
		end
		refreshSwitch()
		listen(switchButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			entry.enabled = not entry.enabled
			refreshSwitch()
			refreshHeader()
			block.projDirty = true
		end)
		local removeButton = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 26),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 90, 90),
			Text = "X",
			TextColor3 = WHITE,
			TextSize = 13,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, header)
		outline(removeButton)
		entry.remove = function()
			local index = table.find(block.projectiles, entry)
			if index then table.remove(block.projectiles, index) end
			box:Destroy()
			block.projDirty = true
			block.scanAt = 0
			refreshProjCount()
		end
		listen(removeButton.MouseButton1Click, entry.remove)

		local fields = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundColor3 = GRAY, LayoutOrder = 2 }, box)
		outline(fields)
		textBox(column(fields, 0, 0.5, "Object name(s)"), entry.name, 12, function(input)
			entry.name = string.match(input.Text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
			input.Text = entry.name
			block.projDirty = true
			block.scanAt = 0
			refreshHeader()
		end)
		textBox(column(fields, 0.5, 0.5, "Asset ID(s) (blank = hide)"), entry.sprite, 12, function(input)
			entry.sprite = input.Text
			entry.ids = parseIds(input.Text)
			input.Text = table.concat(entry.ids, ", ")
			entry.sprite = input.Text
		end)
		buildLookRows(box, entry, 3, true)

		refreshHeader()
		refreshProjCount()
		return entry
	end
	listen(projAddButton.MouseButton1Click, function() addProjectile() end)

	-- ===== the scanner: what new objects show up while the enemy attacks? =====
	local scan = { active = false, counts = {}, conn = nil }
	local function showScanResults()
		for _, child in ipairs(scanResults:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
		end
		local names = {}
		for name, info in pairs(scan.counts) do
			table.insert(names, { name = name, count = info.count, class = info.class })
		end
		table.sort(names, function(a, b)
			if a.count ~= b.count then return a.count > b.count end
			return a.name < b.name
		end)
		if #names == 0 then
			scanStatus.Text = "Nothing new appeared. Press SCAN again and make the enemy shoot / attack while it runs."
			return
		end
		scanStatus.Text = "Found " .. tostring(#names) .. " kind(s) of new objects. SPRITE = replace it with a picture, HIDE = make it invisible."
		for index = 1, math.min(#names, 15) do
			local item = names[index]
			local row = addGrayRow(scanResults, item.name .. "   x" .. tostring(item.count) .. "  (" .. item.class .. ")")
			row.LayoutOrder = index
			local label = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
			if label then
				label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, 0)
				label.TextSize = 11
				label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			end
			local spriteButton = smallButton(row, "SPRITE", 8, 62, ON_COLOR)
			local hideButton = smallButton(row, "HIDE", 76, 56)
			listen(spriteButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
				addProjectile({ name = item.name })
				status.Text = "Added a projectile setting for \"" .. item.name .. "\". Type its picture ID there."
			end)
			listen(hideButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
				local current = block.hideNames or ""
				if not string.find(string.lower(current), string.lower(item.name), 1, true) then
					block.hideNames = (current ~= "" and (current .. ", ") or "") .. item.name
					hideBox.Text = block.hideNames
					block.scanAt = 0
				end
				status.Text = "\"" .. item.name .. "\" is on the hide list."
			end)
		end
	end
	listen(scanButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		if scan.active then return end
		scan.active, scan.counts = true, {}
		scanStatus.Text = "Scanning for 8 seconds ... let the enemy shoot / attack now!"
		scan.conn = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			if not (object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("Model")) or object:IsA("Terrain") then return end
			local name = object.Name
			if string.sub(name, 1, 5) == "Oscar" then return end
			local parent = object.Parent
			if parent and parent ~= Workspace and parent:IsA("Model") then return end -- only the top object of a thing
			if insideUnits(object) then return end
			if object:IsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(object) then return end
			local info = scan.counts[name]
			if not info then
				info = { count = 0, class = object.ClassName }
				scan.counts[name] = info
			end
			info.count = info.count + 1
		end)
		task.delay(8, function()
			if scan.conn then
				scan.conn:Disconnect()
				scan.conn = nil
			end
			scan.active = false
			if not destroyed then showScanResults() end
		end)
	end)


	-- ===== save / load =====
	local function clean(text)
		return (string.gsub(text or "", "[|~]", ""))
	end
	local function optText(value)
		return value == nil and "" or tostring(value)
	end
	local function triText(value)
		if value == nil then return "" end
		return value and "1" or "0"
	end
	local function triState(text)
		if text == "1" then return true end
		if text == "0" then return false end
		return nil
	end
	local function numberOr(text, low, high)
		local value = tonumber(text)
		return value and math.clamp(value, low, high) or nil
	end
	local function serializeSprites()
		local rows = {
			table.concat({ "G", block.sizeX, block.sizeY, block.sizeZ, block.raise, block.blockTransparency,
				block.imageTransparency, block.faceCamera and 1 or 0, block.spin, block.angle, block.axis }, "~"),
		}
		for _, entry in ipairs(block.entries) do
			rows[#rows + 1] = table.concat({
				"E", entry.enabled and 1 or 0, entry.team, entry.id, entry.typeIndex, clean(entry.keys), clean(entry.sprite), entry.fps,
				entry.cols, entry.rows, entry.frames, clean(entry.name), entry.dir or 1,
				optText(entry.sizeX), optText(entry.sizeY), optText(entry.sizeZ), optText(entry.raise), optText(entry.blockTransparency),
				optText(entry.imageTransparency), optText(entry.spin), optText(entry.angle), optText(entry.axis), triText(entry.faceCamera),
			}, "~")
		end
		for _, projectile in ipairs(block.projectiles) do
			rows[#rows + 1] = table.concat({
				"P", projectile.enabled and 1 or 0, clean(projectile.name), clean(projectile.sprite), projectile.sizeX, projectile.sizeY,
				optText(projectile.sizeZ), optText(projectile.raise), optText(projectile.blockTransparency), optText(projectile.imageTransparency),
				optText(projectile.spin), optText(projectile.angle), optText(projectile.axis), triText(projectile.faceCamera),
			}, "~")
		end
		rows[#rows + 1] = table.concat({ "H", clean(block.hideNames), block.keepBars and 1 or 0 }, "~")
		local body = Custom.encodeBase64(table.concat(rows, "|"))
		return "OSB1" .. body .. Custom.checksum(body)
	end
	local function parseSprites(code)
		code = string.gsub(code or "", "%s", "")
		if string.sub(code, 1, 4) ~= "OSB1" or #code < 5 then
			return false, "That is not a valid sprite code."
		end
		local body = string.sub(code, 5, #code - 1)
		if Custom.checksum(body) ~= string.sub(code, #code) then
			return false, "The code is damaged (a character is wrong or missing)."
		end
		local ok, decoded = pcall(decodeBase64, body)
		if not ok or decoded == "" then return false, "The code could not be read." end
		local globals, list, projectileList, hideRow = nil, {}, {}, nil
		for _, row in ipairs(string.split(decoded, "|")) do
			local f = string.split(row, "~")
			if f[1] == "G" then
				globals = f
			elseif f[1] == "H" then
				hideRow = f
			elseif f[1] == "P" then
				if #f < 6 then return false, "The code could not be read." end
				if #projectileList < MAX_ENTRIES then
					projectileList[#projectileList + 1] = {
						enabled = f[2] == "1",
						name = f[3] or "",
						sprite = f[4] or "",
						sizeX = math.clamp(tonumber(f[5]) or 2, 0.05, 200),
						sizeY = math.clamp(tonumber(f[6]) or 2, 0.05, 200),
						sizeZ = numberOr(f[7], 0.05, 200),
						raise = numberOr(f[8], -50, 50),
						blockTransparency = numberOr(f[9], 0, 1),
						imageTransparency = numberOr(f[10], 0, 1),
						spin = numberOr(f[11], -20, 20),
						angle = numberOr(f[12], -360, 360),
						axis = numberOr(f[13], 1, 3),
						faceCamera = triState(f[14]),
					}
				end
			elseif f[1] == "E" then
				if #f < 8 then return false, "The code could not be read." end
				local typeIndex = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(f[5]) or 1), 1, #TYPES)
				list[#list + 1] = {
					enabled = f[2] == "1",
					team = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(f[3]) or 2), 0, 2),
					id = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(f[4]) or 0)),
					name = f[12] or "", -- older codes have no names
					typeIndex = typeIndex,
					keys = f[6] or TYPES[typeIndex].keys,
					sprite = f[7] or "",
					fps = math.clamp(tonumber(f[8]) or 8, -60, 60),
					cols = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(f[9]) or 1), 1, 64), -- older codes have no sheet fields
					rows = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(f[10]) or 1), 1, 64),
					frames = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(f[11]) or 0), 0, 4096),
					dir = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(f[13]) or 1), 1, 4), -- older codes read the sheet to the right
					sizeX = numberOr(f[14], 0.05, 200),
					sizeY = numberOr(f[15], 0.05, 200),
					sizeZ = numberOr(f[16], 0.05, 200),
					raise = numberOr(f[17], -50, 50),
					blockTransparency = numberOr(f[18], 0, 1),
					imageTransparency = numberOr(f[19], 0, 1),
					spin = numberOr(f[20], -20, 20),
					angle = numberOr(f[21], -360, 360),
					axis = numberOr(f[22], 1, 3),
					faceCamera = triState(f[23]),
				}
				if #list >= MAX_ENTRIES then break end
			else
				return false, "The code could not be read."
			end
		end
		return list, globals, { projectiles = projectileList, hide = hideRow }
	end
	local function loadSprites(code)
		local list, globals, extras = parseSprites(code)
		if not list then return false, globals end -- the second value is the problem text
		if globals then
			block.sizeX = math.clamp(tonumber(globals[2]) or 5, 0, 200)
			block.sizeY = math.clamp(tonumber(globals[3]) or 6, 0, 200)
			block.sizeZ = math.clamp(tonumber(globals[4]) or 1, 0, 200)
			block.raise = math.clamp(tonumber(globals[5]) or 0, -50, 50)
			block.blockTransparency = math.clamp(tonumber(globals[6]) or 0, 0, 1)
			block.imageTransparency = math.clamp(tonumber(globals[7]) or 0, 0, 1)
			block.faceCamera = globals[8] == "1"
			block.spin = math.clamp(tonumber(globals[9]) or 0, -20, 20) -- older codes have no rotation
			block.angle = math.clamp(tonumber(globals[10]) or 0, -360, 360)
			block.axis = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(globals[11]) or 1), 1, 3)
			if block.refreshAxis then block.refreshAxis() end
		end
		while #block.entries > 0 do
			block.entries[#block.entries].remove()
		end
		for _, init in ipairs(list) do
			addEntry(init)
		end
		-- projectile settings + the hide list that came with the code
		while #block.projectiles > 0 do
			block.projectiles[#block.projectiles].remove()
		end
		for _, init in ipairs(extras.projectiles) do
			addProjectile(init)
		end
		if extras.hide then
			block.hideNames = extras.hide[2] or ""
			block.keepBars = extras.hide[3] ~= "0"
			if block.refreshHideUi then block.refreshHideUi() end
		end
		block.scanAt, block.projDirty = 0, true
		refreshAll()
		return true, #list + #extras.projectiles
	end

	-- Custom Spawner: puts the picture rows of a sprite SAVE code onto ONE kind of battler (its ID + side), next to the
	-- settings that are already there. The block size / rotation inside a code are skipped (they stay as you set them).
	-- Loading the same code again does nothing; a changed code replaces the old rows.
	function Custom.spriteMerge(code, unitId, ally)
		local list, problem = parseSprites(code)
		if not list then return false, problem end
		local tag = tostring(unitId) .. (ally and "A" or "E")
		local old = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(block.entries) do
			if entry.spawnTag == tag then table.insert(old, entry) end
		end
		if #old > 0 and old[1].spawnCode == code then return true, 0 end
		for _, entry in ipairs(old) do entry.remove() end
		local added = 0
		for _, init in ipairs(list) do
			init.id, init.name, init.team, init.enabled = unitId, "", ally and 1 or 0, true
			init.spawnTag, init.spawnCode = tag, code
			local count = #block.entries
			addEntry(init)
			if #block.entries > count then added = added + 1 end
		end
		refreshAll()
		if added > 0 and block.autoOn then block.autoOn() end
		return true, added
	end
	Custom.spriteSerialize, Custom.spriteLoad = serializeSprites, loadSprites
	Custom.spriteCount = function() return #block.entries end

	local saveRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Save / Load sprites")
	local function saveButton(text, offset)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 24),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, saveRow)
		outline(button)
		return button
	end
	local loadButton = saveButton("LOAD", 8)
	local saveCodeButton = saveButton("SAVE", 68)
	local codeRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Code")
	local codeBox = make("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		PlaceholderText = "save to get a code / paste one here",
		PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY,
		Text = "",
		TextSize = 12,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		Font = Enum.Font.Code,
	}, codeRow)
	outline(codeBox)
	listen(saveCodeButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		local code = serializeSprites()
		codeBox.Text = code
		status.Text = Custom.copy(code) and "Saved! The code is in the box and copied to your clipboard." or "Saved! Copy the code from the box."
	end)
	listen(loadButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		local ok, result = loadSprites(codeBox.Text)
		status.Text = ok and ("Loaded " .. tostring(result) .. " sprite setting(s).") or ("Could not load: " .. tostring(result))
	end)

	listen(addButton.MouseButton1Click, function() addEntry() end)
	addEntry()
end)

-- Mesh Changer (Misc tab): like the sprite / decal block, but the battler becomes a MESH. Pick battlers by ID or name,
-- paste a mesh ID (and a texture ID), choose WHICH BODY PARTS change (the whole battler or only head / torso / arms / legs),
-- and give it a WEAPON mesh that appears in its hand. The mesh and the weapon can also stay on the DEATH (the corpse / the
-- Death Effects custom death). Only YOU see it (the game's own battler is hidden for you).
safeBuild("Mesh Changer", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
	local fx = Custom.fx or { hideObject = function() end, keepHidden = function() end, restoreState = function() end }
	local MAX_ENTRIES = 100
	local TEAM_SHORT = { [0] = "Enemies", [1] = "Units", [2] = "Both" }
	local TEAM_LABELS = { [0] = "RED enemies", [1] = "BLUE units", [2] = "BOTH teams" }
	local PALETTE = { "", "FF3B3B", "34A0FF", "45E06A", "B455FF", "FF9628", "FF66C4", "F5E6A0", "3A3A3A" }
	local HAND_NAMES = { "Right", "Left" }
	-- the body parts you can pick (R6 and R15 names); the mesh sits on the first one found, ALL of them are hidden
	local GROUPS = {
		{ key = "head", label = "Head", names = { "Head" } },
		{ key = "torso", label = "Torso", names = { "Torso", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso" } },
		{ key = "larm", label = "L Arm", names = { "Left Arm", "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand" } },
		{ key = "rarm", label = "R Arm", names = { "Right Arm", "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm", "RightHand" } },
		{ key = "lleg", label = "L Leg", names = { "Left Leg", "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot" } },
		{ key = "rleg", label = "R Leg", names = { "Right Leg", "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot" } },
	}
	local HANDS = {
		{ "RightHand", "Right Arm", "RightLowerArm", "RightUpperArm" },
		{ "LeftHand", "Left Arm", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftUpperArm" },
	}

	local meshes = {
		on = false, entries = {}, units = {}, clones = {}, scanAt = 0, bound = false, lastRender = nil,
		last = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), -- model -> the setting that covered it while it was alive
		forced = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), -- model -> a setting given to exactly this battler (Spawn Battler)
	}
	Custom.meshChanger = meshes

	-- ===== colours: blank = the mesh keeps its own colours; otherwise HEX (FF9628) or R,G,B =====
	local function parseColor(text)
		local cleaned = string.gsub(tostring(text or ""), "%s", "")
		local hex = string.match(cleaned, "^#?(%x%x%x%x%x%x)$")
		if hex then return string.upper(hex) end
		local r, g, b = string.match(cleaned, "^(%d+),(%d+),(%d+)$")
		if r then
			return string.format("%02X%02X%02X", math.clamp(tonumber(r), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(g), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(b), 0, 255))
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function toColor(hex)
		local cleaned = parseColor(hex)
		if not cleaned then return Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
		return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(string.sub(cleaned, 1, 2), 16), tonumber(string.sub(cleaned, 3, 4), 16), tonumber(string.sub(cleaned, 5, 6), 16))
	end

	-- ===== asset IDs: 12345, rbxassetid://12345, roblox.com/asset/?id=12345 =====
	local function parseId(text)
		local id = string.match(tostring(text or ""), "id=(%d+)") or string.match(tostring(text or ""), "%d+")
		return id and math.floor(tonumber(id)) or 0
	end

	-- A mesh ID can be a plain Mesh asset, or a model asset (a catalog accessory / MeshPart) that holds the real mesh and its
	-- texture. The real ones are looked up once (GetObjects) and cached; until then the plain ID is used.
	local resolvedMesh, pendingMesh = {}, {}
	local function resolveMesh(id)
		local known = resolvedMesh[id]
		if known then return known[1], known[2] end
		if not pendingMesh[id] then
			pendingMesh[id] = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local meshUrl, textureUrl = "rbxassetid://" .. id, nil
				local ok, objects = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. id) end)
				if ok and type(objects) == "table" then
					for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
						local found
						pcall(function()
							if object:IsA("MeshPart") then
								found = { object.MeshId, object.TextureID }
							elseif object:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
								found = { object.MeshId, object.TextureId }
							else
								local part = object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart", true)
								if part then
									found = { part.MeshId, part.TextureID }
								else
									local special = object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh", true)
									if special then found = { special.MeshId, special.TextureId } end
								end
							end
						end)
						if found and found[1] ~= "" then
							meshUrl = found[1]
							if found[2] ~= "" then textureUrl = found[2] end
							break
						end
					end
					for _, object in ipairs(objects) do pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
				end
				pcall(function() ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ meshUrl }) end)
				resolvedMesh[id] = { meshUrl, textureUrl }
			end)
		end
		return "rbxassetid://" .. id, nil
	end

	-- a texture ID can be an image, or a Decal asset that holds the real image
	local resolvedTexture, pendingTexture = {}, {}
	local function resolveTexture(id)
		local known = resolvedTexture[id]
		if known then return known end
		if not pendingTexture[id] then
			pendingTexture[id] = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local final = "rbxassetid://" .. id
				local ok, objects = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. id) end)
				if ok and type(objects) == "table" then
					for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
						local texture
						pcall(function()
							if object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then
								texture = object.Texture
							elseif object:IsA("ImageLabel") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
								texture = object.Image
							end
						end)
						if texture and texture ~= "" then
							final = texture
							break
						end
					end
					for _, object in ipairs(objects) do pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
				end
				pcall(function() ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ final }) end)
				resolvedTexture[id] = final
			end)
		end
		return "rbxassetid://" .. id
	end

	-- ===== which battler does a setting cover (ID or name) =====
	local nameCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local function namesOf(model)
		local cached = nameCache[model]
		if cached and os.clock() - cached.time < 3 then return cached.list end
		local list = { string.lower(model.Name) }
		for attribute, value in pairs(model:GetAttributes()) do
			if type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
				local lowered = string.lower(attribute)
				if lowered == "name" or lowered == "displayname" or lowered == "unitname" or lowered == "enemyname" or lowered == "title" then
					table.insert(list, string.lower(value))
				end
			end
		end
		local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and humanoid.DisplayName ~= "" then table.insert(list, string.lower(humanoid.DisplayName)) end
		nameCache[model] = { time = os.clock(), list = list }
		return list
	end
	local function nameMatches(model, text)
		local names = namesOf(model)
		for piece in string.gmatch(string.lower(text), "[^,]+") do
			local token = string.match(piece, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
			if token ~= "" then
				for _, name in ipairs(names) do
					if string.find(name, token, 1, true) then return true end
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	local function isSpecific(entry)
		return entry.id > 0 or entry.name ~= ""
	end
	local function covers(entry, model, isAlly)
		if not entry.enabled or (entry.meshId <= 0 and entry.weaponId <= 0) then return false end
		if entry.team ~= 2 and (entry.team == 1) ~= isAlly then return false end
		if entry.name ~= "" then
			return nameMatches(model, entry.name)
		end
		if entry.id > 0 and tonumber(model:GetAttribute("ID")) ~= entry.id then return false end
		return true
	end
	local function isAlive(model)
		if not model or not model.Parent then return false end
		local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		return not humanoid or humanoid.Health > 0
	end
	local function rootOf(model)
		return model.PrimaryPart
			or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			or model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
			or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
			or model:FindFirstChild("Head")
			or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
	end
	local function firstPart(model, names)
		for _, name in ipairs(names) do
			local found = model:FindFirstChild(name)
			if found and found:IsA("BasePart") then return found, name end
		end
		return nil, nil
	end

	-- ===== what a setting puts on a battler: the body mesh (whole battler or the chosen parts) and the weapon =====
	local function wantedItems(entry, flags)
		local list = {}
		if flags.mesh and entry.meshId > 0 then
			if entry.all then
				list[#list + 1] = { key = "body", kind = "body" }
			else
				for _, group in ipairs(GROUPS) do
					if entry[group.key] then list[#list + 1] = { key = group.key, kind = "group", group = group } end
				end
				for token in string.gmatch(entry.custom or "", "[^,]+") do
					token = string.match(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
					if token ~= "" then list[#list + 1] = { key = "c:" .. token, kind = "custom", partName = token } end
				end
			end
		end
		if flags.weapon and entry.weaponId > 0 then
			list[#list + 1] = { key = "weapon", kind = "weapon" }
		end
		return list
	end

	local function buildItem()
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = "OscarMeshChanger"
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		part.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
		mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
		mesh.Parent = part
		part.Parent = Workspace
		return { part = part, mesh = mesh }
	end
	local function clearItems(state)
		for _, item in pairs(state.items) do
			pcall(function() item.part:Destroy() end)
		end
		state.items, state.list, state.sig = {}, {}, ""
	end
	local function ensureItems(state, flags)
		local list = wantedItems(state.entry, flags)
		local keys = {}
		for _, spec in ipairs(list) do keys[#keys + 1] = spec.key end
		local sig = table.concat(keys, ",")
		if sig ~= state.sig then
			clearItems(state)
			for _, spec in ipairs(list) do state.items[spec.key] = buildItem() end
			state.sig = sig
		end
		state.list = list
	end

	-- puts every mesh of this battler (or corpse copy) where it belongs: the body mesh follows the root or the chosen parts,
	-- the weapon follows the hand - so a death animation moves them too
	local function drawItems(state, now, frameTime)
		local entry, model = state.entry, state.model
		state.spin = (state.spin + entry.spin * 360 * frameTime) % 360
		local fade = 0
		if state.fadeStart then
			fade = math.clamp((now - state.fadeStart) / math.max(state.fadeDur, 0.01), 0, 1)
		end
		for _, spec in ipairs(state.list) do
			local item = state.items[spec.key]
			if item then
				local target, targetName
				if spec.kind == "body" then
					target = rootOf(model)
				elseif spec.kind == "group" then
					target = firstPart(model, spec.group.names)
				elseif spec.kind == "custom" then
					local found = model:FindFirstChild(spec.partName, true)
					if found and found:IsA("BasePart") then target = found end
				else
					target, targetName = firstPart(model, HANDS[entry.hand] or HANDS[1])
					target = target or rootOf(model)
				end
				local part, mesh = item.part, item.mesh
				if not target then
					if part.Transparency ~= 1 then part.Transparency = 1 end
				else
					local meshId, textureId, scale, alpha, color, cframe
					if spec.kind == "weapon" then
						meshId, textureId = entry.weaponId, entry.weaponTex
						scale = Vector3.new(entry.wScale, entry.wScale, entry.wScale)
						alpha, color = 0, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
						local grip = (targetName == "Right Arm" or targetName == "Left Arm") and -1 or 0 -- R6 arms: the hand is at the bottom
						cframe = target.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, grip, 0) * CFrame.new(entry.wx, entry.wy, entry.wz)
							* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(entry.wrx), math.rad(entry.wry), math.rad(entry.wrz))
					else
						meshId, textureId = entry.meshId, entry.textureId
						scale = Vector3.new(entry.sx, entry.sy, entry.sz)
						alpha, color = entry.alpha, toColor(entry.color)
						cframe = target.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, entry.raise, -entry.forward) * CFrame.new(entry.mx or 0, entry.my or 0, entry.mz or 0)
							* CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(entry.rot + state.spin), 0)
							* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(entry.mrx or 0), math.rad(entry.mry or 0), math.rad(entry.mrz or 0))
					end
					local meshUrl, bundledTexture = resolveMesh(meshId)
					local textureUrl = textureId > 0 and resolveTexture(textureId) or bundledTexture or ""
					if mesh.MeshId ~= meshUrl then mesh.MeshId = meshUrl end
					if mesh.TextureId ~= textureUrl then mesh.TextureId = textureUrl end
					if mesh.Scale ~= scale then mesh.Scale = scale end
					alpha = alpha + (1 - alpha) * fade
					if part.Transparency ~= alpha then part.Transparency = alpha end
					if part.Color ~= color then part.Color = color end
					part.CFrame = cframe
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- ===== hiding the battler for you: the whole thing, or only the parts that were picked =====
	local function hideSignature(entry, dead, useMesh)
		if useMesh == false or entry.meshId <= 0 or (dead and not entry.deathMesh) then return "none" end
		if entry.all then return "all" end
		local keys = {}
		for _, group in ipairs(GROUPS) do
			if entry[group.key] then keys[#keys + 1] = group.key end
		end
		for token in string.gmatch(entry.custom or "", "[^,]+") do
			token = string.match(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
			if token ~= "" then keys[#keys + 1] = "c:" .. token end
		end
		if #keys == 0 then return "none" end
		return "parts:" .. table.concat(keys, ",")
	end
	local function shouldHide(state, object)
		if state.hideSig == "all" then return true end
		if string.sub(state.hideSig, 1, 5) ~= "parts" then return false end
		local node = object
		while node and node ~= state.model do
			if state.roots[node] then return true end
			node = node.Parent
		end
		return false
	end
	local function connectHide(state)
		if state.conn then state.conn:Disconnect() end
		-- parts / effects the game adds later (attacks, auras) are hidden the moment they appear
		state.conn = state.model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			if shouldHide(state, object) then fx.hideObject(state, object) end
		end)
	end
	local function applyHide(state)
		local sig = hideSignature(state.entry, state.dead, state.useMesh)
		if sig ~= state.hideSig then
			fx.restoreState(state) -- shows everything again (and drops the connection)
			state.hideSig, state.roots = sig, {}
			connectHide(state)
		end
		local model = state.model
		if sig == "all" then
			for _, object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				fx.hideObject(state, object)
			end
		elseif string.sub(sig, 1, 5) == "parts" then
			for token in string.gmatch(state.entry.custom or "", "[^,]+") do
				token = string.match(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
				local part = token ~= "" and model:FindFirstChild(token, true)
				if part then
					state.roots[part] = true
					fx.hideObject(state, part)
					for _, inner in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do
						fx.hideObject(state, inner)
					end
				end
			end
			for _, group in ipairs(GROUPS) do
				if state.entry[group.key] then
					for _, name in ipairs(group.names) do
						local part = model:FindFirstChild(name)
						if part then
							state.roots[part] = true
							fx.hideObject(state, part)
							for _, inner in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do
								fx.hideObject(state, inner)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	meshes.byModel = {}
	local function remove(state)
		if not state then return end
		clearItems(state)
		fx.restoreState(state) -- the battler is visible again
		meshes.units[state] = nil
		local mine = meshes.byModel[state.model]
		if mine then
			mine[state.entry] = nil
			if next(mine) == nil then meshes.byModel[state.model] = nil end
		end
	end

	local function add(model, entry)
		local state = {
			model = model, entry = entry, dead = false, taken = false, hidden = {}, fx = {}, roots = {}, hideSig = "",
			items = {}, list = {}, sig = "", spin = 0, useMesh = true, useWeapon = true,
		}
		meshes.units[state] = state
		meshes.byModel[model] = meshes.byModel[model] or {}
		meshes.byModel[model][entry] = state
		connectHide(state)
		return state
	end

	-- the mesh slots a setting wants: the whole body, or the chosen parts
	local function meshSlots(entry)
		local slots = {}
		if entry.meshId <= 0 then return slots end
		if entry.all then
			slots[1] = "body"
		else
			for _, group in ipairs(GROUPS) do
				if entry[group.key] then slots[#slots + 1] = group.key end
			end
			for token in string.gmatch(entry.custom or "", "[^,]+") do
				token = string.match(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
				if token ~= "" then slots[#slots + 1] = "c:" .. token end
			end
		end
		return slots
	end

	-- ALL the settings that cover a battler apply together (head from one, torso from another, a weapon from a third ...).
	-- When two want the same slot, the more specific one (battler ID / name) wins, then the higher one in the list.
	local function pickFor(npc, isAlly, list)
		local candidates, seenEntry = {}, {}
		local forced = meshes.forced[npc]
		if forced then candidates[1] = forced; seenEntry[forced] = true end
		for _, wantSpecific in ipairs({ true, false }) do
			for _, entry in ipairs(meshes.entries) do
				if not seenEntry[entry] and isSpecific(entry) == wantSpecific and covers(entry, npc, isAlly) then
					seenEntry[entry] = true
					candidates[#candidates + 1] = entry
				end
			end
		end
		local claimed, claimedAny, bodyClaimed, weaponClaimed = {}, false, false, false
		for _, entry in ipairs(candidates) do
			local useMesh, useWeapon = false, false
			local slots = meshSlots(entry)
			if #slots > 0 and not bodyClaimed then
				local free = true
				if slots[1] == "body" then
					free = not claimedAny
				else
					for _, slot in ipairs(slots) do
						if claimed[slot] then free = false end
					end
				end
				if free then
					useMesh = true
					for _, slot in ipairs(slots) do claimed[slot] = true end
					claimedAny = true
					if slots[1] == "body" then bodyClaimed = true end
				end
			end
			if entry.weaponId > 0 and not weaponClaimed then
				useWeapon, weaponClaimed = true, true
			end
			if useMesh or useWeapon then
				list[#list + 1] = { model = npc, entry = entry, dead = false, useMesh = useMesh, useWeapon = useWeapon }
			end
		end
	end

	local function rescan()
		local wanted = {}
		for _, folderName in ipairs({ "EnemyFolder", "FriendlyFolder" }) do
			local isAlly = folderName == "FriendlyFolder"
			local folder = npcFolder(folderName)
			if folder then
				for _, npc in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
					if npc:IsA("Model") then
						if isAlive(npc) then
							pickFor(npc, isAlly, wanted)
							local firstOne
							for _, info in ipairs(wanted) do
								if info.model == npc then firstOne = info.entry break end
							end
							if firstOne then meshes.last[npc] = firstOne end
						else
							-- a dead battler keeps its mesh / weapon while the setting says so (until the game removes it)
							for entry, existing in pairs(meshes.byModel[npc] or {}) do
								if (entry.deathMesh or entry.deathWeapon) and (table.find(meshes.entries, entry) or meshes.forced[npc] == entry) then
									wanted[#wanted + 1] = { model = npc, entry = entry, dead = true, useMesh = existing.useMesh, useWeapon = existing.useWeapon }
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local seen = {}
		for _, info in ipairs(wanted) do
			local mine = meshes.byModel[info.model]
			local state = (mine and mine[info.entry]) or add(info.model, info.entry)
			seen[state] = true
			state.dead, state.useMesh, state.useWeapon = info.dead, info.useMesh, info.useWeapon
			if not state.taken then applyHide(state) end
		end
		for state in pairs(meshes.units) do
			if not seen[state] then remove(state) end
		end
	end

	local function stop()
		meshes.on = false
		if meshes.bound then
			meshes.bound = false
			pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("OscarMeshChanger") end)
		end
		for state in pairs(meshes.units) do
			remove(state)
		end
		for _, cloneState in ipairs(meshes.clones) do
			clearItems(cloneState)
		end
		meshes.clones = {}
	end
	Custom.meshStop = stop

	local function start()
		stop()
		meshes.on = true
		meshes.scanAt, meshes.lastRender = 0, nil
		meshes.bound = true
		RunService:BindToRenderStep("OscarMeshChanger", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 8, function()
			if not meshes.on or destroyed then return end
			local now = os.clock()
			if now >= meshes.scanAt then
				meshes.scanAt = now + 0.3
				rescan()
			end
			local frameTime = meshes.lastRender and math.min(now - meshes.lastRender, 0.2) or 0
			meshes.lastRender = now
			for state in pairs(meshes.units) do
				if not state.model.Parent or not state.entry then
					remove(state)
				else
					fx.keepHidden(state)
					if not state.taken then
						local entry = state.entry
						ensureItems(state, { mesh = state.useMesh and ((not state.dead) or entry.deathMesh), weapon = state.useWeapon and ((not state.dead) or entry.deathWeapon) })
						drawItems(state, now, frameTime)
					end
				end
			end
			-- the copies of dying battlers made by Death Effects (custom death)
			for index = #meshes.clones, 1, -1 do
				local cloneState = meshes.clones[index]
				if not cloneState.model.Parent then
					clearItems(cloneState)
					table.remove(meshes.clones, index)
				else
					local entry = cloneState.entry
					ensureItems(cloneState, { mesh = entry.deathMesh, weapon = entry.deathWeapon })
					drawItems(cloneState, now, frameTime)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	-- ===== the Death Effects module hands over a dying battler's copy: the mesh / weapon move onto it and follow its death animation =====
	local function hideCloneParts(clone, entry)
		local sig = hideSignature(entry, false)
		local function hide(object)
			if object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then
				pcall(function() object.Transparency = 1 end)
			end
		end
		if sig == "all" then
			for _, object in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do hide(object) end
		elseif string.sub(sig, 1, 5) == "parts" then
			for _, group in ipairs(GROUPS) do
				if entry[group.key] then
					for _, name in ipairs(group.names) do
						local part = clone:FindFirstChild(name)
						if part then
							hide(part)
							for _, inner in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do hide(inner) end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	Custom.meshOnDeath = function(model, clone)
		if not meshes.on then return end
		local entry = meshes.last[model]
		if not entry or not (entry.deathMesh or entry.deathWeapon) then return end
		for _, state in pairs(meshes.byModel[model] or {}) do
			clearItems(state) -- the copy shows them now (the original stays hidden by Death Effects)
			state.taken = true
		end
		if entry.deathMesh then hideCloneParts(clone, entry) end
		table.insert(meshes.clones, {
			model = clone, entry = entry, items = {}, list = {}, sig = "", spin = 0, dead = true,
		})
	end
	Custom.meshFadeClone = function(clone, seconds)
		for _, cloneState in ipairs(meshes.clones) do
			if cloneState.model == clone then
				cloneState.fadeStart, cloneState.fadeDur = os.clock(), seconds
			end
		end
	end

	-- ===== UI =====

		return meshes.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then start() else stop() end
	end)
