	local function addEntry(init)
		if #meshes.entries >= MAX_ENTRIES then
			status.Text = "That is the maximum: " .. tostring(MAX_ENTRIES) .. " mesh settings."
			return
		end
		local entry = {
			enabled = true, team = 2, id = 0, name = "", meshId = 0, textureId = 0,
			sx = 1, sy = 1, sz = 1, raise = 0, forward = 0, rot = 0, spin = 0, alpha = 0, color = "",
			all = true, head = false, torso = false, larm = false, rarm = false, lleg = false, rleg = false,
			weaponId = 0, weaponTex = 0, wScale = 1, hand = 1, wx = 0, wy = 0, wz = 0, wrx = 0, wry = 0, wrz = 0,
			deathMesh = true, deathWeapon = true, custom = "",
			mx = 0, my = 0, mz = 0, mrx = 0, mry = 0, mrz = 0,
		}
		if type(init) == "table" then
			for key, value in pairs(init) do entry[key] = value end
		end
		table.insert(meshes.entries, entry)

		local box = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = #meshes.entries,
		}, list)
		make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, box)

		local header = addGrayRow(box, "")
		header.LayoutOrder = 1
		local title = header:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if title then
			title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0)
			title.TextSize = 12
			title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		end
		local function refreshHeader()
			local index = table.find(meshes.entries, entry) or 0
			local who = entry.name ~= "" and ('"' .. entry.name .. '"') or (entry.id > 0 and ("ID " .. tostring(entry.id)) or "every battler")
			local what = entry.meshId > 0 and ("mesh " .. tostring(entry.meshId)) or "no mesh yet"
			if entry.weaponId > 0 then what = what .. " + weapon" end
			if title then
				title.Text = "Mesh " .. tostring(index) .. "  -  " .. who .. "  -  " .. TEAM_LABELS[entry.team] .. "  -  " .. what
			end
			header.BackgroundColor3 = entry.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(200, 225, 200) or GRAY
		end
		local switchButton = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 26),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0.5, 0),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = "",
		}, header)
		outline(switchButton)
		local function refreshSwitch()
			switchButton.Text = entry.enabled and "ON" or "OFF"
			switchButton.BackgroundColor3 = entry.enabled and ON_COLOR or WHITE
		end
		refreshSwitch()
		listen(switchButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			entry.enabled = not entry.enabled
			refreshSwitch()
			refreshHeader()
		end)
		local removeButton = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 26),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 90, 90),
			Text = "X",
			TextColor3 = WHITE,
			TextSize = 13,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, header)
		outline(removeButton)
		entry.remove = function()
			local index = table.find(meshes.entries, entry)
			if index then table.remove(meshes.entries, index) end
			box:Destroy()
			refreshCount()
		end
		listen(removeButton.MouseButton1Click, entry.remove)

		local function newRow(order)
			local row = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundColor3 = GRAY, LayoutOrder = order }, box)
			outline(row)
			return row
		end
		local function numberBox(row, x, width, label, key, low, high, fallback)
			return textBox(column(row, x, width, label), tostring(entry[key]), 13, function(input)
				local value = tonumber(input.Text)
				value = value and math.clamp(value, low, high) or fallback
				entry[key] = value
				input.Text = tostring(value)
			end)
		end
		local function idBox(row, x, width, label, key)
			return textBox(column(row, x, width, label), entry[key] > 0 and tostring(entry[key]) or "", 12, function(input)
				entry[key] = parseId(input.Text)
				input.Text = entry[key] > 0 and tostring(entry[key]) or ""
				refreshHeader()
			end)
		end
		local function switchCell(row, x, width, label, key)
			local function text() return entry[key] and "ON" or "OFF" end
			cellButton(column(row, x, width, label), text(), function(button)
				entry[key] = not entry[key]
				button.Text = text()
			end)
		end

		-- row 1: who + colour
		local row1 = newRow(2)
		textBox(column(row1, 0, 0.4, "ID / name (0=all)"), entry.name ~= "" and entry.name or tostring(entry.id), 12, function(input)
			local text = string.match(input.Text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
			local value = tonumber(text)
			if value then
				entry.id, entry.name = (value > 0) and math.floor(value) or 0, ""
			elseif text ~= "" then
				entry.id, entry.name = 0, text
			else
				entry.id, entry.name = 0, ""
			end
			input.Text = entry.name ~= "" and entry.name or tostring(entry.id)
			refreshHeader()
		end)
		cellButton(column(row1, 0.4, 0.28, "Team"), TEAM_SHORT[entry.team], function(button)
			entry.team = (entry.team + 1) % 3
			button.Text = TEAM_SHORT[entry.team]
			refreshHeader()
		end)
		do
			local holder = column(row1, 0.68, 0.32, "Colour (blank = own)")
			local input
			local swatch = make("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 24),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 22),
				BackgroundColor3 = toColor(entry.color),
				Text = "",
				AutoButtonColor = false,
			}, holder)
			outline(swatch)
			local function apply(hex)
				entry.color = hex
				input.Text = hex
				swatch.BackgroundColor3 = toColor(hex)
			end
			input = textBox(holder, entry.color, 12, function(boxInput)
				local text = string.match(boxInput.Text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
				if text == "" then apply("") else apply(parseColor(text) or entry.color) end
			end)
			input.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 24)
			listen(swatch.MouseButton1Click, function()
				local index = table.find(PALETTE, entry.color) or 0
				apply(PALETTE[index % #PALETTE + 1])
			end)
		end

		-- row 2: the mesh
		local row2 = newRow(3)
		idBox(row2, 0, 0.5, "Mesh ID", "meshId")
		idBox(row2, 0.5, 0.5, "Texture ID (optional)", "textureId")

		-- row 3: size + height
		local row3 = newRow(4)
		numberBox(row3, 0, 0.25, "Scale X", "sx", 0.01, 500, 1)
		numberBox(row3, 0.25, 0.25, "Scale Y", "sy", 0.01, 500, 1)
		numberBox(row3, 0.5, 0.25, "Scale Z", "sz", 0.01, 500, 1)
		numberBox(row3, 0.75, 0.25, "Raise (studs)", "raise", -100, 100, 0)

		-- row 4: turn + position + look
		local row4 = newRow(5)
		numberBox(row4, 0, 0.25, "Rotate (deg)", "rot", -360, 360, 0)
		numberBox(row4, 0.25, 0.25, "Spin (turns/s)", "spin", -20, 20, 0)
		numberBox(row4, 0.5, 0.25, "Forward", "forward", -100, 100, 0)
		numberBox(row4, 0.75, 0.25, "See-through", "alpha", 0, 1, 0)

		-- the mesh can be moved / turned around like the weapon (relative to the body part it sits on)
		local rowMoveA = newRow(6)
		numberBox(rowMoveA, 0, 0.34, "Mesh Move X", "mx", -100, 100, 0)
		numberBox(rowMoveA, 0.34, 0.33, "Mesh Move Y", "my", -100, 100, 0)
		numberBox(rowMoveA, 0.67, 0.33, "Mesh Move Z", "mz", -100, 100, 0)
		local rowMoveB = newRow(7)
		numberBox(rowMoveB, 0, 0.34, "Mesh Rot X", "mrx", -360, 360, 0)
		numberBox(rowMoveB, 0.34, 0.33, "Mesh Rot Y", "mry", -360, 360, 0)
		numberBox(rowMoveB, 0.67, 0.33, "Mesh Rot Z", "mrz", -360, 360, 0)

		-- row 5: WHICH BODY PARTS change ("Whole" = the entire battler; OFF = only the parts that are ON)
		local row5 = newRow(8)
		local cell = 1 / 7
		switchCell(row5, 0, cell, "Whole", "all")
		for index, group in ipairs(GROUPS) do
			switchCell(row5, cell * index, cell, group.label, group.key)
		end
		local rowCustom = newRow(9)
		textBox(column(rowCustom, 0, 1, "Other parts by NAME (comma separated, e.g. Handle, Blade)"), entry.custom or "", 12, function(input)
			local text = (string.gsub(input.Text, "[|~]", ""))
			entry.custom = string.match(text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
			input.Text = entry.custom
		end)

		-- row 6-8: the WEAPON in the hand
		local row6 = newRow(10)
		idBox(row6, 0, 0.34, "Weapon mesh ID", "weaponId")
		idBox(row6, 0.34, 0.34, "Weapon texture", "weaponTex")
		numberBox(row6, 0.68, 0.17, "Scale", "wScale", 0.01, 500, 1)
		cellButton(column(row6, 0.85, 0.15, "Hand"), HAND_NAMES[entry.hand] or "Right", function(button)
			entry.hand = entry.hand % #HAND_NAMES + 1
			button.Text = HAND_NAMES[entry.hand]
		end)
		local row7 = newRow(11)
		numberBox(row7, 0, 0.25, "Move X", "wx", -100, 100, 0)
		numberBox(row7, 0.25, 0.25, "Move Y", "wy", -100, 100, 0)
		numberBox(row7, 0.5, 0.25, "Move Z", "wz", -100, 100, 0)
		numberBox(row7, 0.75, 0.25, "Rot X", "wrx", -360, 360, 0)
		local row8 = newRow(12)
		numberBox(row8, 0, 0.2, "Rot Y", "wry", -360, 360, 0)
		numberBox(row8, 0.2, 0.2, "Rot Z", "wrz", -360, 360, 0)
		switchCell(row8, 0.4, 0.3, "Mesh on death", "deathMesh")
		switchCell(row8, 0.7, 0.3, "Weapon on death", "deathWeapon")

		refreshHeader()
		refreshCount()
		return entry
	end

	-- ===== the scanner =====
	local MAX_FOUND = 80
	listen(scopeButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		scanScope = (scanScope + 1) % 3
		scopeButton.Text = TEAM_SHORT[scanScope]
	end)
	local function scanMeshes()
		for _, child in ipairs(scanResults:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
		end
		local found, seen = {}, {}
		for _, folderName in ipairs({ "EnemyFolder", "FriendlyFolder" }) do
			local isAlly = folderName == "FriendlyFolder"
			if scanScope == 2 or (scanScope == 1) == isAlly then
				local folder = npcFolder(folderName)
				for _, npc in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
					if npc:IsA("Model") then
						local battlerId = tonumber(npc:GetAttribute("ID"))
						for _, object in ipairs(npc:GetDescendants()) do
							local meshUrl, textureUrl, partName
							if object:IsA("MeshPart") then
								meshUrl, textureUrl, partName = object.MeshId, object.TextureID, object.Name
							elseif object:IsA("SpecialMesh") and object.Parent and object.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
								meshUrl, textureUrl, partName = object.MeshId, object.TextureId, object.Parent.Name
							end
							local meshId = meshUrl and parseId(meshUrl) or 0
							if meshId > 0 and #found < MAX_FOUND then
								local key = npc.Name .. "|" .. partName .. "|" .. tostring(meshId)
								if not seen[key] then
									seen[key] = true
									found[#found + 1] = {
										name = npc.Name, battlerId = battlerId, ally = isAlly, part = partName,
										meshId = meshId, textureId = textureUrl and parseId(textureUrl) or 0,
									}
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if scanLabel then
			scanLabel.Text = #found > 0 and ("Mesh scanner - " .. tostring(#found) .. " mesh(es) found") or "Mesh scanner - nothing found (start a battle, then SCAN)"
		end
		for index, item in ipairs(found) do
			local row = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = GRAY, LayoutOrder = index }, scanResults)
			outline(row)
			make("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -74, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = item.name .. (item.battlerId and (" (ID " .. tostring(item.battlerId) .. ")") or "") .. "  -  " .. item.part
					.. "  -  mesh " .. tostring(item.meshId) .. (item.textureId > 0 and ("  +  texture " .. tostring(item.textureId)) or ""),
				TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 11, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			}, row)
			local editButton = make("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 26), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0),
				BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Text = "EDIT", TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			}, row)
			outline(editButton)
			listen(editButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
				-- a ready setting for exactly this battler + part + mesh: change the mesh ID, scale, colour, ... below
				local init = {
					id = item.battlerId and math.floor(item.battlerId) or 0, name = item.battlerId and "" or item.name,
					team = item.ally and 1 or 0, meshId = item.meshId, textureId = item.textureId,
					all = false, head = false, torso = false, larm = false, rarm = false, lleg = false, rleg = false, custom = "",
				}
				local matched = false
				for _, group in ipairs(GROUPS) do
					for _, name in ipairs(group.names) do
						if name == item.part then
							init[group.key] = true
							matched = true
						end
					end
				end
				if not matched then init.custom = item.part end
				local added = addEntry(init)
				status.Text = added and ("Added a setting for " .. item.name .. " / " .. item.part .. " (mesh " .. tostring(item.meshId) .. "). Scroll down to the mesh settings and edit it - it is saved with SAVE.")
					or "Could not add it (maximum number of settings reached)."
			end)
		end
	end
	listen(scanButton.MouseButton1Click, scanMeshes)

	-- ===== save / load =====
	local PART_KEYS = { "all", "head", "torso", "larm", "rarm", "lleg", "rleg" } -- bits 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64
	local function clean(text)
		return (string.gsub(text or "", "[|~]", ""))
	end
	local function serializeMeshes()
		local rows = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(meshes.entries) do
			local mask = 0
			for index, key in ipairs(PART_KEYS) do
				if entry[key] then mask = mask + 2 ^ (index - 1) end
			end
			rows[#rows + 1] = table.concat({
				"E", entry.enabled and 1 or 0, entry.team, entry.id, clean(entry.name), entry.meshId, entry.textureId,
				entry.sx, entry.sy, entry.sz, entry.raise, entry.rot, entry.spin, entry.forward, entry.alpha, entry.color,
				math.floor(mask), entry.weaponId, entry.weaponTex, entry.wScale, entry.wx, entry.wy, entry.wz,
				entry.wrx, entry.wry, entry.wrz, entry.hand, entry.deathMesh and 1 or 0, entry.deathWeapon and 1 or 0, clean(entry.custom or ""),
				entry.mx or 0, entry.my or 0, entry.mz or 0, entry.mrx or 0, entry.mry or 0, entry.mrz or 0,
			}, "~")
		end
		if #rows == 0 then rows[1] = "N" end
		local body = Custom.encodeBase64(table.concat(rows, "|"))
		return "OSM1" .. body .. Custom.checksum(body)
	end
	local function parseMeshes(code)
		code = string.gsub(code or "", "%s", "")
		if string.sub(code, 1, 4) ~= "OSM1" or #code < 5 then
			return false, "That is not a valid mesh changer code."
		end
		local body = string.sub(code, 5, #code - 1)
		if Custom.checksum(body) ~= string.sub(code, #code) then
			return false, "The code is damaged (a character is wrong or missing)."
		end
		local ok, decoded = pcall(decodeBase64, body)
		if not ok or decoded == "" then return false, "The code could not be read." end
		local listed = {}
		for _, row in ipairs(string.split(decoded, "|")) do
			local f = string.split(row, "~")
			if f[1] == "E" then
				if #f < 15 then return false, "The code could not be read." end
				if #listed < MAX_ENTRIES then
					local item = {
						enabled = f[2] == "1",
						team = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(f[3]) or 2), 0, 2),
						id = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(f[4]) or 0)),
						name = f[5] or "",
						meshId = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(f[6]) or 0)),
						textureId = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(f[7]) or 0)),
						sx = math.clamp(tonumber(f[8]) or 1, 0.01, 500),
						sy = math.clamp(tonumber(f[9]) or 1, 0.01, 500),
						sz = math.clamp(tonumber(f[10]) or 1, 0.01, 500),
						raise = math.clamp(tonumber(f[11]) or 0, -100, 100),
						rot = math.clamp(tonumber(f[12]) or 0, -360, 360),
						spin = math.clamp(tonumber(f[13]) or 0, -20, 20),
						forward = math.clamp(tonumber(f[14]) or 0, -100, 100),
						alpha = math.clamp(tonumber(f[15]) or 0, 0, 1),
						color = parseColor(f[16]) or "",
						-- added later: older codes do not have them (whole battler, no weapon, stays on death)
						weaponId = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(f[18]) or 0)),
						weaponTex = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(f[19]) or 0)),
						wScale = math.clamp(tonumber(f[20]) or 1, 0.01, 500),
						wx = math.clamp(tonumber(f[21]) or 0, -100, 100),
						wy = math.clamp(tonumber(f[22]) or 0, -100, 100),
						wz = math.clamp(tonumber(f[23]) or 0, -100, 100),
						wrx = math.clamp(tonumber(f[24]) or 0, -360, 360),
						wry = math.clamp(tonumber(f[25]) or 0, -360, 360),
						wrz = math.clamp(tonumber(f[26]) or 0, -360, 360),
						hand = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(f[27]) or 1), 1, #HAND_NAMES),
						deathMesh = f[28] == nil or f[28] == "1",
						deathWeapon = f[29] == nil or f[29] == "1",
						custom = f[30] or "",
						mx = math.clamp(tonumber(f[31]) or 0, -100, 100),
						my = math.clamp(tonumber(f[32]) or 0, -100, 100),
						mz = math.clamp(tonumber(f[33]) or 0, -100, 100),
						mrx = math.clamp(tonumber(f[34]) or 0, -360, 360),
						mry = math.clamp(tonumber(f[35]) or 0, -360, 360),
						mrz = math.clamp(tonumber(f[36]) or 0, -360, 360),
					}
					local mask = tonumber(f[17])
					for index, key in ipairs(PART_KEYS) do
						if mask == nil then
							item[key] = (key == "all")
						else
							item[key] = math.floor(mask / 2 ^ (index - 1)) % 2 == 1
						end
					end
					listed[#listed + 1] = item
				end
			elseif f[1] ~= "N" then
				return false, "The code could not be read."
			end
		end
		return true, listed
	end
	local function loadMeshes(code)
		local ok, listed = parseMeshes(code)
		if not ok then return false, listed end
		while #meshes.entries > 0 do
			meshes.entries[#meshes.entries].remove()
		end
		for _, init in ipairs(listed) do addEntry(init) end
		return true, #listed
	end
	Custom.meshSerialize = serializeMeshes
	-- for Spawn Battler: give ONE battler its own mesh setting (a setting number from the list, or a pasted code),
	-- even when no setting in the list covers it. It also switches the Mesh Changer ON.
	Custom.meshParse = parseMeshes
	Custom.meshEntryNumber = function(index) return meshes.entries[index] end
	Custom.meshForce = function(model, entry)
		meshes.forced[model] = entry
		if not meshes.on then
			start()
			if refreshMain then refreshMain() end
		end
		meshes.scanAt = 0
	end

	local saveRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Save / Load mesh changer")
	local function saveButton(text, offset)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 24),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, saveRow)
		outline(button)
		return button
	end
	local loadButton = saveButton("LOAD", 8)
	local saveCodeButton = saveButton("SAVE", 68)
	local codeRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Code")
	local codeBox = make("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		PlaceholderText = "save to get a code / paste one here",
		PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY,
		Text = "",
		TextSize = 12,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		Font = Enum.Font.Code,
	}, codeRow)
	outline(codeBox)
	listen(saveCodeButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		local code = serializeMeshes()
		codeBox.Text = code
		status.Text = Custom.copy(code) and "Saved! The code is in the box and copied to your clipboard." or "Saved! Copy the code from the box."
	end)
	listen(loadButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		local ok, result = loadMeshes(codeBox.Text)
		status.Text = ok and ("Loaded " .. tostring(result) .. " mesh setting(s).") or ("Could not load: " .. tostring(result))
	end)
	listen(addButton.MouseButton1Click, function() addEntry() end)

	-- the mesh settings travel with the Custom Spawner spawn-cycle codes (like the battler sprites)
	Custom.meshCount = function() return #meshes.entries end
	-- loading a spawn cycle that carries meshes also switches the Mesh Changer row ON
	Custom.meshLoadStart = function(code)
		local ok, result = loadMeshes(code)
		if ok and #meshes.entries > 0 and not meshes.on then
			start()
			if refreshMain then refreshMain() end
		end
		return ok, result
	end
end)

-- Freecam (Misc tab): fly the camera around the map to watch the battle and take cool shots. Nothing to delete in Dex:
-- it takes the camera every frame and gives it back when you turn it off.
--   PC:     WASD move, Q / E down / up, Shift = faster, hold RIGHT-CLICK and move the mouse to look, scroll = FOV,
--           R / T = faster / slower, F = exit
--   Mobile: left thumb = move (drag on the left side), right thumb = look (drag on the right side), buttons for up / down /
--           speed / FOV / exit
-- The "Controls" setting switches between PC and Mobile.
safeBuild("Freecam", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local MODE_NAMES = { "PC (keyboard + mouse)", "Mobile (touch controls)" }

	local cam = {
		on = false,
		mode = (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled) and 2 or 1,
		speed = 20, fov = 70, sens = 1,
		yaw = 0, pitch = 0, pos = Vector3.new(), lookX = 0, lookY = 0,
		keys = {}, hold = { up = false, down = false }, rmb = false,
		joystick = Vector2.new(), moveTouch = nil, moveOrigin = nil, lookTouch = nil,
		conns = {}, gui = nil, info = nil, saved = nil, refreshMain = nil, camera = nil,
		hideInfo = false, controlsHidden = false, highlight = false, controls = {}, hl = nil, toggleButton = nil,
	}
	Custom.freecam = cam

	local function updateInfo()
		if not cam.info then return end
		cam.info.Visible = not cam.hideInfo and not cam.controlsHidden -- setting: hide the instructions text (also hidden while HIDE is on)
		local text = string.format("Freecam   Speed: %d   FOV: %d", math.round(cam.speed), math.round(cam.fov))
		if cam.mode == 1 then
			text = text .. "\nWASD move | Q/E down/up | Shift fast | hold RIGHT-CLICK to look | R/T speed | scroll FOV | H hide text | F exit"
		end
		cam.info.Text = text
	end

	-- setting: the yellow box around the HIDE / SHOW button (if you lost it)
	local function applyHighlight()
		if cam.hl then cam.hl.Visible = cam.highlight end
	end

	local function destroyHud()
		if cam.gui then
			pcall(function() cam.gui:Destroy() end)
		end
		cam.gui, cam.info = nil, nil
		cam.controls, cam.hl, cam.toggleButton = {}, nil, nil
		cam.moveTouch, cam.lookTouch, cam.moveOrigin = nil, nil, nil
		cam.joystick = Vector2.new()
		cam.hold.up, cam.hold.down = false, false
	end

	local stop
	local function exitFreecam()
		stop()
		if cam.refreshMain then cam.refreshMain() end
	end

	local function buildHud()
		destroyHud()
		local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name = "OscarsFreecamHUD"
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		gui.DisplayOrder = 1000
		gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
		gui.Parent = playerGui
		cam.gui = gui

		cam.info = make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 44),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -8),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
			TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			TextSize = 13,
			TextWrapped = true,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = "",
			Active = false,
		}, gui)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }, cam.info)
		updateInfo()
		if cam.mode ~= 2 then return end

		-- ===== mobile controls =====
		local function isPress(input)
			return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		end
		-- the joystick stays in ONE spot (bottom-left), so the rest of the screen stays free: the panel and its icon can still be
		-- tapped and closed. LOOK = drag a finger anywhere that is not a button, the joystick or the panel's own buttons.
		local applyControls
		local pad = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 130), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 1, -24),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.75, Active = true, ZIndex = 2,
		}, gui)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, pad)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Transparency = 0.4, Thickness = 2 }, pad)
		local knob = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, ZIndex = 3,
		}, pad)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, knob)
		table.insert(cam.controls, pad)
		pad.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not cam.moveTouch then
				cam.moveTouch = input
			end
		end)
		table.insert(cam.conns, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
			-- a touch on a button / the joystick / the panel is already "processed": only free touches look around
			if processed or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch or cam.lookTouch then return end
			cam.lookTouch = input
		end))
		table.insert(cam.conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if not cam.on then return end
			if input == cam.moveTouch then
				local center = pad.AbsolutePosition + pad.AbsoluteSize / 2
				local offset = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - center
				local radius = 55
				local clamped = offset.Magnitude > radius and offset.Unit * radius or offset
				cam.joystick = clamped / radius
				knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, clamped.X, 0.5, clamped.Y)
			elseif input == cam.lookTouch then
				cam.lookX += input.Delta.X * 0.006
				cam.lookY += input.Delta.Y * 0.006
			end
		end))
		table.insert(cam.conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input == cam.moveTouch then
				cam.moveTouch = nil
				cam.joystick = Vector2.new()
				knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			elseif input == cam.lookTouch then
				cam.lookTouch = nil
			end
		end))

		local function button(text, row, onDown, onUp, isToggle)
			local b = make("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 40), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 10 + row * 46),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
				Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				AutoButtonColor = false, Active = true, ZIndex = 5,
			}, gui)
			make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }, b)
			if not isToggle then table.insert(cam.controls, b) end
			b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if isPress(input) then
					-- the HIDE / SHOW button never flashes while hidden (it used to pop back into view on every tap)
					if not isToggle or not cam.controlsHidden then b.BackgroundTransparency = 0 end
					onDown()
				end
			end)
			b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
				if isPress(input) then
					if not isToggle or not cam.controlsHidden then b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 end
					if onUp then onUp() end
				end
			end)
			return b
		end
		button("UP", 0, function() cam.hold.up = true end, function() cam.hold.up = false end)
		button("DOWN", 1, function() cam.hold.down = true end, function() cam.hold.down = false end)
		button("SPEED +", 2, function() cam.speed = math.clamp(cam.speed + 10, 5, 500); updateInfo() end)
		button("SPEED -", 3, function() cam.speed = math.clamp(cam.speed - 10, 5, 500); updateInfo() end)
		button("FOV +", 4, function() cam.fov = math.clamp(cam.fov + 5, 10, 120); updateInfo() end)
		button("FOV -", 5, function() cam.fov = math.clamp(cam.fov - 5, 10, 120); updateInfo() end)
		button("EXIT", 6, function() exitFreecam() end)

		-- HIDE / SHOW: hides the controls (joystick + buttons) and then the button itself (invisible, but still tappable)
		local toggle = button("HIDE", 7, function()
			cam.controlsHidden = not cam.controlsHidden
			applyControls()
		end, nil, true)
		cam.toggleButton = toggle
		local box = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 16, 1, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = false, ZIndex = 9, Visible = cam.highlight,
		}, toggle)
		local boxStroke = make("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0), Thickness = 4 }, box)
		pcall(function()
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(boxStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { Transparency = 0.6 }):Play()
		end)
		cam.hl = box
		local strokeOriginal = toggle.TextStrokeTransparency
		applyControls = function()
			for _, object in ipairs(cam.controls) do
				if object.Parent then object.Visible = not cam.controlsHidden end
			end
			if cam.controlsHidden then
				-- nothing keeps moving while the controls are hidden
				cam.joystick = Vector2.new()
				cam.moveTouch = nil
				cam.hold.up, cam.hold.down = false, false
			end
			toggle.Text = cam.controlsHidden and "SHOW" or "HIDE"
			-- while hidden the button is completely invisible too (a clean screen) but it can still be tapped (it stays in its spot, top-right).
			-- "Highlight the HIDE / SHOW button" still shows the yellow box where it is.
			toggle.BackgroundTransparency = cam.controlsHidden and 1 or 0.3
			toggle.TextTransparency = cam.controlsHidden and 1 or 0
			toggle.TextStrokeTransparency = cam.controlsHidden and 1 or strokeOriginal
			for _, child in ipairs(toggle:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("UIStroke") then child.Enabled = not cam.controlsHidden end
			end
			updateInfo() -- the instructions text goes too, so nothing is left on screen
		end
		applyControls()
	end

	local function step(dt)
		if not cam.on or destroyed then return end
		local camera = cam.camera
		if not camera or not camera.Parent then return end
		if Workspace.CurrentCamera ~= camera then Workspace.CurrentCamera = camera end
		dt = math.min(dt, 0.1)
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable -- every frame: the game cannot take the camera back

		cam.yaw -= cam.lookX * cam.sens
		cam.pitch = math.clamp(cam.pitch - cam.lookY * cam.sens, -math.pi / 2 + 0.01, math.pi / 2 - 0.01)
		cam.lookX, cam.lookY = 0, 0

		local move = Vector3.new()
		local vertical = 0
		local keys = cam.keys
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.W] then move += Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.S] then move += Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.A] then move += Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.D] then move += Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
		move += Vector3.new(cam.joystick.X, 0, cam.joystick.Y)
		if move.Magnitude > 1 then move = move.Unit end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.E] or cam.hold.up then vertical += 1 end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.Q] or cam.hold.down then vertical -= 1 end

		local boost = (keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] or keys[Enum.KeyCode.RightShift]) and 2.5 or 1
		local rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, cam.yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(cam.pitch, 0, 0)
		cam.pos += (rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(move) + Vector3.new(0, vertical, 0)) * cam.speed * boost * dt
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(cam.pos) * rotation
		camera.FieldOfView = cam.fov
	end

	stop = function()
		if not cam.on then
			destroyHud()
			return
		end
		cam.on = false
		pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("OscarFreecam") end)
		for _, connection in ipairs(cam.conns) do
			pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
		end
		cam.conns = {}
		destroyHud()
		cam.keys, cam.rmb = {}, false
		pcall(function() UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default end)
		-- give the game's own camera back, and remove ours
		local saved = cam.saved
		local old = saved and saved.camera
		if not old or not old.Parent then
			old = Instance.new("Camera")
			old.Parent = Workspace
		end
		pcall(function() Workspace.CurrentCamera = old end)
		if cam.camera then
			pcall(function() cam.camera:Destroy() end)
			cam.camera = nil
		end
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if saved and camera then
			pcall(function()
				camera.CameraType = saved.cameraType
				if saved.subject then camera.CameraSubject = saved.subject end
				camera.CFrame = saved.cframe
				camera.FieldOfView = saved.fov
			end)
		end
		cam.saved = nil
	end
	Custom.freecamStop = stop

	local function start()
		stop()
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end
		if Custom.camAutoScan and Custom.camScan then pcall(Custom.camScan, true) end -- remember the normal camera, so it can be fixed afterwards
		cam.saved = {
			camera = camera, cameraType = camera.CameraType, subject = camera.CameraSubject, cframe = camera.CFrame, fov = camera.FieldOfView,
		}
		-- like deleting the game's camera in Dex: the game's scripts keep talking to the OLD camera, and what you see is a fresh camera
		-- of ours - so nothing fights over it (that was the twitching). The old camera is given back when Freecam is turned off.
		local own = Instance.new("Camera")
		own.Name = "OscarFreecam"
		own.CFrame = camera.CFrame
		own.FieldOfView = camera.FieldOfView
		own.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		own.Parent = Workspace
		Workspace.CurrentCamera = own
		cam.camera = own
		local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		cam.yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
		cam.pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(look.Y, -1, 1))
		cam.pos = camera.CFrame.Position
		cam.fov = camera.FieldOfView
		cam.lookX, cam.lookY = 0, 0
		cam.keys, cam.rmb = {}, false
		cam.controlsHidden = false -- always start with everything visible
		cam.on = true

		table.insert(cam.conns, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and cam.mode == 1 then
				cam.rmb = true
				UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
				return
			end
			if processed or cam.mode ~= 1 then return end
			local key = input.KeyCode
			cam.keys[key] = true
			if key == Enum.KeyCode.R then
				cam.speed = math.clamp(cam.speed + 5, 5, 500)
				updateInfo()
			elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.T then
				cam.speed = math.clamp(cam.speed - 5, 5, 500)
				updateInfo()
			elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.H then
				cam.controlsHidden = not cam.controlsHidden -- PC: hides / shows the instructions text
				updateInfo()
			elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.F then
				exitFreecam()
			end
		end))
		table.insert(cam.conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and cam.rmb then
				cam.rmb = false
				UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
			end
			cam.keys[input.KeyCode] = nil
		end))
		table.insert(cam.conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if cam.mode ~= 1 then return end
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and cam.rmb then
				cam.lookX += input.Delta.X * 0.003
				cam.lookY += input.Delta.Y * 0.003
			elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
				cam.fov = math.clamp(cam.fov - input.Position.Z * 3, 10, 120)
				updateInfo()
			end
		end))
		buildHud()
		RunService:BindToRenderStep("OscarFreecam", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 20, step)
	end

	Custom.freecamStart = start

	-- ===== UI =====
	local drawer, _, refreshMain = addToggleCogRow(page, "Freecam (fly the camera)", function()
		return cam.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then start() else stop() end
	end)
	cam.refreshMain = refreshMain


	local modeRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Controls")
	local modeButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		Text = MODE_NAMES[cam.mode],
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		TextSize = 11,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	}, modeRow)
	outline(modeButton)
	listen(modeButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		cam.mode = cam.mode % #MODE_NAMES + 1
		modeButton.Text = MODE_NAMES[cam.mode]
		cam.keys, cam.rmb = {}, false
		pcall(function() UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default end)
		if cam.on then
			-- the touch controls are rebuilt (or removed) for the new mode
			for index = #cam.conns, 1, -1 do
				if index > 3 then
					pcall(function() cam.conns[index]:Disconnect() end)
					table.remove(cam.conns, index)
				end
			end
			buildHud()
		end
	end)

	local function number(label, get, set, low, high)
		addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, label), tostring(get()), function(box)
			local value = tonumber(box.Text)
			set(value and math.clamp(value, low, high) or get())
			box.Text = tostring(get())
			updateInfo()
		end)
	end
	number("Camera speed (studs/second)", function() return cam.speed end, function(v) cam.speed = v end, 5, 500)
	number("Field of view", function() return cam.fov end, function(v) cam.fov = v end, 10, 120)
	number("Look sensitivity (1 = normal)", function() return cam.sens end, function(v) cam.sens = v end, 0.1, 5)
	addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, "Hide the instructions text"), function()
		return cam.hideInfo
	end, function(value)
		cam.hideInfo = value
		updateInfo()
	end)
	addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, "Highlight the HIDE / SHOW button (yellow box)"), function()
		return cam.highlight
	end, function(value)
		cam.highlight = value
		applyHighlight()
	end)
	make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "Credits: Freecam made by brooklyntguy92",
		TextColor3 = WHITE,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, drawer)
end)

-- Hide Delta (Misc tab): makes the executor's own screen (the Delta button / menu) invisible, so it is not in your way or your shots.
-- Executors put their windows in a hidden container (gethui) or in CoreGui; this switches those screens off while the row is ON and
-- puts them back exactly as they were when you turn it OFF (or delete the GUI).
safeBuild("Hide Delta", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local hd = {
		on = false, names = "delta", everything = true, saved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), loop = nil, scanAt = 0,
		standIn = true, revealed = false, standGui = nil, standConns = {},
	}
	Custom.hideDelta = hd

	local function nameMatches(name)
		local lowered = string.lower(name)
		for piece in string.gmatch(string.lower(hd.names or ""), "[^,]+") do
			local token = string.match(piece, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
			if token ~= "" and string.find(lowered, token, 1, true) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function hideOne(object)
		pcall(function()
			if object:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				if hd.saved[object] == nil then hd.saved[object] = { "Enabled", object.Enabled } end
				if object.Enabled then object.Enabled = false end
			elseif object:IsA("GuiObject") then
				if hd.saved[object] == nil then hd.saved[object] = { "Visible", object.Visible } end
				if object.Visible then object.Visible = false end
			end
		end)
	end
	local function hideTree(root)
		if string.sub(root.Name, 1, 6) == "Oscars" then return end -- never our own panel
		hideOne(root)
		local ok, items = pcall(function() return root:GetDescendants() end)
		if ok then
			for _, object in ipairs(items) do
				if object:IsA("ScreenGui") then hideOne(object) end
			end
		end
	end

	local function scan()
		-- 1) the executor's hidden container: everything in it is executor stuff
		local getHidden = Custom.exec("gethui", "get_hidden_gui")
		if hd.everything and getHidden then
			local ok, container = pcall(getHidden)
			if ok and typeof(container) == "Instance" and container ~= CoreGui then
				local okChildren, children = pcall(function() return container:GetChildren() end)
				for _, child in ipairs(okChildren and children or {}) do hideTree(child) end
			end
		end
		-- 2) anything in CoreGui / the hidden container whose NAME matches (Delta, ...)
		local roots = { CoreGui }
		if getHidden then
			local ok, container = pcall(getHidden)
			if ok and typeof(container) == "Instance" then table.insert(roots, container) end
		end
		for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
			local ok, children = pcall(function() return root:GetChildren() end)
			for _, child in ipairs(ok and children or {}) do
				if nameMatches(child.Name) then hideTree(child) end
			end
		end
	end

	local restore
	restore = function()
		for object, info in pairs(hd.saved) do
			pcall(function() object[info[1]] = info[2] end)
			hd.saved[object] = nil
		end
	end

	-- a small Oscar icon button (the Oscar picture) stays on screen while Delta is hidden: TAP = bring Delta back, tap again = hide it
	local function destroyStandIn()
		for _, connection in ipairs(hd.standConns) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
		hd.standConns = {}
		if hd.standGui then pcall(function() hd.standGui:Destroy() end) end
		hd.standGui = nil
	end
	local function buildStandIn()
		destroyStandIn()
		if not (hd.on and hd.standIn) then return end
		local standGui = make("ScreenGui", { Name = "OscarsDeltaStandIn", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 900 }, playerGui)
		hd.standGui = standGui
		local image = loadIconImage()
		local button = make("ImageButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutoButtonColor = false,
			Image = image or "", ImageTransparency = hd.revealed and 0 or 0.4, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
			ResampleMode = Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated,
		}, standGui)
		if not image then
			make("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45), Text = "O", TextColor3 = WHITE, TextSize = 20, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold }, button)
		end
		local dragging, moved, dragStart, startPos = false, false, nil, nil
		table.insert(hd.standConns, button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging, moved, dragStart, startPos = true, false, input.Position, button.Position
			end
		end))
		table.insert(hd.standConns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if not dragging then return end
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			if not moved and delta.Magnitude < 6 then return end
			moved = true
			local screen = standGui.AbsoluteSize
			button.Position = UDim2.new(
				0, math.clamp(startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 0, math.max(0, screen.X - 40)),
				startPos.Y.Scale, math.clamp(startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y, -screen.Y * startPos.Y.Scale, screen.Y * (1 - startPos.Y.Scale) - 40)
			)
		end))
		table.insert(hd.standConns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if not dragging then return end
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			dragging = false
			if not moved then
				hd.revealed = not hd.revealed
				button.ImageTransparency = hd.revealed and 0 or 0.4
				if hd.revealed then restore() else hd.scanAt = 0 end
			end
		end))
	end

	local function stop()
		hd.on = false
		destroyStandIn()
		if hd.loop then
			hd.loop:Disconnect()
			hd.loop = nil
		end
		restore()
	end
	Custom.hideDeltaStop = stop

	local function start()
		stop()
		hd.on = true
		hd.scanAt = 0
		hd.revealed = false
		buildStandIn()
		hd.loop = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if destroyed or not hd.on or hd.revealed then return end
			local now = os.clock()
			if now >= hd.scanAt then
				hd.scanAt = now + 0.4
				scan() -- also catches screens that open later
			end
		end)
	end

	local drawer = addToggleCogRow(page, "Hide Delta (make the executor GUI invisible)", function()
		return hd.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then start() else stop() end
	end)

	addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, "Oscar icon button (tap = bring Delta back / hide it)"), function()
		return hd.standIn
	end, function(value)
		hd.standIn = value
		if hd.on then buildStandIn() end
	end)
	local namesRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Names to hide (comma separated)")
	addNumberBox(namesRow, hd.names, function(box)
		hd.names = string.match(box.Text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
		box.Text = hd.names
		hd.scanAt = 0
	end)
	addSwitch(addGrayRow(drawer, "Also hide everything in the executor's hidden container"), function()
		return hd.everything
	end, function(value)
		hd.everything = value
		if hd.on then
			restore()
			hd.scanAt = 0
		end
	end)
end)

safeBuild("Cinematic Mode", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
	local cine = { on = false, token = 0, hidden = {}, bars = {}, hideBars = false, keepMove = true, core = nil, topbar = nil, conn = nil,
		ghost = {}, ghostGuis = {}, keepSet = {}, keepCount = 0,
		keepWords = "left,right,move,arrow,camera,pan,swipe,drag,joystick,thumbstick,slide,scroll" }
	Custom.cine = cine

	-- the thumbstick / jump button must stay, otherwise you could not move on mobile
	local KEEP = { TouchGui = true, ControlGui = true }

	local function isOurs(gui)
		return string.sub(gui.Name, 1, 6) == "Oscars" or (cine.keepMove and KEEP[gui.Name] == true)
	end

	-- ===== "keep moving": the game's own left / right (camera pan) controls stay usable but invisible =====
	local VISUALS = { "BackgroundTransparency", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency", "ImageTransparency", "ScrollBarImageTransparency" }

	local function wordsList()
		local list = {}
		for word in string.gmatch(string.lower(cine.keepWords or ""), "[^,%s]+") do table.insert(list, word) end
		return list
	end

	local function wantsKeep(object, words, viewport)
		local name = string.lower(object.Name)
		for _, word in ipairs(words) do
			if string.find(name, word, 1, true) then return true end
		end
		-- a big tappable / draggable area (swipe to move the camera left and right) also counts
		local big = object.AbsoluteSize.X >= viewport.X * 0.45 and object.AbsoluteSize.Y >= viewport.Y * 0.45
		return big and (object:IsA("GuiButton") or object.Active)
	end

	local function markKeep(object, gui)
		cine.keepSet[object] = true
		local node = object.Parent
		while node and node ~= gui do
			if node:IsA("GuiObject") then cine.keepSet[node] = true end
			node = node.Parent
		end
	end

	-- decides (once, before the screen is switched off) which controls of this game screen are kept
	local function scanKeep(gui)
		local words = wordsList()
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1000, 600)
		local found = false
		local ok, items = pcall(function() return gui:GetDescendants() end)
		for _, object in ipairs(ok and items or {}) do
			if object:IsA("GuiObject") and not cine.keepSet[object] and wantsKeep(object, words, viewport) then
				markKeep(object, gui)
				cine.keepCount += 1
				found = true
			end
		end
		return found
	end

	local function ghostPass(gui)
		local ok, items = pcall(function() return gui:GetDescendants() end)
		for _, object in ipairs(ok and items or {}) do
			if object:IsA("UIStroke") then
				if cine.ghost[object] == nil then cine.ghost[object] = { Enabled = object.Enabled } end
				if object.Enabled then object.Enabled = false end
			elseif object:IsA("GuiObject") then
				local saved = cine.ghost[object]
				if saved == nil then
					saved = { Visible = object.Visible }
					for _, name in ipairs(VISUALS) do
						local okRead, value = pcall(function() return object[name] end)
						if okRead then saved[name] = value end
					end
					cine.ghost[object] = saved
				end
				for _, name in ipairs(VISUALS) do
					if saved[name] ~= nil and object[name] < 1 then object[name] = 1 end
				end
				if cine.keepSet[object] then
					if saved.Visible and not object.Visible then object.Visible = true end
				elseif object.Visible then
					object.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function unghostAll()
		for object, saved in pairs(cine.ghost) do
			if object.Parent then
				for key, value in pairs(saved) do
					pcall(function() object[key] = value end)
				end
			end
		end
		table.clear(cine.ghost)
		table.clear(cine.ghostGuis)
		table.clear(cine.keepSet)
		cine.keepCount = 0
	end

	local function hideGui(gui)
		if not gui:IsA("ScreenGui") or isOurs(gui) then return end
		if cine.ghostGuis[gui] then
			ghostPass(gui)
			return
		end
		if cine.hidden[gui] == nil then
			-- decide before the screen is switched off (switched-off screens have no size to measure)
			if cine.keepMove and gui.Enabled and scanKeep(gui) then
				cine.ghostGuis[gui] = true
				ghostPass(gui)
				return
			end
			cine.hidden[gui] = gui.Enabled
		end
		if gui.Enabled then gui.Enabled = false end
	end

	local function hideBar(bar)
		if not bar:IsA("BillboardGui") then return end
		if cine.bars[bar] == nil then cine.bars[bar] = bar.Enabled end
		if bar.Enabled then bar.Enabled = false end
	end

	local function sweep()
		for _, gui in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
			pcall(hideGui, gui)
		end
		if cine.hideBars then
			local npcRoot = Workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCFolders")
			if npcRoot then
				local ok, items = pcall(function() return npcRoot:GetDescendants() end)
				for _, object in ipairs(ok and items or {}) do
					pcall(hideBar, object)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function restoreBars()
		for bar, was in pairs(cine.bars) do
			if bar.Parent then pcall(function() bar.Enabled = was end) end
		end
		table.clear(cine.bars)
	end

	local function stop()
		cine.on = false
		cine.token += 1
		if cine.conn then
			pcall(function() cine.conn:Disconnect() end)
			cine.conn = nil
		end
		for gui, was in pairs(cine.hidden) do
			if gui.Parent then pcall(function() gui.Enabled = was end) end
		end
		table.clear(cine.hidden)
		unghostAll()
		restoreBars()
		if cine.core then
			for coreType, was in pairs(cine.core) do
				pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(coreType, was) end)
			end
			cine.core = nil
		end
		pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCore("TopbarEnabled", cine.topbar ~= false) end)
		cine.topbar = nil
	end

	local function start()
		stop()
		cine.on = true
		local token = cine.token
		-- the Roblox buttons (logo / menu), chat and backpack
		cine.core = {}
		for _, coreType in ipairs(Enum.CoreGuiType:GetEnumItems()) do
			if coreType ~= Enum.CoreGuiType.All then
				pcall(function()
					cine.core[coreType] = StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(coreType)
					StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(coreType, false)
				end)
			end
		end
		pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCore("TopbarEnabled", false) end)
		cine.topbar = true
		sweep()
		-- anything the game adds or switches back on while the mode is on is hidden again
		cine.conn = playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			task.defer(function()
				if cine.on and child.Parent then pcall(hideGui, child) end
			end)
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			while cine.on and cine.token == token and not destroyed do
				sweep()
				task.wait(0.4)
			end
		end)
	end
	Custom.cineStop = stop

	local drawer = addToggleCogRow(page, "Mobile Cinematic Mode (hide game HUD)", function()
		return cine.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then start() else stop() end
	end)


	local moveRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Keep moving (walk stick + jump stay)")
	addSwitch(moveRow, function() return cine.keepMove end, function(value)
		cine.keepMove = value
		if cine.on then
			-- re-decide everything with the new setting
			unghostAll()
			for gui, was in pairs(cine.hidden) do
				if gui.Parent then pcall(function() gui.Enabled = was end) end
			end
			table.clear(cine.hidden)
			sweep()
		end
	end)

	local wordsRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Keep these controls (name contains)")
	local wordsLabel = wordsRow:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	if wordsLabel then
		wordsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 1, 0)
		wordsLabel.TextSize = 11
	end
	local wordsBox = make("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		Text = cine.keepWords,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		Font = Enum.Font.Code,
	}, wordsRow)
	outline(wordsBox)
	listen(wordsBox.FocusLost, function()
		cine.keepWords = wordsBox.Text
		if cine.on then
			-- apply the new words right now
			unghostAll()
			for gui, was in pairs(cine.hidden) do
				if gui.Parent then pcall(function() gui.Enabled = was end) end
			end
			table.clear(cine.hidden)
			sweep()
		end
	end)

	local barRow = addGrayRow(drawer, "Also hide health bars above units")
	addSwitch(barRow, function() return cine.hideBars end, function(value)
		cine.hideBars = value
		if not value then restoreBars() end
	end)
end)

safeBuild("Weather Changer", function()
	local page = pages["Misc"]
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

	make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "WEATHER CHANGER",
		TextColor3 = WHITE,
		TextSize = 16,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
	}, page)

	local world = {
		light = { on = false, clock = 0, brightness = 1, exposure = 0, ambient = { 40, 40, 70 }, outdoor = { 40, 40, 70 }, saved = nil, token = 0 },
		rain = { on = false, texture = "", color = { 170, 190, 255 }, visibility = 0.8, amount = 500, speed = 110, width = 50, height = 45, part = nil, emitter = nil },
		fog = { on = false, texture = "", color = { 200, 205, 215 }, visibility = 6, part = nil, emitter = nil, saved = nil },
		sky = { on = false, texture = "", color = { 255, 255, 255 }, visibility = 1, folder = nil, images = {} },
		follow = nil,
	}
	Custom.world = world

	local function color3(rgb)
		return Color3.fromRGB(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3])
	end

	local refreshers = {} -- redraw the boxes after a LOAD

	-- ===== small UI helpers =====
	local function addTextRow(drawer, label, placeholder, getText, onCommit)
		local row = addGrayRow(drawer, label)
		local box = make("TextBox", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 24),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			PlaceholderText = placeholder,
			PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY,
			Text = getText(),
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.Code,
			ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		}, row)
		outline(box)
		listen(box.FocusLost, function()
			onCommit(box.Text, box)
		end)
		table.insert(refreshers, function()
			box.Text = getText()
		end)
		return box
	end

	local function addRgbRow(drawer, label, rgb, onChange)
		local row = addGrayRow(drawer, label)
		local previewBox = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = color3(rgb),
		}, row)
		outline(previewBox)
		local rgbBoxes = {}
		table.insert(refreshers, function()
			for boxIndex, rgbBox in ipairs(rgbBoxes) do
				rgbBox.Text = tostring(rgb[boxIndex])
			end
			previewBox.BackgroundColor3 = color3(rgb)
		end)
		for index, offset in ipairs({ 124, 82, 40 }) do
			local box = make("TextBox", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 24),
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 0.5, 0),
				BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
				TextColor3 = BLACK,
				TextSize = 13,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				Text = tostring(rgb[index]),
				ClearTextOnFocus = false,
			}, row)
			outline(box)
			rgbBoxes[index] = box
			listen(box.FocusLost, function()
				local number = tonumber(box.Text)
				if number then
					rgb[index] = math.clamp(math.floor(number), 0, 255)
				end
				box.Text = tostring(rgb[index])
				previewBox.BackgroundColor3 = color3(rgb)
				onChange()
			end)
		end
	end

	local function addNumberRow(drawer, label, getValue, minValue, maxValue, onChange)
		local numberBoxRef = addNumberBox(addGrayRow(drawer, label), tostring(getValue()), function(box)
			local number = tonumber(box.Text)
			local value = number and math.clamp(number, minValue, maxValue) or getValue()
			onChange(value)
			box.Text = tostring(getValue())
		end)
		table.insert(refreshers, function()
			numberBoxRef.Text = tostring(getValue())
		end)
	end

	local function resolveImage(text, done)
		task.spawn(function()
			local image = ""
			if string.gsub(text or "", "%s", "") ~= "" then
				image = Avatar.resolveTexture(text) or ""
			end
			done(image)
		end)
	end

	local function statusLabel(drawer)
		return make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "",
			TextColor3 = WHITE,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
		}, drawer)
	end

	-- parts that follow the camera (rain / fog emitters and the skybox)
	local function camera()
		return Workspace.CurrentCamera
	end

	local function updateFollow()
		local cam = camera()
		if not cam then return end
		local position = cam.CFrame.Position
		if world.rain.part then
			world.rain.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, world.rain.height, 0))
		end
		if world.fog.part then
			world.fog.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
		end
		if world.sky.folder then
			local distance = 900
			for index, wall in ipairs(world.sky.folder:GetChildren()) do
				local direction = wall:GetAttribute("Dir")
				if direction then
					wall.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position + direction * distance, position)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function refreshFollow()
		local needed = world.rain.part or world.fog.part or world.sky.folder
		if needed and not world.follow then
			world.follow = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateFollow)
		elseif not needed and world.follow then
			world.follow:Disconnect()
			world.follow = nil
		end
	end

	local function newEmitterPart(name, size)
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = name
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Transparency = 1
		part.Size = size
		part.Parent = Workspace
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Parent = part
		return part, emitter
	end

	-- ===== Lighting / day & night =====
	local light = world.light
	local LIGHT_PROPS = { "ClockTime", "Brightness", "ExposureCompensation", "Ambient", "OutdoorAmbient" }

	local function applyLight()
		pcall(function()
			Lighting.ClockTime = light.clock
			Lighting.Brightness = light.brightness
			Lighting.ExposureCompensation = light.exposure
			Lighting.Ambient = color3(light.ambient)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = color3(light.outdoor)
		end)
	end

	local function stopLight()
		light.on = false
		light.token += 1
		if light.saved then
			for property, value in pairs(light.saved) do
				pcall(function()
					Lighting[property] = value
				end)
			end
			light.saved = nil
		end
	end

	local function startLight()
		stopLight()
		light.on = true
		local token = light.token
		light.saved = {}
		for _, property in ipairs(LIGHT_PROPS) do
			pcall(function()
				light.saved[property] = Lighting[property]
			end)
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			while light.on and light.token == token and not destroyed do
				applyLight() -- held, in case the game changes it back
				task.wait(0.3)
			end
		end)
	end

	local lightDrawer = addToggleCogRow(page, "Lighting (day / night)", function()
		return light.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then startLight() else stopLight() end
	end)
	local function lightChanged()
		if light.on then applyLight() end
	end
	addNumberRow(lightDrawer, "Time of day (0-24, 0 = midnight, 14 = day)", function() return light.clock end, 0, 24, function(v) light.clock = v lightChanged() end)
	local presetRow = addGrayRow(lightDrawer, "Presets")
	local function presetButton(text, offset, width, clock, brightness, ambient)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 24),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, presetRow)
		outline(button)
		listen(button.MouseButton1Click, function()
			light.clock, light.brightness = clock, brightness
			light.ambient = { ambient[1], ambient[2], ambient[3] }
			light.outdoor = { ambient[1], ambient[2], ambient[3] }
			if not light.on then startLight() else applyLight() end
		end)
	end
	presetButton("NIGHT", 8, 64, 0, 0.4, { 30, 30, 60 })
	presetButton("DAY", 78, 64, 14, 2.5, { 120, 120, 120 })
	presetButton("SUNSET", 148, 70, 18, 1.5, { 110, 70, 60 })
	addNumberRow(lightDrawer, "Brightness (0-10)", function() return light.brightness end, 0, 10, function(v) light.brightness = v lightChanged() end)
	addNumberRow(lightDrawer, "Exposure (-3 to 3)", function() return light.exposure end, -3, 3, function(v) light.exposure = v lightChanged() end)
	addRgbRow(lightDrawer, "Ambient colour RGB", light.ambient, lightChanged)
	addRgbRow(lightDrawer, "Outdoor ambient RGB", light.outdoor, lightChanged)

	-- ===== Rain =====
	local rain = world.rain
	local function applyRain()
		local emitter = rain.emitter
		if not emitter then return end
		emitter.Texture = rain.texture ~= "" and rain.texture or "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color3(rain.color))
		emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - rain.visibility)
		emitter.Rate = rain.amount
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(rain.speed * 0.9, rain.speed * 1.1)
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(math.max(0.3, rain.height / rain.speed), math.max(0.4, rain.height / rain.speed * 1.2))
		if rain.part then rain.part.Size = Vector3.new(rain.width * 2.8, 1, rain.width * 2.8) end
		emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.5)
		emitter.Squash = NumberSequence.new(-0.9)
		emitter.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel
		emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
		emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(2, 2)
		emitter.LightEmission = 0
		emitter.LightInfluence = 0
		emitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -60, 0)
		emitter.Enabled = true
	end
	local function stopRain()
		rain.on = false
		if rain.part then rain.part:Destroy() end
		rain.part, rain.emitter = nil, nil
		refreshFollow()
	end
	local function startRain()
		stopRain()
		rain.on = true
		rain.part, rain.emitter = newEmitterPart("OscarsRain", Vector3.new(140, 1, 140))
		applyRain()
		updateFollow()
		refreshFollow()
	end
	local rainDrawer = addToggleCogRow(page, "Rain", function()
		return rain.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then startRain() else stopRain() end
	end)
	local rainStatus
	addTextRow(rainDrawer, "Texture / decal ID (blank = default)", "image ID", function() return rain.texture end, function(text, box)
		resolveImage(text, function(image)
			rain.texture = image
			box.Text = image
			applyRain()
			if rainStatus then rainStatus.Text = image ~= "" and "Rain texture set." or "Rain uses the default drop." end
		end)
	end)
	addRgbRow(rainDrawer, "Rain colour RGB", rain.color, applyRain)
	addNumberRow(rainDrawer, "Visibility (0 = invisible, 1 = fully visible)", function() return rain.visibility end, 0, 1, function(v) rain.visibility = v applyRain() end)
	addNumberRow(rainDrawer, "Amount (1-3000)", function() return rain.amount end, 1, 3000, function(v) rain.amount = v applyRain() end)
	addNumberRow(rainDrawer, "Rain width (1-100)", function() return rain.width end, 1, 100, function(v) rain.width = v applyRain() end)
	addNumberRow(rainDrawer, "Rain height (1-100)", function() return rain.height end, 1, 100, function(v) rain.height = v applyRain() updateFollow() end)
	addNumberRow(rainDrawer, "Fall speed (10-400)", function() return rain.speed end, 10, 400, function(v) rain.speed = v applyRain() end)
	rainStatus = statusLabel(rainDrawer)

	-- ===== Fog =====
	local fog = world.fog
	local FOG_PROPS = { "FogColor", "FogStart", "FogEnd" }
	local function applyFog()
		pcall(function()
			Lighting.FogColor = color3(fog.color)
			Lighting.FogStart = 0
			-- visibility 0 = no fog at all, 10 = thick fog close to you
			local density = fog.visibility / 10
			Lighting.FogEnd = density <= 0 and 1000000 or (60 + ((1 - density) ^ 3) * 5000)
		end)
		local emitter = fog.emitter
		if emitter then
			emitter.Texture = fog.texture ~= "" and fog.texture or "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
			emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color3(fog.color))
			emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, 1 - (fog.visibility / 10) * 0.6),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, 1 - (fog.visibility / 10) * 0.6),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
			})
			emitter.Rate = 6
			emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(7, 9)
			emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
			emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(35)
			emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
			emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-8, 8)
			emitter.LightInfluence = 0
			emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
			emitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			emitter.Enabled = true
		end
	end
	local function stopFog()
		fog.on = false
		if fog.part then fog.part:Destroy() end
		fog.part, fog.emitter = nil, nil
		if fog.saved then
			for property, value in pairs(fog.saved) do
				pcall(function()
					Lighting[property] = value
				end)
			end
			fog.saved = nil
		end
		refreshFollow()
	end
	local function startFog()
		stopFog()
		fog.on = true
		fog.saved = {}
		for _, property in ipairs(FOG_PROPS) do
			pcall(function()
				fog.saved[property] = Lighting[property]
			end)
		end
		fog.part, fog.emitter = newEmitterPart("OscarsFog", Vector3.new(90, 4, 90))
		applyFog()
		updateFollow()
		refreshFollow()
	end
	local fogDrawer = addToggleCogRow(page, "Fog", function()
		return fog.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then startFog() else stopFog() end
	end)
	local fogStatus
	addTextRow(fogDrawer, "Texture / decal ID (blank = default)", "image ID", function() return fog.texture end, function(text, box)
		resolveImage(text, function(image)
			fog.texture = image
			box.Text = image
			if fog.on then applyFog() end
			if fogStatus then fogStatus.Text = image ~= "" and "Fog texture set." or "Fog uses the default cloud." end
		end)
	end)
	addRgbRow(fogDrawer, "Fog colour RGB", fog.color, function() if fog.on then applyFog() end end)
	addNumberRow(fogDrawer, "Fog strength (0 = none, 10 = thickest)", function() return fog.visibility end, 0, 10, function(v) fog.visibility = v if fog.on then applyFog() end end)
	fogStatus = statusLabel(fogDrawer)

	-- ===== Skybox =====
	local sky = world.sky
	local SKY_DIRECTIONS = {
		Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
		Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
	}
	local function applySky()
		for _, image in ipairs(sky.images) do
			image.Image = sky.texture
			image.ImageColor3 = color3(sky.color)
			image.ImageTransparency = 1 - sky.visibility
		end
	end
	local function stopSky()
		sky.on = false
		if sky.folder then sky.folder:Destroy() end
		sky.folder = nil
		sky.images = {}
		refreshFollow()
	end
	local function startSky()
		stopSky()
		if sky.texture == "" then return false end
		sky.on = true
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "OscarsSkybox"
		for _, direction in ipairs(SKY_DIRECTIONS) do
			local wall = Instance.new("Part")
			wall.Name = "Wall"
			wall.Anchored = true
			wall.CanCollide = false
			wall.CanTouch = false
			wall.CanQuery = false
			wall.CastShadow = false
			wall.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			wall.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			wall.Size = Vector3.new(2100, 2100, 1)
			wall:SetAttribute("Dir", direction)
			local gui3d = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
			gui3d.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
			gui3d.LightInfluence = 0
			gui3d.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(1024, 1024)
			gui3d.Parent = wall
			local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			image.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
			image.Parent = gui3d
			table.insert(sky.images, image)
			wall.Parent = folder
		end
		folder.Parent = Workspace
		sky.folder = folder
		applySky()
		updateFollow()
		refreshFollow()
		return true
	end
	local skyStatus
	local skyDrawer = addToggleCogRow(page, "Skybox", function()
		return sky.on
	end, function(value)
		if value then
			if not startSky() then
				if skyStatus then skyStatus.Text = "Type a texture / decal ID first." end
			end
		else
			stopSky()
		end
	end)
	addTextRow(skyDrawer, "Texture / decal ID", "image ID", function() return sky.texture end, function(text, box)
		resolveImage(text, function(image)
			sky.texture = image
			box.Text = image
			if image == "" then
				stopSky()
				if skyStatus then skyStatus.Text = "Skybox off: no texture." end
			elseif sky.on then
				applySky()
			else
				startSky()
				if skyStatus then skyStatus.Text = "Skybox on. Use the header switch to turn it off." end
			end
		end)
	end)
	addRgbRow(skyDrawer, "Skybox colour RGB (255 = original)", sky.color, function() if sky.on then applySky() end end)
	addNumberRow(skyDrawer, "Visibility (0 = invisible, 1 = fully visible)", function() return sky.visibility end, 0, 1, function(v) sky.visibility = v if sky.on then applySky() end end)
	skyStatus = statusLabel(skyDrawer)

	-- ===== Save / Load the world settings =====
	local function numbers(...)
		local list = {}
		for _, value in ipairs({ ... }) do list[#list + 1] = tostring(value) end
		return list
	end
	local function clean(text)
		return (string.gsub(text or "", "[|%s]", ""))
	end
	local function serializeWorld()
		local f = {}
		local function add(...)
			for _, value in ipairs({ ... }) do f[#f + 1] = tostring(value) end
		end
		add(light.clock, light.brightness, light.exposure, light.ambient[1], light.ambient[2], light.ambient[3], light.outdoor[1], light.outdoor[2], light.outdoor[3])
		add(clean(rain.texture), rain.color[1], rain.color[2], rain.color[3], rain.visibility, rain.amount, rain.speed, rain.width, rain.height)
		add(clean(fog.texture), fog.color[1], fog.color[2], fog.color[3], fog.visibility)
		add(clean(sky.texture), sky.color[1], sky.color[2], sky.color[3], sky.visibility)
		local body = Custom.encodeBase64(table.concat(f, "|"))
		return "OSW1" .. body .. Custom.checksum(body)
	end
	local WORLD_FIELDS = 9 + 9 + 5 + 5

	local function loadWorld(code)
		code = string.gsub(code or "", "%s", "")
		if string.sub(code, 1, 4) ~= "OSW1" or #code < 7 then
			return false, "That is not a valid world code."
		end
		local body = string.sub(code, 5, #code - 1)
		if Custom.checksum(body) ~= string.sub(code, #code) then
			return false, "The code is damaged (a character is wrong or missing)."
		end
		local ok, decoded = pcall(decodeBase64, body)
		if not ok then return false, "The code could not be read." end
		local f = string.split(decoded, "|")
		if #f ~= WORLD_FIELDS then return false, "The code could not be read." end
		local at = 0
		local function num(minValue, maxValue, fallback)
			at += 1
			local value = tonumber(f[at])
			return value and math.clamp(value, minValue, maxValue) or fallback
		end
		local function text()
			at += 1
			return f[at] or ""
		end
		local function rgb(target)
			for i = 1, 3 do target[i] = math.floor(num(0, 255, target[i])) end
		end
		light.clock = num(0, 24, light.clock)
		light.brightness = num(0, 10, light.brightness)
		light.exposure = num(-3, 3, light.exposure)
		rgb(light.ambient)
		rgb(light.outdoor)
		rain.texture = text()
		rgb(rain.color)
		rain.visibility = num(0, 1, rain.visibility)
		rain.amount = num(1, 3000, rain.amount)
		rain.speed = num(10, 400, rain.speed)
		rain.width = num(1, 100, rain.width)
		rain.height = num(1, 100, rain.height)
		fog.texture = text()
		rgb(fog.color)
		fog.visibility = num(0, 10, fog.visibility)
		sky.texture = text()
		rgb(sky.color)
		sky.visibility = num(0, 1, sky.visibility)

		for _, refreshBox in ipairs(refreshers) do
			refreshBox()
		end
		if light.on then applyLight() end
		if rain.on then applyRain() end
		if fog.on then applyFog() end
		if sky.on then
			if sky.texture == "" then stopSky() else applySky() end
		end
		return true
	end

	local saveRow = addGrayRow(page, "Save / Load world settings")
	local function saveButton(text, offset)
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 24),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = BLACK,
			TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		}, saveRow)
		outline(button)
		return button
	end
	local worldLoadButton = saveButton("LOAD", 8)
	local worldSaveButton = saveButton("SAVE", 68)
	local codeRow = addGrayRow(page, "Code")
	local worldCodeBox = make("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 24),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		TextColor3 = BLACK,
		PlaceholderText = "save to get a code / paste one here",
		PlaceholderColor3 = GRAY,
		Text = "",
		TextSize = 12,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		Font = Enum.Font.Code,
	}, codeRow)
	outline(worldCodeBox)
	local worldStatus = statusLabel(page)
	listen(worldSaveButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		local code = serializeWorld()
		worldCodeBox.Text = code
		worldStatus.Text = Custom.copy(code) and "Saved! The code is in the box and copied to your clipboard." or "Saved! Copy the code from the box."
	end)
	listen(worldLoadButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
		local ok, reason = loadWorld(worldCodeBox.Text)
		worldStatus.Text = ok and "Loaded! Switch the features on to see them (the ones already on were updated)." or ("Could not load: " .. tostring(reason))
	end)

	Custom.worldSerialize, Custom.worldLoad = serializeWorld, loadWorld

	Custom.worldStop = function()
		pcall(stopLight)
		pcall(stopRain)
		pcall(stopFog)
		pcall(stopSky)
	end
end)
